prompt:
镜头保持着第一人称视角（POV）。指尖轻轻擦过镜头的边缘，带来一丝微凉的触感。布料摩擦的细微声响，轻柔得像耳语。
她眼带笑意，声音轻柔地凑近：
“又在偷偷看我吗？”

下一秒，她突然凑得更近，发丝几乎要拂过镜头，屏幕外都能感受到那股温热而暧昧的气息。
她带着一丝调侃的语气，刻意地引诱着：
“看够了吗……
不如……
再好好看看我。”

她的睫毛轻微颤动，再次抬眼时，眼底盛满了笑意，只剩下你们之间，安静的呼吸声。

The camera maintains a Point of View (POV) perspective. Fingertips gently brush the edge of the lens, carrying a slightly cool touch. The sound of fabric lightly rubbing is as soft as a whisper.
She smiles with her eyes, her voice gently leaning in:
“Are you secretly watching me again?”

The next second, she suddenly moves closer, her hair almost sweeping across the lens, and the warm, cozy breath can be felt through the screen.
Her slightly teasing tone carries a deliberate allure:
“Have you seen enough yet…
How about…
Take a good look at me.”

Her eyelashes flutter slightly, and when she looks up again, her eyes are full of smiles, and the only sound left is the quiet breathing between the two of you.

prompt: A single uninterrupted cinematic shot begins at sunrise in the middle of a vast peaceful meadow. At the center stands one enormous ancient oak tree with a wide trunk, sprawling branches, and deeply textured bark. The surrounding landscape is calm, covered in fresh green grass with distant mountains beneath a soft golden sky. Gentle birdsong fills the air as the camera slowly begins orbiting the tree in a perfectly smooth circular motion. The tree remains at the exact center of the frame throughout the entire film. As the camera completes the first quarter of its orbit, spring awakens instantly around the tree. Tiny buds emerge along every branch. Fresh green leaves unfurl in beautiful synchronized motion. Wildflowers bloom across the meadow in waves of color. Butterflies flutter through the warm air while birds begin building nests among the branches. Soft morning mist lifts from the grass as sunlight grows brighter. Without stopping, the camera continues its orbit. The landscape gradually transforms into vibrant summer. The tree's canopy becomes dense and full. Long grass sways gently in the warm breeze. Bees collect pollen from blooming flowers. A nearby stream sparkles under intense sunlight. Children briefly appear beneath the tree enjoying a picnic before naturally fading as time continues moving forward. Everything feels alive with warmth and abundance. The camera never cuts. As it reaches the opposite side of the tree, summer slowly gives way to autumn. The sunlight becomes warmer and lower in the sky. Leaves transition through brilliant shades of emerald, yellow, orange, crimson, and deep red. Gentle wind carries thousands of leaves into elegant swirling patterns around the camera. The meadow changes into rich golden tones while migrating birds cross the distant horizon. Time accelerates. The final leaves drift gracefully to the ground. The orbit continues. A quiet snowfall begins. Within moments the landscape transforms into winter. Snow blankets every branch with delicate crystalline detail. Frost slowly spreads across the bark. The nearby stream freezes into clear ice. The sky becomes pale blue while soft snowflakes fall silently through the air. The entire world feels peaceful and still. The camera completes one full orbit. Instead of stopping, it continues circling faster. Each complete revolution now represents decades instead of seasons. Spring, summer, autumn, and winter flow continuously around the tree in increasingly rapid succession. Blossoms bloom and disappear. Leaves grow, change color, and fall. Snow arrives and melts.

path: prompts/真人/特效向/科幻/youmind-6664--丛林军事基地外星人突袭.md
prompt:
A jungle army base at night, deep in thick wet rainforest. Tents, sandbags, floodlights, an open dirt yard, and a low concrete ammo bunker stacked with shells. A giant alien — brownish-black, slimy, with long whipping tentacles — has torn open the ammo bunker and is dragging a soldier across the ground toward the stacked shells. On the watchtower, a gunner loads a mounted gun. Sound: tearing concrete, wet tentacles slapping, shouting men, the alien's low roar, radio voices.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low shot across the floodlit yard. The giant alien rips the steel door off the ammo bunker with one set of tentacles while another wraps a soldier's legs, dragging him backward across the mud toward the open bunker full of shells. He claws at the ground. Men scatter between the tents. One shouts into his radio: "IT'S DRAGGING HIM TO THE SHELLS!"

Shot 2 (3–6s): Up on the watchtower. The gunner swings his mounted gun toward the alien, but holds his fire — the soldier still in the tentacles, the bunker right there. He calls down on the radio: "Break loose! Run clear!"

Shot 3 (6–9s): At the soldier. He pulls a knife and slashes the slimy tentacle around his legs, breaks free, and runs clear of the bunker across the open yard. The alien, now empty-handed, slides forward out of the bunker into the open middle of the yard, rearing up tall and clear in the floodlights, the stacked shells behind it.

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BIG SLOW-MOTION MOMENT: The alien is out in the open now, the ammo bunker right behind it. The gunner fires. Bullet time — a stream of heavy rounds flies across the yard in slow motion, smoke and shell cases hanging in the air, smashing into the alien and ripping into the bunker behind it. The shells catch — a huge fireball blooming around the alien.

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The whole bunker goes up in one massive rolling fireball, shells cooking off in bursts, fire and slime shooting into the night sky. Soldiers dive into the mud as the rescued man scrambles clear of the blast. Cut.

Side exterior shot: a powerful gust makes the crane swing harder. One section rattles violently, a hanging cable whips across the frame, and debris flies away into the night. The agents keep moving toward the unfinished tower ahead.

They reach the far end of the crane and make a fast desperate jump from the crane arm onto the unfinished floor of the next skyscraper. They land hard, roll across the wet concrete, and regain balance as the crane continues swaying behind them.

Final moment: the two agents rise on the unfinished tower floor, storm raging around them, while the giant crane swings behind against the glowing city skyline.

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, fast-paced, suspenseful, clear and readable action, strong sense of height and danger, storm, rain, wind, blinking warning lights, metal structure, dynamic but readable camera movement, visible hair, no hoods, no helmets, no masks, no celebrity resemblance, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion. 她在一层半成品的楼面上飞奔，跃过缝隙并躲避碎片。在她身后，三只外星生物——皮肤苍白、身形细长、动作湿滑且充满韧性——正穷追不舍，步步紧逼。

环境音瞬间转为沉寂——外部声音变得低沉模糊。

外部噪音逐渐增强。
无硬切。

prompt:
A vast mirror-like lake sits in the middle of a silent mountain valley at dawn. The water is perfectly reflective, showing not the sky above but alternate versions of the landscape: cities that do not exist, forests that have not grown yet, ruins from futures that may never happen.

Opening frame: slow aerial descent toward the lake surface. Mist moves gently across the water. The real mountains above are cold and grey, but their reflection is filled with impossible golden architecture.

At the 2-second mark, the reflection moves before the real world does.

A future version of a person appears under the water, walking upside down beneath the surface. Then dozens of future selves appear ,older, younger, wounded, joyful, faceless , all moving in different directions beneath the lake.

The camera descends through the water surface without a splash, entering the reflected world. Underwater, there is no water ,only an inverted valley where time flows in visible currents. Memories fall from the sky like leaves. Roads grow out of people’s shadows. Mountains slowly turn into buildings, then back into mountains.

VFX escalation: the different futures begin colliding. A futuristic city rises through an ancient forest. A ruined bridge repairs itself while simultaneously collapsing. The lake surface above fractures like glass, revealing the real world watching from the other side.

Velocity ramp: a future self reaches toward the camera ,time slows as their hand breaks into thousands of reflective shards, each shard showing a different life.

Final moment: the camera rises back above the lake. The surface is still again. Only one word appears as ripples across the water: CHOOSE.

Experimental time-reflection cinema, mirror water physics, alternate futures, surreal temporal landscapes, dawn mist, cinematic poetry, 4K.

The man wears the same look as the viral video: a tailored black suit, crisp white dress shirt, black dress shoes, clean, elegant styling. The drone begins hundreds of feet away, revealing the full scale of the skyscraper and New York City, then slowly glides toward the couple in one continuous, buttery-smooth cinematic movement. As the drone approaches, the man gently takes her hand, slowly drops to one knee, and opens a small velvet ring box. prompt:
Camera: Large-format 65mm sensor, IMAX-grade resolution, Hasselblad look, extreme sharpness, vast depth of field, minimal distortion, clinical rendering, hyperreal CGI clarity, crisp micro-contrast. 35mm lens, f/4.

Camera Style: Handheld urgency during the fall, then locked low-angle shots on the cracking floor and emerging threat.

Lighting: Collapsing cavern shrine lit by harsh orange-red magma glow flooding from multiple fissures. Thick dust haze fills the air. Falling debris catches the firelight.

Style & Mood: High-contrast volcanic grade, obsidian blacks, ember oranges, hyperreal CGI clarity, minimal grain, no painterly texture. Physical peril, disorientation, dawning dread, and the first sign of something waking beneath the rock.

Character: A hooded East Asian woman with an oval face, dark eyes, and mostly black hair with a few thin white/silver strands framing her face. She wears a heavy dark charcoal-black hooded cloak with the hood up. Beneath it: a cream/off-white dress with gold filigree embroidery, blue inner lining visible at the leg slit, a dark leather corset-style waist cinch, pale forearm bracers, and a sword sheathed at her hip. She cradles a small reptilian salamander in an open-topped burlap sack against her chest.

Creature: Small reptilian salamander with dulled grey and pale lavender scales, barely glowing, weak and unmoving inside the sack.

Set: Molten shrine interior with a carved obsidian altar on a circular dais. Jagged cracked walls and floor glow with magma seams. Chamber is mid-collapse, with dust, falling rock, and deep glowing fissures everywhere.

Narrative: During the collapse, debris strikes the woman and knocks her off balance. As she recovers, the magma begins rumbling ominously through the cracks. The fissures pulse brighter like a heartbeat. Massive clawed obsidian arms, veined with orange-red magma, breach the floor and begin pushing upward.

Shot Sequence:

Handheld medium shot: A chunk of ceiling debris clips the woman’s shoulder as she dodges another falling rock. She loses her footing on the shaking ground and falls hard onto one knee and one braced palm, keeping her other arm curled protectively around the burlap sack to cushion the salamander from impact.
Hard cut to close-up: Her face is near the ground, dust-streaked and disoriented. She blinks hard and breathes raggedly.
Hard cut to wide locked low-angle shot: The largest crack near the altar begins to rumble. Thick magma light pulses brighter from within the fissure like a heartbeat.
Hard cut to extreme close-up low-angle: The glowing magma inside the fissure bulges and breaks as a massive clawed obsidian hand, veined with bright orange-red magma, punches through the rock and grips the broken edge of the floor.
Hard cut to second wide shot: A matching second clawed arm breaches a few feet away. Both hands grip the fissure edges, obsidian knuckles cracking with heat as they begin to push upward.

prompt:
This is handheld documentary footage recorded on an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder at the construction site of the Great Pyramid of Giza. The footage feels like real, imperfect documentation of one of the largest building projects in history.

The recording shows hundreds of workers moving massive stone blocks on a large construction ramp. Teams of men are pulling ropes attached to sledges with heavy limestone blocks. Overseers with sticks walk along the lines giving orders. Dust fills the air. In the background, the partially built pyramid rises against the sky. The work is extremely physical and organized.

The camera moves along one of the work gangs, following a team of workers as they pull a large block up the ramp. It occasionally tilts up to show the height of the structure. There are natural cuts between different groups of workers and close views of the ropes straining and the stone moving slowly. The movement of the camera feels like someone walking among the workers documenting the labor.

The handheld camera shows constant shake, drifting framing, autofocus hunting in the bright sunlight and dust, exposure changes, motion blur, and the typical look of filming heavy physical work with an old DV camcorder. The person filming is clearly moving through the active construction site.

Natural sound only: the sound of hundreds of men shouting and grunting in rhythm, ropes creaking under tension, stones scraping on the ground, and general noise of a massive construction site. No music.

The result must feel like authentic, raw footage of the construction of the Great Pyramid, captured on an old camcorder.

镜头跟随其中一个工作小组，记录他们将巨石沿坡道向上拉动的过程。镜头偶尔向上倾斜，展现建筑的高度。画面在不同工作组之间自然切换，并特写了紧绷的绳索和缓慢移动的石块。摄像机的移动感仿佛拍摄者正穿梭在工人中间，记录着他们的劳动。

prompt:
This is handheld documentary footage recorded on an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder following a young man through a farming village along the Nile. The footage should feel like authentic, imperfect home video of daily life in ancient Egypt.

The man is in his early 20s. He has dark hair kept short, warm brown skin with natural texture from outdoor work, and wears a simple white linen kilt with a belt. His body shows the physical condition of someone who does heavy agricultural and construction labor.

The environment is a modest Egyptian village near the river: mud-brick houses, fields of wheat and flax, irrigation channels, palm trees, and a few donkeys and cattle moving through the area.

The recording follows him as he starts the day working in the fields with a wooden plow pulled by two oxen, guiding the animals along the irrigation channels. He then moves to one of the channels to clear mud and debris with a wooden tool. Later he walks toward the river carrying a large basket and joins other men loading harvested crops onto a small wooden boat. On his way back to the village he stops to help repair a section of an irrigation channel using mud bricks. He finishes near his house, sitting on the ground while sharpening a wooden tool with a stone.

The camera follows him with natural handheld shake, drifting framing, autofocus issues when he bends or moves quickly, exposure changes between bright fields and shaded areas, and occasional motion blur.

Natural sound only: water flowing in the channels, distant animal sounds, the sound of tools hitting mud and wood, voices of other workers, and light wind. No music.

The result must feel like real, candid footage of everyday agricultural life in ancient Egypt captured on an old camcorder.

prompt:
Cinematic multi-shot sequence, one continuous duel, no unmotivated cuts,
photorealistic, 8K ultra-high-definition, hyperdetailed, 35mm film quality,
professional color grading, sharp focus, fine film grain, depth of field
mastery, tracking-to-handheld fluidity, 180° shutter motion blur.

WARRIOR ONE: a lean older swordsman, weathered face, grey-streaked topknot,
faded indigo kimono with a torn sleeve, katana held low in a relaxed grip,
calm and economical in movement. Same appearance throughout, no drift.

WARRIOR TWO: a younger, broader swordsman, shaved sides with a dark
top-knot, black armored haori over a crimson under-layer, a slightly
longer blade held high in an aggressive stance, ferocious and explosive in
movement. Same appearance throughout, no drift.

LOCATION: a narrow snowy mountain pass at dusk, sheer grey rock walls on
either side, deep snowdrift underfoot, thin dead pine trees, wind driving
loose snow sideways, a bruised violet-grey sky, faint warm light bleeding
from the last sliver of sun on the horizon.

COLOR 60:30:10 — 60% cold slate-grey and white snow / 30% deep violet-blue
dusk shadow / 10% accent of the dying warm orange horizon light and a flash
of crimson from Warrior Two's under-layer.

PHYSICS: real blade weight and momentum, boots break through snow crust
with each step, snow kicks up and drifts in the wind on every strike, cloth
and hair whipped by wind and motion, sparks on blade contact, breath
steaming heavy in the cold.

0–3s — THE CLOSE: wide low shot, both warriors circling at a distance in
the pass, snow driving sideways between them. Warrior One's calm stance
against Warrior Two's coiled aggression. They surge together, blades
clearing in the same instant.

3–5s — FIRST CLASH: tight tracking shot as the swords meet in a shower of
sparks, both warriors pivoting past each other, snow exploding from their
footwork, a beat of stillness as they land facing opposite directions.

5–8s — THE EXCHANGE: fast tracking shot circling the pair as blades trade
in a rapid three-strike combo, blocked, parried, blocked again, snow and
steam thrown with every impact, Warrior Two forcing Warrior One back toward
the rock wall.

8–9s — THE OPENING: Warrior One slips a strike by a hair, time begins to
ramp as his blade angles in toward Warrior Two's guard.

9–12s — THE MOMENT, slow motion 120fps: near standstill as the blades lock
edge to edge, sparks frozen mid-scatter, snow suspended in the air around
them, both warriors' faces taut with strain, breath visible and hanging,
the dying orange light catching the steel.

12–15s — THE BREAK, snap back to 24fps: time cracks back, Warrior One
twists free and disengages with a low sweeping strike, Warrior Two staggers
back a step into the snow, both warriors resetting into stance, chests
heaving, blades still raised, the wind howling between them as the shot
holds wide.

AUDIO (no music): howling mountain wind, boots crunchin

00:13–00:15 STILLNESS. Wide, still shot. Dust hangs gently in the golden light, calmer now than before, as though something has resolved rather than broken. She stands alone, at peace, glowing warmly in the last of the sunlight. Hold. Fade not cut to warm white light, then to black.

A bright, bouncy K-pop style song with English lyrics. Do not use existing songs.

The protagonist performs a cute dance. Prioritize cuteness. prompt:
15-second stylized 2D hand-drawn animation, top-down naval battle on old yellow lined notebook paper. Keep the notebook-paper world from start to finish, with blue horizontal lines and the red left margin line always visible. Subtle paper texture, pencil marks, and ink strokes should be emphasized. No live action, no 3D, no realistic faces, no modern objects, no narration, no subtitles.

A childlike doodle naval battle gradually transforms into a legendary illustrated naval battle, then collapses back into doodles. The escalation should feel magical, as if imagination is taking over the paper.

Two naval forces, red vs blue, advance across the notebook page. Include panokseon ships, rowing boats, flags, arrows, and cannons. A turtle ship sits at the center of the battle. At first everything is rough and childish, like simple notebook doodles. As the battle intensifies, the drawings become more detailed, with stronger ink lines, richer ship details, ink-like smoke, wave marks, and dramatic motion.

A commander symbolizing Admiral Yi Sun-sin appears as a heroic silhouette, not a realistic portrait. As the animation progresses, his hand-drawn presence becomes more majestic and clearly defined while still staying within the notebook illustration style.

Timeline:
0–3s: A simple doodle naval battle begins on the notebook page. Red and blue fleets move toward each other.
3–7s: The first collision begins. Arrows fly, cannons fire, ships crash, and the drawing style starts upgrading from rough doodles into more detailed ink illustration.
7–11s: The battle reaches its grandest form. The turtle ship dominates the center, surrounded by detailed hand-drawn ships, smoke, waves, arrows, and rhythmic impacts. The scene feels legendary and heroic.
11–15s: After a decisive charge and impact, everything breaks apart. Ships, waves, smoke, and figures collapse back into simple doodles, broken ink lines, and scattered pencil marks. The notebook page becomes strangely quiet again.

Motion should be smooth and fluid, with sharp rhythmic impacts. Keep a minimum 24fps feeling. Maintain readable silhouettes from the top-down view, with the turtle ship clearly visible as the central object.

Emotional flow: playful and curious at first, then increasingly solemn and heroic, reaching a mythic climax, then ending with a quiet, strange afterglow after the collapse.

一场童趣十足的涂鸦海战逐渐演变为史诗般的插画海战，随后又坍塌回涂鸦状态。这种升级过程应具有魔幻感，仿佛想象力正在接管整张纸面。

11–15 秒：在决定性的冲锋与碰撞后，一切分崩离析。船只、波浪、烟雾和人物坍塌回简单的涂鸦、破碎的墨线和零散的铅笔痕迹。笔记本页面再次变得异常宁静。

prompt:
# リファレンス

メインキャラクター = @image1: 顔の特徴、髪型、髪色、目、肌や毛皮の質感、服装、装備、アクセサリー、体格、シルエット、色、雰囲気、そしてキャラクターのアイデンティティを維持してください。リファレンス画像に存在しない服装、装備、身体的特徴を追加しないでください。

# スタイル

フルカラーの日本のアニメスタイル。派手でシネマティックなファンタジー PV。メインキャラクターが夜明け前の森で火の魔法を生み出し、炎を段階的に変化させ、最終的に巨大なフェニックスを召喚します。

順序は固定です：手で空気と光を集める → 火種 → 横に走る炎 → 垂直に噴き上がる炎 → 渦巻く圧縮 → 大きな火の卵 → 卵のひび割れ → 小さな火の鳥 → 成長 → 巨大なフェニックス。手順を飛ばさないでください。

# 設定 / 背景

夜明け前の森の開けた場所。高い木々、朝霧、苔むした地面、湿った土、小石、木の根があります。背景を真っ暗にせず、青い森の奥行き、霧の層、木漏れ日を見せてください。地面は濡れており、炎の光を反射します。火花、灰、舞い散る落ち葉、そして判読不能な抽象的な魔法のルーン文字が空中に現れては消えます。

# 時間 / 季節 / 天候 / 光

早朝。晴れ。最初は冷たい青色の薄明と霧。魔法が始まると、炎の温かい光が主人公の顔、髪や頭部、服装、手、そして地面を照らします。炎が大きくなるにつれて、オレンジと黄金色の光が霧、木の幹、枝葉、地面に広がります。巨大なフェニックスが現れると、朝の逆光、強い炎の光、陽炎、地面の反射が強く同時に発生します。

# 視覚的詳細 / 質感

指先、手、服の端、髪や毛皮、装備、アクセサリーの質感を見せてください。髪、毛皮、服の裾、生地、装飾が熱風で自然に揺れます。炎は火種から、横に走る炎の帯、垂直に噴き上がる炎の柱、渦巻く炎、脈動する大きな火の卵、ひび割れる殻、小さな火の鳥、成長する火の鳥、そして巨大なフェニックスへと変化します。最後のフェニックスは、翼、頭、くちばし、胸、尾羽が明確に識別できる雄大な火の鳥です。

# カメラ / フォーカス / 構図

カットの平均長は 2 ～ 3 秒。全編を通して単一の構図を使用しないでください。手のクローズアップ、上半身、顔と手、森を含むミディアムワイド、そして最後のローアングルからの見上げを使用します。正面を向いた「パワーポーズ」は避けてください。45 度の角度、ローアングル、前ボケ、オフセンターの構図を使用してください。炎が横に走るときは水平トラッキング、垂直に噴き上がるときはティルトアップ、卵の形成中はオービット（旋回）、巨大化中はスケールを見せるために少し引くカメラワークを使用します。

# オーディオ

壮大でシネマティックなファンタジー BGM。歌詞なし。最初は神秘的で、中盤はストリングスと重厚なパーカッション、最後はクライマックスに達します。

効果音には、布や装備が擦れる音、手から発生する風切り音、着火音、炎が横に走る音、炎が噴き上がる音、渦巻く燃焼音、卵の低い共鳴音、殻が割れる音、小さな鳥の火の翼が羽ばたく音、そして巨大なフェニックスの爆発的な炎の音と重厚な羽ばたき音を含めます。台詞はありません。

# シーン

この 15 秒間で、主人公は森の中で手の中に空気と光を集め、小さな火種を生み出します。炎は横に走り、垂直に噴き上がり、渦巻いて大きな火の卵になります。卵が割れて小さな火の鳥が生まれ、主人公の周りを旋回しながら成長します。最後になって初めて巨大なフェニックスへと一気に変身し、翼を広げて森と主人公を包み込みます。

# 制約事項

字幕なし。画面内のテキストなし。ロゴなし。判読可能な UI なし。判読可能な文字による魔法文字なし。魔法のシンボルは抽象的なルーン文字やパターンであること。

@image1 の顔、髪型、髪色、目、肌や毛皮の質感、服装、装備、アクセサリー、体格、シルエットを維持してください。リファレンス画像にない帽子、リボン、マント、杖、服装、装備を追加しないでください。同一人物の複数を表示しないでください。

背景を真っ暗にしないでください。変身の段階を飛ばさないでください。カット 3 で形成された大きな火の卵のサイズと位置を、カット 4 の開始時にも維持してください。カット 4 の開始時に卵を小さくしないでください。最後に巨大なフェニックスを明確に見せてください。暗転なし。通常のフレームで終了してください。

# タイムライン

カット 1: 0 ～ 2 秒。夜明け前の森。主人公の上半身と手。主人公は片手を前に出し、もう片方の手を重ねるように近づけ、空気と光を集めます。霧、光の粒子、落ち葉が手に引き寄せられ、指先に小さな火種が灯ります。手元のクローズアップ、45 度の角度。BGM 開始。布や装備が擦れる音、風切り音、着火音。

カット 2: 2 ～ 4.5 秒。火種が手の中に浮かびます。主人公が両手を左右に開くと、炎が鋭く横に走り、炎の帯になります。片手を上げると、炎は中心に戻り、垂直に噴き上がる炎の柱になります。水平トラッキングからティルトアップへ。火花、鋭い燃焼音、重厚な燃焼音。

カット 3: 4.5 ～ 7 秒。炎の柱が霧と木々を照らします。主人公が両手を内側に寄せると、炎が渦巻いて圧縮され、主人公の上半身と同じくらいの大きさの大きな火の卵が作られます。卵は胸から顔の高さにかけて、手の少し前に浮かびます。卵は脈動し、表面を抽象的なルーン文字が走り、最後に明確なひび割れが入ります。卵の周りを旋回。低い共鳴音。

カット 4: 7 ～ 9.5 秒。カット 3 で形成された火の卵のサイズと位置を維持した状態から開始。主人公の顔、頭、服装、手が見えます。卵は胸から顔の高さにかけて、手の少し前に大きく浮かんでいます。卵が割れ、殻が火花となって爆発します。中から小さな火の鳥が生まれます。小さな鳥は卵より明らかに小さく、卵の中心から現れ、出てきた後に主人公の手の周りを一度旋回します。主人公は驚きと喜びを感じ、両手で小さな鳥を導きます。殻が割れる音、小さな羽ばたき音。

カット 5: 9.5 ～ 12 秒。森を含むミディアムワイド。小さな火の鳥は主人公の周りを旋回しながら成長します。手のひらサイズから上半身サイズ、そして人間の胴体サイズへと大きくなります。翼と尾羽が伸び、炎の軌跡が森の中に大きな円を描きます。髪、毛皮、服装、装備、枝葉が熱風で揺れます。カメラは少し引きます。BGM はクライマックス直前まで盛り上がります。

カット 6: 12 ～ 15 秒。森の開けた場所。中サイズの火の鳥が最後の一瞬で巨大なフェニックスへと変身します。翼を広げて画面を埋め尽くし、頭を高く上げ、長い尾羽をなびかせます。火花、灰、霧、落ち葉が衝撃波のように外側へ広がります。主人公は達成感のある表情で巨大なフェニックスを見上げます。ローアングルからの見上げ。爆発的な炎の音、衝撃波、重厚な羽ばたき。翼を広げた巨大なフェニックスの通常のフレームで終了。

# 参考信息

主角 = @image1：保持面部特征、发型、发色、眼睛、皮肤/毛发纹理、服装、装备、配饰、体型、轮廓、颜色、氛围和角色身份。请勿添加参考图中不存在的服装、装备或身体特征。

# 风格

全彩日本动漫风格。华丽且具有电影感的奇幻 PV。主角在黎明前的森林中施展火魔法，火焰分阶段变化，最终召唤出巨型凤凰。

顺序固定：双手汇聚空气与光 → 火种 → 水平奔流的火焰 → 垂直喷发的火焰 → 旋转压缩 → 大型火蛋 → 蛋壳破裂 → 小火鸟 → 成长 → 巨型凤凰。请勿跳过步骤。

# 场景 / 背景

黎明前森林中的一片空地。有高大的树木、晨雾、长满苔藓的地面、潮湿的土壤、鹅卵石和树根。背景不要处理成纯黑色；要展现出蓝色森林的深度、层叠的雾气以及透过树木的晨光。地面潮湿，反射着火焰的光芒。火星、灰烬、飞舞的落叶以及无法辨认的抽象魔法符文在空中出现又消失。

# 时间 / 季节 / 天气 / 光影

清晨。晴天。起初是寒冷的蓝色暮色和雾气。当魔法开始时，火焰的暖光照亮了主角的脸部、头发/头部、服装、双手和地面。随着火焰增长，橙色和金色的光芒扩散到雾气、树干、枝叶和地面上。当巨型凤凰出现时，晨间逆光、强烈的火焰光芒、热浪以及地面的反射同时强烈呈现。

# 视觉细节 / 纹理

展现指尖、手部、服装边缘、头发/毛发、装备和配饰的纹理。头发、毛发、衣摆、织物和装饰物在热风中自然摆动。火焰从火种、水平奔流的火带、垂直喷发的火柱、旋转的火焰、脉动的大型火蛋、破裂的蛋壳、小火鸟、成长中的火鸟，最终变为巨型凤凰。最终的凤凰是一只雄伟的火鸟，具有清晰可辨的翅膀、头部、喙、胸部和尾羽。

# 镜头 / 焦点 / 构图

平均镜头长度 2-3 秒。不要在全片使用单一构图。使用手部特写、上半身、脸部与手部、包含森林的中远景，以及最后的低角度仰拍。避免正面的“力量站姿”。使用 45 度角、低角度、前景虚化和非中心构图。火焰横向奔流时使用水平追踪，垂直喷发时使用向上倾斜（tilt-up），蛋形成时使用环绕拍摄，巨型化时稍微拉远以展现规模感。

# 音频

宏大且具有电影感的奇幻 BGM。无歌词。开头神秘，中间加入弦乐和强力的打击乐，在结尾达到高潮。

音效包括织物或装备摩擦声、手部带动的风声、点火声、火焰横向奔流声、火焰喷发声、旋转燃烧声、蛋的低频共鸣声、蛋壳破裂声、小火鸟拍打翅膀的声音，以及巨型凤凰的爆炸性火焰声和沉重的拍翅声。无对话。

# 场景

在这 15 秒内，主角在森林中双手汇聚空气与光，孕育出一颗小火种。火焰横向奔流、垂直喷发，并旋转压缩成一颗大型火蛋。蛋壳破裂，诞生出一只小火鸟，它围绕着主角盘旋并不断成长。直到最后才瞬间化为巨型凤凰，张开双翼笼罩森林和主角。

# 约束条件

无字幕。屏幕内无文字。无 Logo。无可见的 UI。无可读的魔法文字。魔法符号应为抽象的符文或图案。

保持 @image1 的面部、发型、发色、眼睛、皮肤/毛发纹理、服装、装备、配饰、体型和轮廓。请勿添加参考图中不存在的帽子、丝带、斗篷、法杖、服装或装备。画面中不要出现同一个人的多个分身。

背景不要处理成纯黑色。不要跳过变形阶段。在第 4 镜开始时，保持第 3 镜形成的大型火蛋的大小和位置。第 4 镜开始时不要让蛋变小。最后要清晰展现巨型凤凰。无黑屏。以正常画面结束。

# 时间轴

A violent blizzard sweeps across the Swiss Alps beneath a glowing full moon. The camera starts with an epic aerial shot of endless snow-covered peaks before descending into a frozen pine forest. A lone hunter in a weathered leather coat and fur-lined hood kneels beside enormous wolf footprints—far larger than any ordinary wolf. He brushes snow away from the tracks, realizing they are fresh. He loads a single silver bullet into his antique rifle, lifts an oil lantern, and steps into the darkness. The icy wind whistles through the trees, and a distant wolf howl echoes across the mountains.

The hunter reaches a frozen cliff overlooking the valley. Standing silently on the edge is a majestic white wolf, illuminated by cold moonlight. Its thick fur moves naturally in the wind, and its glowing blue eyes lock onto the hunter. Instead of attacking, the wolf slowly turns and walks toward a hidden mountain pass, pausing several times to look back as if guiding him. The hunter lowers his rifle and follows through a narrow canyon where ancient stone carvings, half-buried in snow, hint at a forgotten civilization.

Scene 3 (7–11 sec) – The Awakening
The wolf stops before a colossal glacier. Silence fills the valley. Suddenly the ground begins to shake violently. Massive cracks race across the frozen mountain, glowing with blue energy beneath the ice. Entire sections of the glacier collapse with thunderous force. From deep beneath the ice, an enormous stone hand slowly pushes through the glacier. Snow avalanches down the cliffs as the hunter stumbles backward in disbelief. The wolf stands perfectly still, staring at the awakening giant without fear.

Scene 4 (11–15 sec) – The Guardian's Truth
The hunter instinctively raises his rifle toward the emerging giant. Before he can pull the trigger, the white wolf steps directly in front of him, shielding the mountain. Time seems to slow. The hunter looks into the wolf's calm blue eyes and realizes the truth—it was never leading him to prey, but protecting an ancient guardian imprisoned beneath the Alps. Suddenly, two gigantic glowing blue eyes open inside the mountain. A deep roar echoes through the valley as snow erupts into the air. prompt: This is handheld documentary footage recorded on an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder by someone moving through NASA Mission Control in Houston during the Apollo 11 moon landing, July 20, 1969. The footage feels like real, imperfect home video, captured in quick, energetic bursts as the camera operator moves through the room chasing the action.  The recording opens weaving fast between rows of consoles, engineers leaning into their screens, hands flying across switches and dials. The camera cuts and whips between different stations: one engineer pounding a fist lightly on the desk in tense anticipation, another leaning back rubbing his eyes, a cluster of three men huddled around a single console pointing at data readouts. Headsets crackle, papers shuffle, someone stands up abruptly and the camera swings to follow him as he strides toward the front of the room.  The camera pushes closer to the huge front display, a grainy black-and-white schematic tracking the lunar module's descent, numbers ticking down. It cuts to a side console screen showing a wavering, static-streaked video feed, distorted with transmission noise, rolling scan lines, and intermittent signal dropout, the faint outline of an astronaut visible through the interference. The room erupts in scattered movement, people standing, leaning in, someone shouting numbers, another slapping a colleague's shoulder.  The camera pushes in tight on that noisy screen, the image glitching, static rolling, the picture briefly cutting to black before flickering back. As it pushes closer the transmission noise and scan lines intensify, filling the frame, and then the image resolves outward into full clarity: the camera is no longer looking at a screen at all but is suddenly standing on the lunar surface itself, the horizon curving under a black sky, harsh sunlight casting long shadows across the grey dust, the astronaut now filmed directly, boots kicking up slow-falling regolith with each step.  The handheld camera throughout Mission Control shows constant whip-pans, fast walking shake, quick rack-focus misses, autofocus hunting between bright screens and dim room lighting, lens flare from overhead fluorescents, and typical DV camcorder imperfections — grain, motion blur on fast cuts, and audio clipping from raised voices. Once the footage transitions to the lunar surface, the camera motion changes entirely: slow, floating, low-gravity movement, sudden gentle bounces as if the person filming is also moving in reduced gravity, dust hanging oddly in the air, harsh contrast between blinding sunlight and pitch-black shadow, and the same DV grain and imperfections carried over as though it's the same tape.  Natural sound only: on Earth, the hum of electronics, overlapping headset chatter, static bursts, shouted numbers, footsteps, and papers rustling; transitioning into muffled radio-static breathing sounds

prompt:
CAMERA / LOOK: Handheld mini DV camcorder footage filmed by the subject herself. Slight hand shake, occasional focus hunting, imperfect framing, natural zoom adjustments, soft tape-like image quality, subtle grain, realistic auto-exposure shifts from indoor evening lighting.

STYLE: Cozy plant-care vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments. Focus on satisfying sounds: soil scooping, pot scraping, water pouring, leaves rustling, scissors snipping, gloves being pulled on.

SUBJECT: Young man in his mid-20s, casual t-shirt, rolled-up sleeves, apron, tousled hair. Calm, content energy while tending to plants.
SETTING: Small balcony/kitchen corner on a quiet evening. Warm hanging light, small table covered in newspaper, terracotta pots, bags of soil, watering can.
STORYBOARD:
→ (2s, propped medium shot) Places camera on shelf, sits at the table. "Time to repot a couple of my plants."
→ (2s, overhead shot) Scoops soil into a fresh pot. Only soil and scooping sounds.
→ (2s, close-up) Gently loosens plant roots from old pot. Soft rustling.
→ (2s, handheld shot) Holds two pots side by side, deciding. "This one's definitely outgrown its home."
→ (2s, detail shot) Trims a few dry leaves with small scissors. No dialogue.
→ (2s, medium shot) Pats soil down around the base of the plant. "There, much better."
→ (2s, macro shot) Label tag being written and pushed into soil. Pen and paper sounds only.
→ (2s, propped shot) Waters the plant slowly, water sound clear and steady.
→ (2s, warm ending shot) Steps back, admires the row of freshly potted plants. "I love how this corner is coming together."
→ (1.5s, final shot) Walks toward camera, reaches for the lens. "Catch you next time." Hand covers lens as recording ends.

AUDIO NOTES: Natural ambience soil, water pouring, scissors, leaf rustling, footsteps should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual.

REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine smiles, occasional thinking pauses, realistic small mistakes (soil spill, leaf drop), imperfect framing, focus breathing, warm evening lighting. Should feel like a real personal plant vlog on a consumer camcorder, not AI-generated or commercial.

prompt:
Create a clean, premium storyboard infographic for a product ASMR unboxing video.

Design specifications:

White background with a modern, minimalist layout.

Title at the top:

STORYBOARD

Product name in bold green (replace with: [PRODUCT NAME])

Subtitle: ASMR UNBOXING

Include four information boxes below the title:

Duration: 30 Seconds

Style: POV Hands, ASMR

Audience: 18–35 years old

Audio Suggestion: Soft ASMR • Crinkles • Tapping • Pouring

Create 12 storyboard panels arranged in a 3-column × 4-row grid.

Each panel should contain:

A numbered green badge (1–12)

Timestamp (0–2.5s, 2.5–5s, etc.)

A realistic cinematic image showing the scene

Handwritten white doodle text like:

TA-DA!

POP!

WOW!

PICK!

CRINKLE~

TEAR!

POUR~

HOT WATER

STIR~

SMOOTH!

BEST!

Three text sections below every image:

VISUAL:

ACTION:

DIALOGUE:

Use realistic product photography, warm wooden table, soft natural lighting, shallow depth of field, POV hands only (no face visible), premium commercial advertising style.

Storyboard sequence:

1 (0–2.5s) Visual: Product box on wooden table. Action: Hands enter frame and point to the box. Dialogue: "Have you tried this before?"

2 (2.5–5s) Visual: Opening the box. Action: Lift the top flap slowly. Dialogue: "Let's unbox it together."

3 (5–7.5s) Visual: Multiple individual sachets neatly arranged. Action: Fully reveal the inside. Dialogue: "Wow, look how many!"

4 (7.5–10s) Visual: Pick up one sachet. Action: Remove a single stick pack. Dialogue: "Let's start with one."

5 (10–12.5s) Visual: Close-up of sachet. Action: Hold and gently crinkle it. Dialogue: "That crinkle sound is satisfying."

6 (12.5–15s) Visual: Tear open the top. Action: Slow ASMR tearing. Dialogue: "Just a small tear."

7 (15–17.5s) Visual: Powder visible inside. Action: Show the powder close-up. Dialogue: "Looks delicious."

8 (17.5–20s) Visual: Pour powder into mug. Action: Slow pouring. Dialogue: "Pour everything in."

9 (20–22.5s) Visual: Hot water being poured. Action: Steam visible. Dialogue: "Add hot water."

10 (22.5–25s) Visual: Stir drink. Action: Slow circular stirring. Dialogue: "Mix it well."

11 (25–27.5s) Visual: Finished drink. Action: Show creamy texture from above. Dialogue: "Looks smooth and creamy."

12 (27.5–30s) Visual: Product box beside finished drink with thumbs up. Action: Hand gives thumbs up. Dialogue: "Easy, delicious, and ready!"

Footer:

Total Duration: 30 Seconds

Format: Vertical (9:16)

Style: POV Hands, ASMR Unboxing

Typography should resemble a professional creative agency storyboard, with clean spacing, green accents, rounded panel borders, and high-end presentation suitable for client pitches.

prompt:
Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9.

Night. High above a neon city, one female agent escapes across the upper levels of an unfinished skyscraper during a storm. She runs across wet steel beams and exposed concrete toward the outer edge of the construction site while security chases behind her. A giant crane towers overhead, its heavy hook and cable swinging violently in the wind between this tower and a second unfinished skyscraper nearby. Rain lashes the structure, warning lights blink red, and the city glows far below through mist.

Wide opening shot: the female agent sprints across the unfinished floor of the skyscraper while security appears behind her, closing in through the steel framework. The crane hook swings overhead in the storm.  Tracking shot: she runs across a narrow beam and leaps onto a small platform near the edge of the building. Wind whips her hair and clothing. The crane cable swings closer, and she times her move while the storm grows more violent.

Side shot: the agent grabs the swinging crane hook or cable and is pulled out into open air between the two skyscrapers. She swings across the gap high above the city while rain, wind, and flashing warning lights intensify the danger. Security reaches the edge behind her but cannot follow.

Final 5 seconds: the action becomes more intense. The swing carries her toward the second unfinished tower. She crashes feet-first into the outer framework, struggles for a split second to hold on, then pulls herself onto a narrow beam or platform. The crane hook swings away behind her as she regains balance and keeps moving forward.

Final moment: the female agent lands on the second skyscraper structure and turns briefly as the crane continues swinging behind her in the storm, with the neon skyline far below.

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, fast-paced, intense, stressful, clear readable action, strong sense of height, storm, rain, steel beams, swinging crane hook, dynamic but readable camera movement, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no famous celebrity faces, no recognizable actors, no movie-star resemblance, no public-figure likenesses, no clear facial close-ups. Keep proportions. Keep style and features. Aspect ratio 16:9.

ショット 5 (虚無のステップ): 次のステップの位置には何もない。彼女はまず空中に足を踏み出し、光の床を召喚する。一瞬の判断に緊張が高まる。

prompt:
This is handheld documentary footage recorded on an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder from the streets of Pompeii at the moment Mount Vesuvius begins erupting. The footage feels like real, imperfect home video of ordinary people witnessing the beginning of a historic disaster.

The recording shows a busy street in Pompeii during the daytime, with merchants, families, children, laborers, and townspeople moving through the city. In the distance, Mount Vesuvius is visible above the rooftops. At first, people are going about normal daily life, but then a strange plume of smoke and ash begins rising from the volcano. The crowd gradually notices it. Some people stop and stare, some point toward the mountain, and others begin shouting to one another in confusion.

The camera moves through the street like someone in the crowd trying to capture what is happening. It shows frightened townspeople looking up at the sky, parents pulling children closer, merchants abandoning their stalls, and groups of people beginning to run as ash starts falling. The footage captures the shift from curiosity to fear as the eruption becomes impossible to ignore. There are natural cuts between wider views of the street, the mountain in the distance, and closer views of people reacting in panic.

The handheld camera shows natural shake, drifting framing, sudden reactive movement, autofocus mistakes as the person filming swings between the crowd and the volcano, slight exposure problems from bright daylight and ash in the air, and the imperfect look of old DV footage. The movement should feel urgent and unplanned, like someone trying to document the disaster while also staying safe.

Natural sound only: the noise of the street, footsteps on stone, people murmuring and then shouting, children crying, distant rumbling from the volcano, debris falling, and the panic of the crowd. No cinematic music added.

The result must feel like authentic, raw footage of ordinary people in Pompeii experiencing the beginning of the eruption of Mount Vesuvius, captured on an old DV camcorder.

旁白：“那晚的雨下得太久，久到我以为它永远不会停。”

STYLE: Cozy skincare vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments. Focus on satisfying sounds: bottle caps popping, cotton pad taps, water splashing, jar lids twisting, soft patting sounds.
SUBJECT: Young woman in her early 20s, hair wrapped in a soft headband, oversized robe, no makeup, relaxed expression. Calm, unwinding energy before bed.
SETTING: Small bathroom vanity area at night. Warm vanity lights, neatly arranged skincare bottles, mirror, soft quiet atmosphere.

→ (2s, propped medium shot) Places camera on the vanity shelf, sits down. "Time for my nighttime routine."
→ (2s, overhead shot) Pours cleanser onto palms, lathers gently.
→ (2s, close-up) Splashes face with water, pats dry with a towel.
→ (2s, handheld shot) Holds up a toner bottle, pours onto a cotton pad. "This one's been my favorite lately."
→ (2s, detail shot) Applies serum with gentle patting motions. No dialogue.
→ (2s, medium shot) Twists open a moisturizer jar, scoops a small amount. "Almost done."
→ (2s, macro shot) Applies lip balm, sets it back on the shelf.
→ (2s, propped shot) Brushes hair gently in front of the mirror.
→ (2s, warm ending shot) Looks at reflection, relaxed smile. "Ready for bed now."
→ (1.5s, final shot) Turns toward camera, reaches for the lens. "Goodnight." Hand covers lens as recording ends.
AUDIO NOTES: Natural bathroom ambience bottle caps, water splashing, patting sounds should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual, almost a whisper.

[00:00-00:03] Shot 1: Floating over Red Outback

Scene: The protagonist, wearing original clothes, is suspended over a red rock desert. A drone selfie perspective shoots from diagonally above. The protagonist's arms are stretched out, looking up at the camera with a bright smile, hair and hemline continuously blown by strong winds.

Transition 2 (Hand Lens Cover): The protagonist smiles and reaches toward the camera, the palm completely covering the lens—the moment the hand is withdrawn, the outfit and scene have changed, the arm still naturally lowering while maintaining the extended posture.

Audio: Sea of clouds wind, music progresses.

[00:06-00:09] Shot 3: Cliff Coast Glide

Scene: Light purple spaghetti strap ruffled dress, purple hair accessory—the protagonist is suspended over a giant turquoise sea cliff and deep blue bay, spreading arms like gliding, the skirt fluttering in layers, the camera slowly circling.

Transition 3 (Spin Defocus Match): The protagonist swings arms and begins to turn, the person gradually becomes out of focus and blurred in the frame; when focus is restored, the outfit and scene have changed, and the turning motion continues seamlessly to completion.

Audio: Faint sea breeze and waves, music expands.

[00:09-00:12] Shot 4: Ocean Sunset Finale

Scene: Mint green off-the-shoulder knit cardigan, pink checkered pleated miniskirt, white sneakers—after completing the turn, the protagonist is suspended over the boundless ocean, in a leaping posture with one leg kicked back against the sunset. The sun bursts with golden flares overhead, the sea surface glitters with broken gold light, seagulls fly below, and the camera slowly zooms out to freeze.

The three transition mechanisms are different and must be strictly executed: (1) Camera tilts up to the sky then down (sky is the shared frame for both scenes) (2) Palm covers the lens then withdraws (reaching motion is continuous across the cut point) (3) Character defocuses on the spot then refocused (turning motion is continuous across the cut point)—all hard cuts and dissolves are prohibited; 3. prompt:
参照画像のキャラクターを主人公として使用してください。15 秒、24fps。日本のアニメ調フルカラー。劇場版アニメレベルの圧倒的な作画クオリティ。滑らかで自然なアニメーションのための非常に高い枚数。線画は繊細でクリア。ノイズや粒子感は一切なく、美しいセルルックスタイル。柔らかな陰影、鮮やかな色彩、透明感のあるライティング、髪の揺れや衣装の自然な物理演算。

キャラクター:
主人公は参照画像のキャラクターです。参照画像の顔立ち、目、髪型、髪色、体型、衣装、アクセサリー、年齢、雰囲気を忠実に維持してください。プロのアイドルではなく、「放課後に TikTok を撮っているクラスで一番可愛い子」のような自然な可愛さ。撮影に対して少し恥ずかしがっている様子。ダンスの途中で時折見せる照れ笑いや、一瞬視線を逸らしてからカメラを見返す仕草。最後は少し赤ら顔で微笑みます。

背景:
放課後の明るい教室。他に誰もいない状態。温かみのある夕日。ポップで爽やか。人物が最も引き立つ背景。

音楽:
オリジナルの日本風ポップソング。実在の楽曲は禁止。テンポは約 140 BPM。可愛い女性ボーカル。サビに焦点を当てる。

ダンス:
TikTok で真似したくなるようなダンス。全身を大きく動かすよりも、上半身の可愛い動きに集中してください。胸の前でハート、指ハート、頬でピースサイン、投げキッス、指差し、ウィンク、肩のバウンド、軽い腰の揺れ、左右のステップ、小さなターン、耳に髪をかける仕草、前髪を触る仕草、スカートが少し揺れる動き、カメラに近づく動き。最後は照れ笑いで締めくくります。

演技:
ここが最も重要です。ダンスは上手ですが、完璧ではありません。少し恥ずかしそうで、笑い出しそうな様子。恥ずかしさで口元を軽く覆う。頬は少し赤い。途中で照れ笑い。最後だけ恥ずかしそうなウィンク。「恥ずかしいけれど一生懸命撮った」という雰囲気。

カメラ構成:
5 台のカメラで撮影しているような構成。2 秒ごとにカメラが切り替わります。使用するカメラ：正面、真上、左 45 度、右 45 度、背面。カメラは完全に固定せず、ビートに合わせて軽い上下のバウンド、パンチイン、左右の小さな動きを加えます。主人公はどのカメラでも常にレンズを意識しています。正面以外のアングルでは、顔だけを自然にレンズに向けます。背面カメラでは、肩越しに振り返って笑顔でアイコンタクトを取ります。

AE スタイルエフェクト:
画面は常に賑やかです。After Effects で作成したような 2D フラットアニメーション。クレヨン、オイルパステル、色鉛筆、手描き感。動きにはバウンド、ポップ、回転、スケール、スプリング、フェード、ワイプ、追従、リピートを含めます。人物の動きと完全に同期させます。

エフェクト要素:
ハート、星、花、王冠、音符、リボン、紙吹雪、キラキラ、矢印、吹き出し、手描きの丸、手描きの四角、波線、渦巻き線、チェック、ストライプ、ドット、ハーフトーン、落書き風の笑顔、稲妻、カラフルなブラシストローク、ステッカー風のポップアップ、手描きのスピード線、ハイライトフラッシュ、可愛い火花、パステルカラーの煙、リズム線、ビートサークル、ジャンプする星、漫画風の集中線。すべて 2D。人物の前後のレイヤーに自然に配置。顔を隠さないこと。

カラー:
ピンク、ライトブルー、ラベンダー、ミント、イエロー、ホワイト、パステルオレンジ。

タイムライン:
0～3 秒: 恥ずかしがりながらダンス開始。ハート多め。パンチイン。エフェクト密度は中程度。
3～6 秒: メインダンス。画面全体に星、花、リボン。リズミカルなカメラ切り替え。エフェクト密度は中程度。
6～9 秒: サビ。エフェクト密度は最大。
9～12 秒: 主人公が微笑み始める。途中で照れ笑い。視線を逸らしてカメラを見返す。エフェクト密度は中程度。
12～15 秒: 最後のポーズ。ウィンク。最後の照れ笑い。画面全体にハートとキラキラが広がる。エフェクト密度は最大。

制約事項:
主人公以外の人物は表示しないこと。衣装チェンジなし。他のキャラクターへの変身なし。顔立ちの変更なし。テキスト、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは一切なし。過度なグリッチなし。火や爆発なし。実写風のエフェクトなし。顔を隠すエフェクトなし。可愛さ、テンポ、TikTok の雰囲気を最優先すること。

variants.text:
请使用参考图中的角色作为主角。15 秒，24fps。日式全彩动漫风格。达到剧场版动画级别的极致画质。极高的帧数以实现流畅自然的动画效果。线条细腻清晰。无任何颗粒感或噪点，呈现精美的赛璐珞风格。柔和的阴影、鲜艳的色彩、通透的灯光，以及头发摆动和服装的自然物理效果。

角色：
主角为参考图中的角色。忠实还原参考图中的面部特征、眼睛、发型、发色、体型、服装、配饰、年龄和氛围。不是专业偶像，而是展现出“放学后拍 TikTok 的班级可爱女生”那种自然的可爱感。对拍摄感到有些害羞和尴尬。跳舞时偶尔露出羞涩的微笑，或短暂地移开视线后再看向镜头。最后带着微红的脸颊微笑。

背景：
放学后明亮的教室。没有其他人。温暖的夕阳。流行且清新。背景应能最大程度突出人物主体。

音乐：
原创日语流行歌曲。禁止使用真实歌曲。节奏约为 140 BPM。可爱的女声。重点突出副歌部分。

舞蹈：
让人想在 TikTok 上模仿的舞蹈。不要大幅度移动全身，重点在于上半身可爱的动作。胸前比心、手指比心、脸颊比耶、飞吻、指镜头、眨眼、抖肩、轻微扭胯、左右踏步、小转身、撩发到耳后、触碰刘海、裙摆微动的动作、靠近镜头的动作。最后以羞涩的微笑结束。

表演：
这是最重要的一点。擅长跳舞，但并不完美。看起来有点尴尬。快要笑场。因害羞而短暂遮住嘴巴。脸颊微红。中间露出羞涩的微笑。仅在最后眨眼。营造出一种“虽然很害羞，但我尽力拍摄了”的氛围。

摄像机构图：
如同使用 5 台摄像机拍摄的构图。每 2 秒切换一次镜头。使用的镜头：正面、正上方、左 45°、右 45°、后方。摄像机并非完全固定，而是随着节奏进行轻微的垂直跳动、推近和左右小幅移动。主角在每个镜头中都时刻意识到镜头的存在。除正面外的角度，自然地仅将脸转向镜头。后方镜头时，回头越过肩膀并微笑对视。

AE 风格特效：
画面始终充满活力。类似 After Effects 制作的 2D 平面动画。蜡笔、油画棒、彩色铅笔、手绘质感。动作包括弹跳、弹出、旋转、缩放、弹簧、淡入淡出、擦除、跟随、重复。与人物动作完全同步。

特效元素：
爱心、星星、花朵、皇冠、音符、丝带、纸屑、闪光、箭头、对话框、手绘圆圈、手绘方块、波浪线、漩涡线、格纹、条纹、圆点、半色调、涂鸦风笑脸、闪电、彩色笔触、贴纸风弹出效果、手绘速度线、高光闪烁、可爱火花、粉彩烟雾、节奏线、节拍圆圈、跳跃星星、漫画风聚焦线。全部为 2D。自然地放置在人物的前后图层中。不要遮挡面部。

色彩：
粉色、浅蓝色、薰衣草紫、薄荷绿、黄色、白色、粉橙色。

时间轴：
0–3 秒：害羞地开始跳舞。大量爱心。镜头推近。中等特效密度。
3–6 秒：主舞部分。屏幕中布满星星、花朵和丝带。节奏感镜头切换。中等特效密度。
6–9 秒：副歌。最高特效密度。
9–12 秒：主角开始微笑。中间露出羞涩的微笑。移开视线后再看向镜头。中等特效密度。
12–15 秒：最终定格姿势。眨眼。最后的羞涩微笑。爱心和闪光布满屏幕。最高特效密度。

限制条件：
不要出现主角以外的任何人。不要更换服装。不要变身为其他角色。不要改变面部特征。不要出现文字、字幕、Logo 或水印。不要出现过度的故障效果。不要出现火或爆炸。不要使用真人实拍风格的特效。不要使用遮挡面部的特效。优先考虑可爱感、节奏感和 TikTok 氛围。

Use the character from the reference image as the protagonist. 15 seconds, 24fps. Japanese full-color anime. Overwhelming drawing quality at the level of a theatrical anime. Extremely high number of drawings for smooth and natural animation. Line art is delicate and clear. No grain or noise at all, beautiful cel-shaded style. Soft shading, vibrant colors, transparent lighting, and natural physics for hair swaying and costumes.

Character:
The protagonist is the character from the reference image. Faithfully maintain the facial features, eyes, hairstyle, hair color, physique, outfit, accessories, age, and atmosphere from the reference image. Not a professional idol, but a natural cuteness like "the cutest girl in class taking a TikTok after school." A bit shy and embarrassed about the filming. Occasionally shows a shy smile during the dance, or looks away for a moment before looking back at the camera. Finally smiles while blushing slightly.

Background:
A bright classroom after school. No one else is there. Warm sunset. Pop and refreshing. A background where the person stands out most.

Music:
Original Japanese pop song. Real songs are prohibited. Tempo is about 140 BPM. Cute female vocals. Focus on the chorus.

Dance:
A dance that makes people want to imitate on TikTok. Rather than moving the whole body largely, focus on cute movements of the upper body. Heart in front of chest, finger heart, cheek peace sign, blowing a kiss, pointing, winking, bouncing shoulders, light hip swaying, left and right steps, small turns, tucking hair behind the ear, touching bangs, movement where the skirt sways slightly, movement like approaching the camera. Acting:
This is the most important part. Good at dancing, but not perfect. Looks a bit embarrassed. About to laugh. Briefly covers mouth in embarrassment. Cheeks are slightly red. Shy smile in the middle. Shy wink only at the end. An atmosphere of "I'm embarrassed but I tried my best to film this."

Camera Composition:
A composition as if filming with 5 cameras. Cameras switch every 2 seconds. Cameras to use: Front, directly above, 45° left, 45° right, behind. Cameras are not completely fixed but perform light vertical bounces, punch-ins, and small left-right movements to the beat. The protagonist is always conscious of the lens in every camera. For angles other than the front, naturally turn only the face toward the lens. For the rear camera, look back over the shoulder and make eye contact with a smile.

AE-style Effects:
The screen is always lively. 2D flat animation like something made in After Effects. Crayon, oil pastel, colored pencil, hand-drawn feel. Movements include bounce, pop, rotate, scale, spring, fade, wipe, follow, repeat. Completely synchronized with the person's movements.

3–6s: Main dance. Stars, flowers, and ribbons throughout the screen. Rhythmic camera switching. Medium effect density.

prompt:
[主人公] 黒髪のボブカットをした小学 2 年生の女の子。
[舞台] シャッターが閉まった商店街。
[ギミック] 送電線。

[動画スタイル]
15 秒。日本のアニメーション（フルカラー）。5 億円規模の予算を投じた高密度な 2D アニメーション。緻密な背景美術、滑らかな中割り、映画クオリティのポストプロセッシング。構図、カメラアングル、画面サイズ、キャラクターとの距離を変化させ、単調にならないよう魅力的に展開すること。字幕なし、ウォーターマークなし、BGM なし。環境音を含めること。

[視覚構成] 夜霧が街を飲み込み、街灯が次々と消えていく。主人公はスケートのように送電線を滑走し、線から線へと飛び移りながら移動する。滑走後、街の明かりが順に灯り、光の軌跡を足場にして途切れた箇所を飛び越えていく。

[ハイライト（ショット 5〜7 のどこかに必ず含めること）] 滑走によって生じた火花が、消えていた街灯に順次飛び移り、商店街を貫く一本の光の線を描き出す。

ショット 1（滑走開始）：シャッターが閉まった商店街。主人公が送電線を滑走し、靴の裏から光の尾を引く。風を切る爽快な表情。
ショット 2（霧）：眼下の街が夜霧に飲み込まれ、街灯が次々と消える。主人公の瞳には静かな決意が宿る。
ショット 3（ジャンプ）：送電線から送電線へジャンプ。移動するたびに光の尾の色が変わり、足場からは弦を弾くような音が鳴る。軽やかで正確な動き。
ショット 4（低姿勢）：長い直線を低姿勢で加速。夜風と光が頬を流れる。集中した真剣な横顔。
ショット 5（復旧）：滑走の後、消えていた街の明かりが順に灯っていく。主人公の口元には小さな笑みが浮かぶ。
ショット 6（途切れ）：足場が途切れた箇所を、光の軌跡だけを頼りに飛び越える。息を呑むような緊張の瞬間。
ショット 7（パトロール）：高い場所に降り立ち、復旧した街の明かりを見下ろして誇らしげに「ただのパトロールだよ」とつぶやく。

variants.text:
[主角] 一位留着黑色波波头的二年级小学生。
[场景] 卷帘门紧闭的商业街。
[噱头] 电线。

[视频风格]
15 秒。日本全彩动漫。高密度 2D 动画，制作预算相当于 5 亿日元。精细的背景美术、流畅的中间画以及电影级的后期处理。通过变换构图、摄像机角度、画面尺寸和角色距离来吸引观众，避免重复相似的画面。无字幕，无水印，无背景音乐。包含环境音。

[视觉构图] 夜雾吞噬了城镇，灯光逐一熄灭。主角像滑冰一样在电线上滑行，并通过在电线间跳跃来移动。滑行过后，城镇的灯光依次恢复，并利用光迹作为落脚点跨越断层。

[高光时刻（必须包含在第 5-7 镜中）] 滑行产生的火花依次跳跃到熄灭的路灯上，在商业街中划出一条光线。

第 1 镜（滑行切入）：卷帘门紧闭的商业街。主角沿着电线滑行，鞋底拖曳出光芒。她穿过风时表情兴奋。
第 2 镜（迷雾）：下方的城镇被夜雾吞噬，灯光逐一熄灭。主角眼中流露出沉静的决心。
第 3 镜（跳跃）：在电线之间跳跃。每次移动时，光尾的颜色都会改变，落脚的声音如同琴弦。动作轻盈而精准。
第 4 镜（低姿态）：在长直线上以低姿态加速。夜风与光流掠过她的脸颊。专注而严肃的侧脸。
第 5 镜（恢复）：滑行过后，熄灭的城镇灯光依次恢复。主角嘴角露出一抹浅笑。
第 6 镜（断层）：跨越落脚点的断层，仅以光迹作为平台。屏住呼吸的紧张瞬间。

prompt:
[基本仕様] 1:1 のスクエア比率、15 秒間、実写、参照画像なし。明るい白砂のビーチでの 2 対 2 の女子ビーチバレー。相手のジャンプサーブから始まり、自チームのレシーブ、トス、スパイク、そして相手のダイビングレシーブ失敗までの一連のラリーを描写。高品質な実写スポーツ映画スタイル。動画全体を通して、待ち時間や位置調整、長い助走、長い滞空時間、不要な間を排除し、速いリアルタイムの競技テンポで進行する。各カットはアクションがすでに進行している状態から開始する。

[キャラクター] 20 代前半の外国人女性アスリート 4 名。健康的で引き締まった体格、自然で魅力的な顔立ち、リアルな肌と髪の質感。顔や髪型が同一であったり、無機質な CG のような顔にならないようにする。自チームはコバルトブルーと白の無地のウェアを着用。メインのアタッカーは、ダークブラウンの肌で、細い三つ編みを高く結い上げた長身の黒人女性。メインのセッターは、明るいブロンドヘアを低い位置で一本に三つ編みにした小柄な白人女性。相手チームはコーラルレッドと黒の無地のウェアを着用。ジャンプサーブを打つのは、日焼けした肌でポニーテールのブルネットの女性。最後のダイビングレシーブを行うのは、色白で長い三つ編みをした赤毛の女性。4 名のアスリートの容姿、服装、役割を最後まで維持する。

[コートの配置] 自チームを手前（フォアグラウンド）、相手チームを奥（バックグラウンド）に配置。ネットは中央を水平に横切る。相手のサーバーは奥のコートのエンドライン後方からサーブし、ボールは奥から手前へ飛ぶ。レシーブとトスは手前のコートで行い、スパイクは手前から奥へ飛び、最後のダイブは奥のコートで行う。この空間関係を逆転させないこと。

[カメラの原則] 冒頭のみ、コート全体と両エンドラインを見せる大胆な俯瞰（オーバーヘッド）ショットを使用する。それ以降は、安定した斜めからのワイドショットおよびミディアムショットを基本とする。カメラは 180 度ラインを越えたり、ネットの反対側に回り込んだりしてはならない。超広角、魚眼レンズ、ボール視点、ボールを追従するカメラ、急激なプッシュイン、足の裏のクローズアップ、巨大化したボールの描写は禁止。太陽そのものは映さず、攻撃中のみ柔らかな逆光を使用する。

[タイム構成]
0.0～0.8 秒：大胆な俯瞰ショット。コート全体、両エンドライン、中央のネット、手前の自チーム 2 名、奥の相手チーム 2 名を明確に映す。奥のエンドライン後方にいるブルネットの選手は、最初のフレームの時点でジャンプサーブの助走を開始していること。静止画のような描写にしない。
0.8～2.8 秒：安定した高い位置からの斜めワイドショットへハードカット。サーバーのトスが上がっている状態から開始し、助走、ジャンプ、打撃までを一気に映す。すべてのアクションは速い通常速度で行い、インパクトの瞬間にスローモーションにしない。カメラは正しいサーブ位置と選手の全身を維持し、打たれたボールは奥から手前へ高速で飛ぶ。
2.8～5.2 秒：手前コートを見下ろす安定した斜めワイドショット。カット開始時にボールはすでに手前コートに近づいており、黒人のアタッカーがレシーブ位置へ移動している。彼女は即座に低く正確なレシーブを行い、ブロンドのセッターは待機することなくボールの下へ移動し、高いトスを上げる。レシーバー、セッター、ボールを同一フレーム内に収める。全編通常速度。
5.2～8.0 秒：手前コートサイドからのミディアムワイドショット。黒人のアタッカーは静止状態からではなく、ネットに向かう最後の 2～3 歩の助走の途中で現れる。ブロンドのセッターは背景に残る。アタッカーの全身、ネット、トスされたボールを同時に映し、短くスムーズな水平トラッキングのみを行う。通常速度。
8.0～10.4 秒：同じカメラ軸上の低い位置からのミディアムショットへハードカット。黒人のアタッカーがジャンプし、奥のコートへ鋭いスパイクを打ち込む。太陽を映さずに、髪と体の輪郭に柔らかな逆光を当てる。スパイクは実際の競技の速い通常速度で描写する。ボールは手前から奥へ飛ぶこと。
10.4～15.0 秒：同じ手前側のカメラ軸から、望遠レンズのような感覚で奥のコートを捉えた安定したミディアムショット。カット開始時に、赤毛のレシーバーはすでに落下地点に向かって走っており、片腕を前方に伸ばして低くダイブしている。極端な手のクローズアップは避け、選手の上半身、伸ばした腕、開いた手、ボール 1 個、砂の表面を同一フレーム内に収める。ボールに向かって伸ばした手は、最初の視認から最後まで同じ形状を維持する。拳を握ったり、手のひらを砂に向けたりせず、5 本の指を自然にまっすぐ、わずかに広げた状態にする。拳、掴む動作、曲がった指、パンチのような形、前腕を揃えたレシーブ姿勢は禁止。ダイブの大部分は通常速度。最後の 0.4～0.6 秒間のみ、開いた指先がボールに触れそうで触れない瞬間をスローモーションにする。ボールは止まらず、指先の数センチ前を通過して斜め下に落ちる。手のひら、指、拳、腕への接触は一切なし。ボールは砂に一度だけ当たる。ボールが砂に最初に触れた瞬間に動画を終了する。バウンド、砂煙、得点後の歓喜、ガッツポーズ、立ち上がる動作などは含めない。

[速度設計] 動画全体を通して速いリアルタイムの競技テンポを維持する。スローモーションは、指先がボールに届かない最後の 0.4～0.6 秒間のみ使用する。ジャンプサーブ、レシーブ、トス、助走、スパイク、ボールの落下、ダイブの開始はすべて通常速度。各カットで待ち時間や長いポーズを入れず、動画全体をスローモーション風にしない。

[一貫性] 常に 2 対 2 のプレイヤーとボール 1 個を維持する。人物の増殖、消失、融合、役割の入れ替わり、顔や髪の変化、余分な手足、長い滞空時間、ボールの複製、サイズ変更、停止、瞬間移動を避ける。サーバーは常に奥のコートのエンドライン後方にいる。レシーブとトスは手前コート、スパイクは手前から奥へ、最後のダイブは奥のコートで行う。最後のショットでは、赤毛のレシーバーの上半身、腕、開いた手、ボール 1 個、砂の表面を同一フレーム内に維持する。

[禁止事項] 実在のブランド、企業ロゴ、スポンサー、看板、放送局のロゴ、スコア表示、ウォーターマーク、字幕、読み取れるテキスト、チーム名、背番号、実在のアスリートの再現は禁止。ウェア、ボール、ネット、支柱、用具は無地でブランドロゴのないものを使用する。ボールにテキスト、ロゴ、シンボル、ブランドのような模様を入れてはならない。魚眼レンズの歪み、ネットを越えるカメラワーク、手前と奥の逆転、動画全編のスローモーション、ボールの複製、極端な手のクローズアップ、拳を握る動作、掴む動作、曲がった指、負けた側の歓喜の描写は禁止。

variants.text:
[基本规格] 1:1 正方形，15 秒，真人实拍，无参考图。明亮洁白沙滩上的 2 对 2 女子沙滩排球。单次拉锯战，描绘对手跳发球，随后是主队接球、二传、扣球，以及对手扑救失败。高质量真人体育电影风格。整个视频以快速的实时竞技节奏进行；无等待、无重新站位、无长助跑、无长滞空或不必要的拖沓。每个镜头剪辑时动作均已在进行中。

[角色] 四名年轻的外国女性运动员。健康、结实的运动体格，自然且有吸引力的面部特征，写实的皮肤和头发。无长相雷同、发型一致或非自然的 CG 面孔。主队身穿纯钴蓝色和白色装备。主攻手是一名高挑的黑人女性，深棕色皮肤，扎着高束细辫。主二传手是一名娇小的白人女性，浅金色头发，扎着低单辫。对手队身穿纯珊瑚红色和黑色装备。跳发球手是一名棕发女性，肤色黝黑，扎着马尾辫。最后扑救者是一名白皙的红发女性，扎着长单辫。在视频结束前，需保持四名运动员的外貌、服装和角色一致。

[场地坐标] 主队位于近场，对手队位于远场。球网横跨在中间。对手发球手在远场底线后发球，球从远向近飞行。接球和二传在近场，扣球从近向远，最后的扑救在远场。切勿颠倒此空间关系。

[运镜原则] 仅在开头使用大胆的空中俯拍，以展示整个球场及两条底线。此后，以稳定的对角线广角和中景构图为标准。摄像机不得越过 180 度线或绕到球网另一侧。禁止使用极度超广角、鱼眼、球视角、随球飞行镜头、突然推近、脚底特写或超大球体。不要展示太阳本身；仅在进攻时使用柔和的逆光。

[时间构成] 0.0-0.8 秒：大胆的空中俯拍。清晰展示整个球场、两条底线、中央球网、前方的两名主队球员和后方的两名对手。远场底线后的棕发球员在第一帧时已开始跳发球助跑。不要将其描述为静态画面。
0.8-2.8 秒：硬切至稳定的高位对角线广角镜头。发球手的抛球动作已完成；一气呵成展示助跑、起跳和击球。所有动作均为快速正常速度；击球点处不要减速。摄像机保持正确的发球位置和球员全身；球被击中后以高速从远向近飞行。
2.8-5.2 秒：俯瞰近场的稳定对角线广角镜头。镜头开始时，球已接近近场，黑人主攻手正向接球位置移动。她立即完成一次低位精准接球，金发二传手无需等待便移动到球下给出高二传。在同一画面中展示接球手、二传手和球。全程正常速度。
5.2-8.0 秒：近场侧面的中景广角镜头。黑人主攻手并非从静止开始，而是以跑动中途的状态出现，完成向网前的最后 2-3 步。金发二传手保持在背景中。同时展示主攻手全身、球网和被传出的球，仅进行短促平滑的水平追踪。正常速度。
8.0-10.4 秒：硬切至同一摄像机轴线上的较低中景镜头。黑人主攻手起跳，将球猛力扣向远场。头发和身体轮廓有柔和逆光，不展示太阳。以真实的竞技快速正常速度展示扣球。球必须从近向远飞行。
10.4-15.0 秒：从同一近场摄像机轴线，拍摄具有长焦感的远场稳定中景。镜头开始时，红发接球手已向落点跑去，单臂前伸低位扑救。非极度手部特写；在同一画面中保持球员上半身、伸出的手臂、张开的手掌、球和沙面。伸向球的手掌从始至终保持同一形状；绝不握拳，掌心朝向沙地，5 根手指自然伸直并略微张开。没有握拳、抓取、弯曲手指、拳头状或前臂对齐的接球姿势。扑救大部分为正常速度。仅在最后 0.4-0.6 秒指尖即将触球但未触球时使用慢动作。球不停留；它斜向下坠落，从指尖前方几厘米处掠过。与手掌、手指、拳头或手臂无接触；球触碰沙地一次。视频在球首次触沙时立即结束；不包含弹起、大量沙尘、得分庆祝、挥拳或站立动作。

[速度设计] 整个视频具有快速的实时竞技节奏。仅在最后 0.4-0.6 秒指尖未能触球时使用慢动作。跳发球、接球、二传、助跑、扣球、球下落及扑救开始均为正常速度。每个镜头中无等待或长时间摆拍；不要将整个视频做成慢动作风格。

[一致性] 始终保持 2 对 2 球员和 1 个球。避免人物增殖、消失或合并、角色互换、面部/发型改变、多余肢体、长滞空、球体复制、缩放、停顿或瞬间移动。发球手始终在远场底线后。接球/二传在近场，扣球从近向远，最后扑救在远场。在最后一个镜头中，保持红发接球手的上半身、手臂、张开的手掌、1 个球和沙面在同一画面中。

[禁止事项] 禁止出现现实世界的品牌、企业标志、赞助商、广告牌、转播商标志、比分显示、水印、字幕、可读文字、队名、球衣号码或对真实运动员的复刻。装备、球、球网、立柱和器材均为素色且无品牌。球上无文字、标志、符号或类似品牌的图案。禁止鱼眼畸变、越网摄像、近远颠倒、全视频慢动作、球体复制、极度手部特写、握拳、抓取、弯曲手指或失败方庆祝。

Pixar-quality 3D animation, highly expressive characters, warm cinematic lighting, colorful suburban backyard with World Cup decorations, exaggerated squash-and-stretch, playful camera movement, vibrant colors, ultra-detailed textures, no dialogue, expressive reactions only.

Scene 1 (0–4s)

Three energetic grandkids play an intense backyard soccer match. One attempts an ambitious bicycle kick and accidentally launches the ball toward Grandma. Grandma peacefully knits in a rocking chair under a tree, wearing glasses, cozy slippers, and a knitted cardigan, completely unaware. The kids freeze in horror as the camera follows the spinning ball toward her.

Scene 2 (4–8s)

Just before impact, Grandma casually lifts one slipper and effortlessly cushions the ball without looking up or stopping her knitting. She gently begins juggling with her slippers while continuing to knit perfectly. The rocking chair rocks naturally as the kids stare in disbelief. Birds stop, a squirrel freezes, and the camera slowly circles Grandma to emphasize how effortless she is.

Scene 3 (8–12s)

Without changing expression, Grandma escalates into impossible freestyle: around-the-world, rainbow flick, heel stall, neck stall, slipper rolls, and a tiny seated bicycle kick. She never misses a stitch or loses balance. The scarf keeps growing while everyone—including a neighbor and a confused golden retriever—watches in complete shock.

Scene 4 (12–15s)

Grandma casually volleys the ball without looking. It curves perfectly into the goal. The kids erupt in celebration and run toward her like she's a football legend. Grandma simply smiles, adjusts her glasses, keeps knitting, and gently rocks back and forth as the camera pulls back on the joyful backyard.

Animation Notes: Strong Pixar facial expressions, readable reactions, smooth soccer physics, only one soccer ball visible at all times exaggerated anticipation and follow-through, subtle secondary motion (fluttering yarn, rocking chair, leaves), wholesome comedy, no dialogue or subtitles, only ambient backyard sounds, ball impacts, knitting clicks, and uplifting orchestral music.

3-6 秒：墨意破局，笔锋初现。粒子流骤然加速，一道锐利的青蓝色光刃从环状光带中迸发而出，贯穿画面，如神罚之剑般瞬间撕裂黑暗。蓝光所过之处，“斩”字的左偏旁以泼墨之势迅速成形，笔画边缘带有锋锐的冰刃锯齿光效，墨色由深黑渐变为冰蓝，笔画内部流淌着碎玉般的反光粒子，共同呈现“墨刃破冰”的动态张力。

6-9 秒：仙意凝实，字形渐成。“斩”字成形后，第二道更具冲击力的蓝色光芒从屏幕下方迸发，自下而上延伸。“仙”字的竖画以“玉柱擎天”之姿骤然成形，笔锋锐利如冰刃，末端伴随冰晶星点飞溅特效。“仙”字的横、撇、捺则以水墨拖尾之势从竖画中衍化而出，笔画边缘伴随青蓝色能量涟漪，共同呈现“仙意凝实，玉质天成”的视觉效果。两字笔画在黑暗中相互呼应，形成强烈的视觉平衡。

9-12 秒：锋芒毕露，特效叠加。当“斩仙”二字完全成形后，字体表面开始浮现流动的青蓝色辉光。辉光从笔画中心向边缘扩散，形成“玉能环绕”的动态效果。与此同时，画面中开始有碎裂的冰晶与墨点粒子飘落。粒子围绕字体旋转碰撞，产生短暂的冰爆效果。字体边缘的锯齿光效逐渐增强，整体亮度提升 30%，背景也由纯黑逐渐变为冰蓝色水墨纹理，营造出“锋芒毕露，仙意凛然”的视觉冲击。

12-15 秒：最终定格，余韵悠长。所有动态特效逐渐收敛，“斩仙”二字的辉光稳定为柔和的青蓝色，粒子流停止涌动，冰晶缓慢飘落至屏幕底部消失。最终定格画面为：在冰蓝色水墨纹理背景下，“斩仙”二字以厚重的书法字体呈现。“斩”字左侧笔画锋利如冰刃，“仙”字右侧竖画挺拔如玉柱。字体边缘带有细微的玉质光晕，共同呈现“斩仙问道，玉意绵长”的最终效果。

技术参数补充（Seedance 2.0 适配）
运动强度：0.75（确保平滑过渡，避免过度晃动）
效果强度：0.85（强化墨点与冰玉特效的视觉冲击力）
色彩校正：青蓝色主色调，辅以墨黑与暗红点缀，对比度提升 20%
镜头语言：全程固定机位，聚焦画面中心，无镜头运动变化，突出字体本身的动态张力。

prompt:
CAMERA / LOOK: Handheld mini DV camcorder footage filmed by the subject herself. Slight hand shake, occasional focus hunting, imperfect framing, natural zoom adjustments, soft tape-like image quality, subtle grain, realistic auto-exposure shifts from dorm fluorescent-mixed daylight. Natural skin tones, mild motion blur, authentic consumer camcorder aesthetic.

STYLE: Cozy dorm-setup vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments. Focus on satisfying sounds: cardboard box unpacking, tape peeling, string lights unraveling, bedsheet snapping, drawer sliding.

SUBJECT: Young woman in her late teens/early 20s, oversized university hoodie, ponytail, minimal jewelry, casual American college style. Excited, hopeful energy on move-in day.

SETTING: Small US college dorm room on a late-summer move-in day. Bare walls, cardboard boxes stacked, twin bed frame, small desk, window with campus view.

STORYBOARD:
→ (2s, propped medium shot) Places camera on the desk, looks around the empty room. "First day in my dorm room."
→ (2s, overhead shot) Opens a cardboard box, pulls out folded bedsheets.
→ (2s, close-up) Snaps a fitted sheet onto the twin mattress.
→ (2s, handheld shot) Hangs string lights along the wall. "This is gonna make it feel more like home."
→ (2s, detail shot) Unpacks books and organizes them on a small shelf. No dialogue.
→ (2s, medium shot) Tapes a small poster to the wall. "Okay, adding some personality now."
→ (2s, macro shot) Arranges pens and supplies in a desk organizer.
→ (2s, propped shot) Plugs in a small desk lamp, turns it on.
→ (2s, warm ending shot) Sits on the bed, looks around the finished room, happy smile. "Feels like mine now."
→ (1.5s, final shot) Reaches toward camera. "See you at class." Hand covers lens as recording ends.

AUDIO NOTES: Natural ambience cardboard unpacking, tape peeling, string lights unraveling should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual.

REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine excited smiles, occasional pauses while deciding placement, imperfect framing, focus breathing, mixed dorm lighting shifts. Should resemble a genuine personal move-in vlog on a consumer camcorder, not a commercial production.

prompt:
Professional cinematic short — Sapphire Storm. Inverted sumi-e style, white ink on pure black void, 16:9, 15 seconds total, 6 cuts.
CHARACTER: Female, age 20–25, sharp fierce beauty. Long straight jet-black hair, one thick strand across face. Fair-warm skin. Floor-length deep sapphire-blue ceremonial robe, wide dramatic sleeves, black inner wrap. Presence: fierce, intense, dangerously calm.
STYLE: Inverted sumi-e — white ink on pure black. Rich tonal gradation, soft grey to blazing white. Expressive energetic brushstrokes. Female figure as luminous white ink silhouette with glowing halo edges. Electric sapphire-blue ink trails bleeding from robe during all movement. No color except white ink and sapphire blue only.
00:00–00:03 — STORM AWAKEN
Low angle, 24mm. Dancer emerges diagonally from black void, sapphire robe billowing. First blazing white ink arc carved across darkness. Blue ink bleeds along robe seams. Mythic opening beat.
00:03–00:05 — BLADE SPIRAL
Wide, orbit. Dancer in deep aggressive lunge, arm driving in a full spin. Explosive white ink ribbons whip across the void. Sapphire robe trails fracture violently. Camera circling with parallax distortion.
00:05–00:07 — ASCENDING CURRENT
Wide, crash push. Camera surges forward. Dancer drops low then explodes upward. Massive white ink column erupts vertically, 3x her height. Sapphire threads spiral inside the white current. Extreme scale contrast.
00:07–00:11 — HALO DRIFT
Wide, slow spiral track. Dancer completes a full circular sweep, forming a blazing white enso ring around her silhouette. Faint sapphire halo glows at the ring's edge. Figure partially dissolves into ink, then re-emerges. Hypnotic, ceremonial.
00:11–00:14 — THUNDER STRIKE
Wide, static impact shot. Dancer drives downward in a violent strike. Massive white ink starburst radiates from the impact point. Sapphire shockwave ring pulses at the base. Most explosive beat of the piece.
00:14–00:15 — STORM'S SIGNATURE
Top view, dolly out. Bird's-eye retreat upward. White silhouette shrinks, revealing the full ink trajectory across the black floor. youngfilm25 logo emerges in bold white brush calligraphy, center frame. Sapphire ink droplets scattered around the logo. Premium cinematic final frame.

prompt:
CAMERA STYLE: Recorded on a compact pocket camcorder held by the subject herself. Slight rolling-shutter wobble during movement, occasional autofocus adjustments, minor exposure fluctuations when passing light sources, subtle digital noise in darker areas, naturally imperfect framing, authentic consumer-camera quality rather than cinematic footage.

MOOD: Quiet late-night self-care diary. Calm, intimate, and unscripted. Feels like a real person documenting a peaceful evening at home rather than creating content for an audience.

SUBJECT: Woman in her early 20s wearing an oversized sweatshirt and comfortable lounge pants. Hair loosely tied back with a few strands falling naturally around her face. Bare skin, relaxed and slightly sleepy expression.

SETTING: Small apartment kitchen and living room at night. Warm lamp lighting, soft shadows, a few houseplants, books on a side table, rain visible through a nearby window.

STORYBOARD:

→ (2s, handheld selfie shot) Walks into the kitchen carrying the camera. Soft smile.
“Couldn’t sleep, so I’m making some tea.”

→ (2s, countertop shot) Camera set down beside a kettle. Steam begins rising as water heats.

→ (2s, close detail shot) Opens a tea tin and scoops loose tea leaves. Soft metallic lid sounds.

→ (2s, side angle) Pours hot water into a mug. Steam drifts naturally toward the lens.

→ (2s, handheld shot) Carries the mug toward the living room, camera slightly bouncing with each step.

→ (2s, medium shot) Sits cross-legged on a couch and wraps both hands around the warm mug. No dialogue.

→ (2s, close-up) Flips through a book, slowly turning pages. Audible paper sounds.

→ (2s, candid shot) Looks out the window at the rain for a moment, quietly sipping tea.

→ (2s, low-angle shot from coffee table) Pulls a blanket over her legs and settles deeper into the couch.

→ (2s, selfie shot) Small tired smile.
“I think this is exactly what I needed.”

→ (1.5s, ending shot) Reaches toward the camera and gently lowers it onto the couch cushion. Recording continues for a brief moment before ending naturally.

AUDIO NOTES: Soft rain outside, kettle heating, tea pouring, ceramic mug sounds, page turning, fabric rustling, quiet room ambience. Minimal speech with natural pauses.

REALISM NOTES: Natural posture changes, occasional glances away from the camera, authentic hand movements, imperfect focus transitions, subtle camera shake, realistic indoor lighting, genuine facial expressions, no commercial styling, no beauty filters, no cinematic color grading. The final result should feel like an actual personal late-night diary clip recorded spontaneously at home.

variants.text:
场景背景
明亮的夏日午后，海岸公路：年轻男子骑着薄荷绿踏板车向海边驶去，年轻女子坐在他身后，双臂环绕着他的腰——他们轻松愉快地骑行，经过水边的铁路道口。

活动参考
<<<image_1>>> — 年轻女子，20 岁，身高 165 厘米，身材苗条，深棕色直发，侧分刘海用黑色小发夹固定，脸颊和鼻梁上有雀斑。与参考图 100% 匹配。
<<<image_2>>> — 年轻男子，22 岁，身高 178 厘米，精瘦，晒成古铜色，凌乱的深色头发下戴着一顶反戴的棕褐色棒球帽。与参考图 100% 匹配。
<<<image_3>>> — 交通工具：复古薄荷绿踏板车，配有棕色皮革车座、镀铬后视镜和银色轮毂。与参考图 100% 匹配。
<<<image_4>>> — 地点：海岸公路在经过铁路道口处向下弯曲，道口设有黄黑相间的交叉路标、电线杆和电线、石质路堤墙、杆上的橙色凸面交通镜，背景是波光粼粼的开阔大海。

位置地图
来自 <<<image_4>>> 的道路在中景处穿过铁路道口向下弯曲，大海填满了其后的背景。道路两侧是升起的石质路堤，橙色凸面镜立在右侧路肩的近景处，电线杆沿弯道排列。他们的路线：沿弯道向下，经过道口，沿着水边向屏幕左侧行驶。主光源：明亮的海滨日光，阳光高照，海风吹拂。

首帧与空间构图
第一帧画面中 <<<image_3>>> 已经出现在弯道上，两人都在车上——<<<image_2>>> 驾驶，双手握住车把，<<<image_1>>> 紧贴在他身后，双臂环绕他的腰，她的头刚好在他肩膀上方，比他矮一个头。没有空镜头，没有延迟出现。他在每一段中都在驾驶；她始终是乘客。

格式模式
受控的四段多镜头序列：一个插入镜头（INSERT CUT）和两个硬切（HARD CUT）。实时运动，保持轻松不急促的踏板车速度。每一段均采用手持拍摄——序列中没有任何静态镜头。

光学效果
镜头锁定第 1 段 = 47° 对角线视场，标准定焦镜头特性，摄像机位于路边 12 至 15 米处，踏板车和两人完整入画，背景是道口和大海，直线呈直线状，无鱼眼效果。柔和的复古镜头渲染：边缘轻微柔化，明亮的天空和海面眩光处有轻微光晕，整个画面亮度均匀——无暗角，角落与中心同样明亮。此渲染适用于每一段。
镜头锁定第 2 段 = 29° 对角线视场，短焦距镜头特性，摄像机位于后方车辆上，距离 3 至 4 米跟拍，两人的面部和肩部特写，大海在身后柔和流过。
镜头锁定第 3 段 = 29°，摄像机距离 1.5 至 2 米，紧凑插入镜头，拍摄她环抱在他腹部的手，下方是薄荷绿车身和棕色车座，路面在下方模糊掠过。
镜头锁定第 4 段 = 47°，摄像机位于右侧路肩橙色凸面镜后方 10 至 12 米处，近景处的凸面镜中映射出道路，真实的踏板车穿过画面并沿海边远去。
中段无漂移。

摄像机
每一段均为手持拍摄，无一例外——路边和后方车辆上均有真实的摄影师：画面随着肩部的晃动而呼吸，每一秒都能看到轻微的震颤，小幅度的后期重构图追随踏板车并平滑回位；跟拍镜头在手部动作之上带有轻微的路面震动；插入镜头震颤稍明显；广角镜头的呼吸感较慢但从不冻结。没有三脚架的静止，没有稳定器的平滑，全程无任何数字稳定。此外，素材表现得像是在放映机中运行的旧胶片：持续细微的画格抖动、轻微的曝光闪烁、偶尔出现的微小灰尘斑点和发丝划痕，画面柔和且略带扩散，如同老旧的 16mm 胶片——绝不锐利，绝不数字洁净，任何时刻均无暗角或角落变暗。

动作时序
0.0 秒至 3.5 秒 — 路边广角：薄荷绿踏板车以轻松的速度沿弯道行驶，随着弯道轻微倾斜；<<<image_2>>> 手握车把神态放松，<<<image_1>>> 紧贴在他身后，她的头发和裙摆在海风中飘动；他们经过黄黑相间的道口标志，身后是波光粼粼的大海。
3.5 秒 硬切
3.5 秒至 6.5 秒 — 跟拍双人特写：她将下巴几乎抵在他的肩膀上，在他耳边俏皮地说着什么——嘴唇移动但听不到声音；他大笑起来，摇着头，帽子在风中戴得很稳；她迎着风开怀大笑，刘海飞舞，眼睛幸福地眯起。
6.5 秒 插入镜头
6.5 秒至 8.5 秒 — 紧凑插入：她的双手交叠在他腹部，手指交扣，随着踏板车在弯道中摇摆而轻轻挤压；薄荷绿车身反射着光影，路面在下方柔和模糊地流过。
8.5 秒 硬切
8.5 秒至 12.0 秒 — 橙色凸面镜后的广角：踏板车的微小倒影在真实的踏板车进入并穿过画面前一拍掠过前景中的圆形镜面，他们两人在广阔明亮的大海背景下显得很小；她向后仰头，迎着风大笑，沿着海岸远去；引擎的突突声渐行渐远。

物理特性
踏板车承载着真实的综合重量：路面接缝处的悬挂压缩感，随着两人身体倾斜而产生的轻微过弯侧倾，因油门变化产生的轻微晃动，她通过抓得更紧来保持平衡；引擎震动透过他们的袖子传递；骑行速度下的风持续吹动她的头发、他的 T 恤和她的裙摆，伴随织物飘动；海风增加了阵风效果；凸面镜的反射真实地追踪了他们的运动。

灯光
仅限明亮的海滨日光——无人工照明。老式胶片质感：天空和波光粼粼的大海绽放出柔和的白金色雾霾，带有可见的光晕环，空气中悬浮着柔和的光芒，奶油色的高光柔和过渡。老胶片的褪色粉彩色调：提升的乳白色黑色，柔和海蓝色之上的暖象牙色和蜂蜜色调，薄荷绿车身呈现为柔和的洗练粉绿色，橙色镜面和黄黑标志作为温暖柔和的强调色——绝不过饱和；略微泛黄的白色，低对比度，色彩如同一张陈放了二十年的胶片般柔和洗练，每一帧都有明显的胶片颗粒感，带有精致的雾霾感。曝光在整个画面中保持自然——无添加暗角，无边缘或角落变暗。整个画面看起来就像是在尘封的胶卷中发现的一部 2000 年代的日本老电影。没有现代数字影像的锐利感，没有冷色调。

音频
仅限音效，带有旧式光学声轨的磨损质感——略显沉闷，伴有持续的微弱嘶嘶声：小踏板车引擎的轻柔突突声随着油门起伏，风声掠过，路下方的海浪拍打声，海鸥的叫声，她被风吹散的清脆笑声，以及远去时引擎微弱的滴答声。无音乐，无清晰的人声对白，无字幕，无配乐。

正向锁定
身份在每一段中 100% 锁定为 <<<image_1>>> 和 <<<image_2>>> ——全程穿着与参考图相同的服装，她 165 厘米、他 178 厘米的身高比例真实，他的帽子在骑行速度下始终反戴且稳固。<<<image_2>>> 在每一段中都在驾驶；<<<image_1>>> 从始至终坐在后座，双臂环绕他的腰，双手从未松开。踏板车在每一个镜头中始终是 100% 的 <<<image_3>>> ——薄荷绿车身、棕色车座、镀铬后视镜。道路地理位置在所有剪辑中与 <<<image_4>>> 保持一致：下坡弯道、道口标志、路堤、右侧路肩的橙色镜面，大海始终在道路之外；行驶方向保持不变。

prompt:
Style: 8K cinematic. Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic.
Cinematography: naturalistic master cinematography.
Lighting: Surrealistic, vibrant alien twilight. High-contrast dramatic light. Cold ambient purple and indigo sky vs. blinding fiery orange-red illumination from the falling debris. The environment is underlit by colorful bioluminescent fungal glow.
Color: 60:30:10 — dominant deep indigo and violet (alien sky & ground) / secondary toxic green, magenta, and cyan (glowing mushrooms) / accent fiery orange-red and bright electrical blue (falling station & explosions).
Camera: Physical cine lens. 180° shutter motion blur. Continuous handheld operator shake motivated by the shockwaves.
Physics: Gravity and inertia respected. Debris, smoke, and spores obey atmospheric physics.

SUBJECTS:

@truck: The heavy, battered off-road hauler (inspired by 'CHIMERA-7' from watermarked_img_14909239665213110893.png), modified for a damp alien environment—covered in strange moss and glowing fungal spores instead of frost. A wrapped rider is braced low on the cargo bed, clothes snapping in the wind, wearing a rebreather mask. The truck trails a heavy column of dark, iridescent chemical smoke.

@station: A colossal orbital space station (or ancient technomagic citadel), breaking apart and falling through the upper atmosphere directly behind the truck. A massive lattice of metal, alien alloys, and glowing power-cores tearing itself to pieces.

LOCATION: A bizarre alien plain covered in a dense forest of towering bioluminescent mushrooms with thick twisted stalks and massive glowing caps. Spores drift like glowing dust through the air. The horizon is dominated by the orbital descent.

ACTION — ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE, single unbroken handheld tracking shot, NO cuts. 15 seconds.

0:00–0:05 — Medium-Wide Shot on @truck: The camera tracks alongside the hauler as it zigzags through a clearing in the giant glowing mushroom forest. Giant caps snap and burst under the truck's heavy tires, releasing luminous spores. Behind it, the purple sky is torn open as a massive burning section of the space station enters frame, trailing fire and thick purple-black smoke. Smaller debris shatters distant mega-mushrooms.

0:05–0:10 — Slow Continuous Zoom-In / Tilt Up: The camera smoothly zooms past the truck, tilting up through the glowing fungal canopy to focus entirely on the falling @station. A violent explosion rips through a main power-core, sending out a shockwave that distorts the atmosphere with a horizontal optical lens flare. Electrical blue arcs crackle across its superstructure.

0:10–0:15 — Extreme Close-Up on @station: The camera settles into a tight telephoto compressed view of the disintegrating station against the alien sky. Giant metallic beams twist and snap, burning orange-hot, shedding glowing fragments, ash, and burning debris toward the camera, illuminated by the colorful world below.

path: prompts/真人/现实向/都市剧情/youmind-7395--制片人办公室对话场景.md
prompt:
INT. mid-century producer's office, day. Walnut-paneled walls hung with film posters and black-and-white photo collages, deep blue carpet, brown leather Eames chairs, a cluttered wooden desk with books and a film canister, tall windows behind with an overcast city skyline, warm circular ceiling lights overhead. A young East Asian woman — dark hair in a messy high bun with loose strands, black over-ear headphones pushed back on her head, blue-and-rust tie-dye cropped tee — sits across the desk from a bald man with a grey-flecked beard, white shirt sleeves rolled to the elbow. Entire scene shot on a restless handheld camera: the frame breathes, sways, drifts and reframes with every movement, never locked off.
Shot 1 — handheld medium on the woman, frame loose and shifting: she leans forward on one forearm against the desk edge, the other hand turning a pen slowly between her fingers. Her body stays contained — a quick lift of the eyebrows, a small tilt of the head, a half-grin pulling one corner of her mouth. She stops the pen, taps it once on the desk, and holds his eyes. "I've got an idea." A flicker of a smile after the line; she lets the silence sit. The camera drifts slightly, breathing with her.
Shot 2 — handheld over-the-shoulder onto the man, the frame snapping to him and settling unevenly: he slaps a palm flat on the desk, shoves his chair back, throws his head back and rubs his face with both hands, then jabs a finger at her, exasperated. "Stop — STOP. Voices like that, generated, for a real film? Kid—" he spreads his hands, shaking his head hard, "—that's not a thing." The handheld drifts in on his frustrated face.
Shot 3 — handheld push-in on the woman, the camera creeping closer through the natural sway: she goes completely still. The pen lowers to the desk. Shoulders drop. The grin fades into calm, level certainty. She holds his eyes, and the frame tightens to a close-up as she says one quiet word: "Watch." The man stops moving; his hand freezes mid-gesture. The handheld settles on her steady face.
Soft overcast daylight from the windows mixed with warm tungsten from the ceiling rings, natural color, shallow background. Dialogue in English, delivered with full emotion — hers calm and certain, his loud and rattled, then both dropping to stillness on the turn.

内景。中世纪制片人办公室，日。胡桃木墙壁上挂着电影海报和黑白照片拼贴画，深蓝色地毯，棕色皮革 Eames 椅，凌乱的木质办公桌上放着书籍和电影胶片盒，身后高大的窗户映出阴天的城市天际线，头顶是温暖的圆形吸顶灯。一位年轻的东亚女性——深色头发梳成凌乱的高丸子头，几缕发丝垂下，黑色头戴式耳机推到脑后，身穿蓝锈色扎染短款 T 恤——坐在办公桌对面，与一位留着灰白胡茬的秃顶男子交谈，男子穿着白色衬衫，袖子卷至肘部。整场戏采用不安定的手持摄影：画面随着每一次动作呼吸、摇晃、漂移并重新构图，从不固定。
镜头 1——手持中景拍摄女性，构图松散且不断变换：她单手前臂撑在桌边前倾，另一只手在指间缓慢转动一支笔。她的身体保持收敛——快速扬起的眉毛，轻微的歪头，嘴角勾起的一抹半笑。她停下转笔，在桌上轻敲一下，注视着对方的眼睛。“我有个主意。” 台词后闪过一丝微笑；她让沉默蔓延。摄像机轻微漂移，与她一同呼吸。
镜头 2——手持过肩镜头拍摄男子，画面突然切到他身上并显得不平衡：他一掌拍在桌上，推开椅子，向后仰头并用双手揉脸，然后恼火地指着她。“停——停下。那种声音，生成的，用在真正的电影里？孩子——” 他摊开双手，用力摇头，“——这根本行不通。” 手持镜头漂移向他沮丧的脸。
镜头 3——手持推镜头拍摄女性，摄像机在自然的摇晃中悄然靠近：她完全静止了。笔放下，靠在桌上。双肩下垂。笑容褪去，转为平静、笃定的神情。她注视着他的眼睛，随着她说出一个安静的词，画面收紧为特写：“看着。” 男子停止动作；他的手在半空中僵住。手持镜头定格在她沉稳的脸上。
窗户透入柔和的阴天日光，混合着天花板灯环发出的温暖钨丝光，自然色彩，背景虚化。对话为英语，情感饱满——她的冷静笃定，他的大声烦躁，随后两人在转折处同时归于沉静。

SCENE: Kazakh nomadic summer camp on a green mountain pasture — felt yurts left, herd of horses and sheep beside them, flowering meadow, pale river winding down the right, vast snow-capped mountains rising in the distance. Soft directional daylight, warm on peaks, cool valley shadow.

SHOT 1 — WIDE, handheld. Thirds, not centered: yurts on lower-left power point close to camera; meadow sweeps right to the river in the right third; snow mountains fill the upper half; low horizon, camp small against colossal peaks.

HARD CUT to SHOT 2 — MEDIUM WIDE, handheld, closer on yurts and herd. Largest yurt on the left third, dark doorway the focal point; horses and sheep strung lower-center to right; slice of distant mountain upper-right.

HARD CUT to SHOT 3 — VERY WIDE EXTREME LONG SHOT, handheld. Camp tiny in the lower-left corner; enormous snow mountains fill the upper two-thirds; river a thin thread down the right; horizon very low, settlement minuscule at the foot of the range. Big-versus-small at its extreme.

AUDIO (all shots): gentle mountain wind through grass, calls of the herd, soft bleating, thin trickle of the river, wide calm hush. No music, no dialogue, no subtitles.

8K IMAX 电影级画质。采用每秒 12 帧的手绘逐帧动画，每一帧均由手工绘制，保留可见的笔触、油画纸纹理、帧间手绘线条抖动、定格动画般的时序停顿以及逐帧动画节奏。无平滑插帧，无 CGI，无 3D 渲染，无游戏引擎，无游戏过场动画质感。

摄影由 Emmanuel Lubezki 与 Roger Deakins 联合执导。使用物理电影镜头拍摄，采用 180° 快门运动模糊。构图遵循三分法与黄金分割比例。摄像机保持在主体的阴影侧，采用强烈的逆光构图。

光线来自单一统一光源：从上方投射的苍白冷月光，穿过极度浓厚的大气雾霾。每一个角色和环境元素均由同一光源照亮。柔和的淡蓝色月光均匀地覆盖在皮肤、织物、积雪和树干上。冷色调轮廓光勾勒出肩膀、头部和头巾的边缘，而面部则保持在柔和的阴影中。

环境：被极强暴风雪和浓重冰雾吞没的积雪森林。能见度仅约 3 米。超出此范围的一切都消融在纯白色的雾霾中，仅最近的树木和人物清晰可见。浓厚的雾墙消除了景深。强劲的横向风将密集的雪幕吹过画面。积雪迅速堆积在长袍、肩膀和头巾上。呼出的气息瞬间化为水汽并被风撕裂。长袍、宽松的织物和头发在强风下剧烈地向侧面摆动。

角色：一对在严寒风暴中迷路的绝望母子。他们精疲力竭、惊恐万分，已接近体能极限。母亲努力掩饰内心的恐慌以安抚孩子，而孩子则因恐惧而放声大哭，紧紧依偎着母亲。

角色对天气的反应：两人都紧闭双眼以抵御风雪，用手或前臂遮挡面部，低头并将脸埋入衣领或头巾中，在深雪中艰难跋涉时，整个身体都倾斜以对抗风暴的阻力。

调色板：60% 雪蓝色，30% 黑色树干，10% 冷色调点缀。

物理效果完全真实，遵循重力、惯性、自然的织物动力学、正确的积雪交互以及精确的接触阴影。无漂浮物体或不真实的动作。

保持所有镜头的一致性：角色、服装、道具、环境、光线和天气完全相同。每个角色从第一帧到每一个剪辑点都保持自然的连续动作，无任何连贯性中断。
