镜头 1 (0-3s)：低角度广角追踪镜头。建立召唤仪式空间。女剑客结印；小师妹满怀期待地注视。镜头缓慢向前推进。
音效：深沉的古琴声、山风声、青铜铃声。
镜头 2 (3-6s)：中景/牛仔景。女剑客高喊：“神凤，听我号令！”天空中爆发巨大的火焰漩涡。巨大的凤凰虚影穿过迷雾。火星与羽毛飘落。小师妹感到震惊。
音效：古琴声渐强，风声加剧，火焰漩涡的轰鸣声，神话音效。
镜头 3 (6-10s)：特写至大特写。火焰漩涡突然“砰”地一声缩小。盛大的奇观坍缩成一只浑身煤灰的小凤凰，落在女剑客的玉簪上。小鸡啄了啄她的头发，说道：“妈妈。”音乐瞬间停止。小师妹掩嘴憋笑。女剑客的大特写，表情僵硬，眉毛抽动，笑容凝固，一片冒烟的羽毛从她脸庞飘落。
音效：爆裂声，小鸡叫声，音乐停止，尴尬的寂静，风声。
IV. 最后 4 秒序列：漩涡缩小 → 小鸡降落 → 小鸡说话 → 音乐停止 → 小师妹憋笑 → 大特写 → 女剑客僵住 → 羽毛飘落。

A blend of poetic Xianxia spectacle and restrained deadpan comedy, with cinematic high-definition quality.
Classical Chinese mythical art design, contrasting grand summoning momentum with a tiny result for strong scale reversal.

Humor comes from clear expectation mismatch.
【Worldview】
Pure ancient Chinese Xianxia world. No modern items, architecture, or language. No text overlays.
【Duration】Strictly 10s. 【Aspect Ratio】16:9, 24fps.
【Shot Structure】Three clean shots.

prompt:
Create a gritty cinematic action shot, 7 seconds, 16:9. Use dynamic action-movie cutting.

Main subjects:
@jin, a lean man in a worn knee-length dark coat over dark clothes, expressionless, fast and economical. @mishima, a young man in a black suit, holding a compact Glock 19 pistol with a mounted underbarrel tactical light.

Setting:
A Neo-East slum alley at blue-hour twilight — deep-blue dusk sky overhead, faint neon city towers far beyond, retro filament-style LED bulbs glowing amber as the dominant local light: scrap-metal walls, tangled cables overhead, wet reflective ground, humid haze. A makeshift food stall with a steaming pot, a hanging amber lantern and a tarp canopy stands close behind @mishima.

The shot opens over @jin's shoulder from directly behind him — @jin's back stays to the camera the whole time and he never turns toward the lens — looking down the alley at @mishima as @jin drives forward into the charge. As he closes the gap, cut to a tighter side angle: @jin catches @mishima's gun wrist on the outside line and wrenches it upward, and in the same motion drives an elbow into @mishima's face. Cut to @mishima's head snapping back as he is hurled backward and SLAMS into the food stall behind him — [VFX: a wooden support post snaps, the tarp canopy collapses, the metal cooking pot flips into the air and its broth sprays outward, utensils scatter, and a gout of flame flares up from the toppled stove just beside him as the amber lantern shatters]. The shot resolves with @jin already low and rooted in the wreckage of the stall, gaze flat, no pause.

Camera behavior:
Over-the-shoulder from directly behind @jin with his back to camera throughout, steadicam tracking in with the charge, a hard cut on the elbow impact, framing fixed with no reversal. Real-time speed with the impact landing heavy.

Global style:
Gritty cyber-noir at blue-hour twilight, cinematic low-key amber light from the filament bulbs as the key with a cool deep-blue ambient fill, wet reflective surfaces, humid haze, cold and quiet tone, high texture detail, 35mm film grain.

Audio:
Rapid wet footsteps closing in, cloth friction, the wrench of a seized joint, a sharp elbow impact, a wooden post cracking, the metal pot clanging and broth splashing, a flame whooshing up, and the lantern shattering. No dialogue.

Keep @jin and @mishima visually distinct, and use only these two referenced characters.

全程采用 @jin 的正后方越肩视角，背部始终对着镜头，使用斯坦尼康（Steadicam）跟随冲锋，在肘击瞬间进行硬切，构图固定，无反转。实时速度，强调击打的沉重感。

path: prompts/漫剧/特效向/战斗大招/youmind-8017--动漫风格海怪激战场景.md
prompt:
高品質なアニメ映像。英雄的なハイファンタジーの海上討伐アクション。高密度な 3D トゥーン／セルルックで描画すること。薄く繊細でクールトーンの輪郭線、透明感のある多層セル影、強い夏の直射日光、海面の反射、逆光の飛沫、そして高品質なコンポジットを維持すること。キャラクター固有の色をキーライト、反射光、影の色、武器のエフェクトに反映させること。背景を深海、白い岩、灰白色の石造建築に限定し、キャラクターを背景から明確に分離すること。髪、目、濡れた怪物の肌、布、金属、石、木を、その反射率と質感の違いによって明確に描き分けること。太い輪郭線、単層のフラットな影、没個性的な顔、滑らかなプラスチック CG、低密度の背景、セミリアリズム、実写風、くすんだ色調、および混合されたアートスタイルは禁止。

舞台は、白い岩礁と深海の上に築かれた無人の古代海上要塞であり、晴天と透明感のある海風に包まれている。石造りの防波堤、閉鎖された桟橋、青銅製のウィンチ、信号塔、帆布、鎖を配置すること。場所、建築構造、戦闘経路を固定し、ビーチハウス、カフェ、現代都市、屋内などに変更しないこと。人物、通行人、船乗り、第三者は存在させないこと。破壊対象は無人の石壁、木製の桟橋、信号塔、設備のみとする。ホラー、負傷、流血、残酷な描写、ギャグ、可愛らしい怪物の描写、間抜けな表情、勝利のポーズは禁止。シリアスで爽快な劇場版グレードのアクションを貫徹すること。

画像 1 は「Person 1」、画像 2 は「Person 2」を示す。参照元の画像に登場するキャラクターを参照し、同一人物として維持すること。参照画像は、キャラクターの顔、目の形、虹彩の色、髪型、髪色、衣装、装飾、体格、シルエット、雰囲気、キャラクターカラーのみに使用すること。参照画像自体の背景、部屋、家具、ポーズ、画角、フレーミングを再現しないこと。表情、視線、口元、ポーズ、呼吸、髪や衣装の自然な揺れのみが変化し得る。特徴の混合、顔の平均化、衣装の入れ替え、別人に変えること、クローン化、人数の追加、余分な手足の追加は禁止。

Person 1 は画像 1 のキャラクター、Person 2 は画像 2 のキャラクターとして完全に固定すること。両者の特徴、顔、髪、衣装、装飾、配色を混ぜないこと。最初から Person 1 はそのキャラクターに本来属する両手持ちの重武器を 1 つ所持し、Person 2 はそのキャラクターに本来属する片手武器を 1 つ所持していること。

敵は単体の巨大な海洋モンスターであるクラーケン。流線型の長い外套膜、低い額の装甲隆起、鋭い琥珀色の目、深緑がかった濡れた粗い肌、青白い吸盤を持つ脅威的な深海生物。枝分かれのない、根元から先端まで繋がった 8 本の触手を持つこと。触手の融合、増殖、枝分かれ、切断、または他の種類の怪物への変身は禁止。

待機、静的な導入、横並びの構図を最初から含めないこと。海面すれすれの低いカメラが砕ける波を高速で通り抜け、同時に要塞の外縁にクラーケンが出現する。接触前、信号塔は完全に無傷であること。1 本の触手が体と連動して振り下ろされ、その側面が信号塔中央の 1 点に明確に接触する。接触した瞬間にのみ、その地点から石と木が砕け、塔が海に向かって崩壊すること。

落下する破片を前景の遮蔽物として利用し、2 人が既に疾走している 3/4 低アングルの背面追跡ショットへ移行する。Person 2 が先頭に立ち、右から迫る 1 本の触手を片手武器で斜め上方に一度だけ受け流す。接触点から扇状の水膜が飛散し、反動が武器、腕、肩、支え脚に伝わる。その反動と勢いを次の動作に繋げ、閉鎖された桟橋の手すりを蹴り、一歩で隆起する別の触手に飛び乗る。Person 1 は両手持ちの重武器を低く構え、壊れた石壁を一歩の足場にして背後に続く。2 人は同時に触手の湾曲した表面からクラーケンの外套膜へと駆け上がる。Person 2 は行く手を阻む触手を鋭い斜めの一振りで切り開き、Person 1 が頂点に到達するための直線を確保すること。怪物の本体を切断しないこと。

最後の跳躍から武器の接触までをワンカットで描写すること。Person 1 はクラーケンの外套膜の斜面を 3 歩加速し、頂点直前で強く跳躍する。跳躍した瞬間から、両手で武器全体を保持したまま、前方垂直方向に正確に 1 回転する。武器、両手、肩、胸、腰、脚を同一の運動連鎖に統合すること。武器の先端だけを回転させないこと。回転中の停止、浮遊、空中でのポーズ、空中での二段ジャンプ、2 回転は禁止。正確に 1 回転を完了した直後、両足がクラーケンや地面に一度も触れない完全な空中状態のまま、回転の勢いを殺さずに、Person 1 の武器をクラーケンの頂点中央にある装甲隆起に叩き込むこと。攻撃前に着地やポーズを整えるシーケンス、武器を掲げて静止するシーンは禁止。頂点の装甲は武器が接触する直前まで完全に無傷であること。その後、クラーケンは海面下へと押し戻される。

高质量动漫画面。英雄式的高奇幻海洋征服动作。采用高密度 3D 卡通/赛璐珞风格绘制。保持纤细、精致且冷色调的轮廓线，透明的多层赛璐珞阴影，强烈的夏日阳光，海面反射，背光水花，以及高质量的合成效果。在关键光、反射光、阴影颜色和武器特效中体现角色固有的色彩。通过将背景保持为深蓝色海洋、白色岩石和灰白色石质结构，使角色与背景分离。通过反射率和粗糙度清晰区分头发、眼睛、湿润的怪物皮肤、布料、金属、石头和木材。禁止使用粗轮廓线、单层平涂阴影、大众脸、光滑的塑料感 CG、低密度背景、半写实、真人实拍、暗淡色调以及混合艺术风格。

场景设定为一座无人居住的古代海上要塞，建在白色礁石和深蓝色海洋之上，天气晴朗，海面空气通透。布置石质防波堤、封闭式码头、青铜绞盘、信号塔、帆布和锁链。固定地点、建筑结构和战斗路径，不得将其更改为海滩小屋、咖啡馆、现代城市或室内。不存在任何人物、路人、水手或第三方。破坏目标仅限于无人居住的石墙、木码头、信号塔和设备。禁止恐怖、受伤、流血、残酷描写、恶搞、可爱的怪物形象、愚蠢的表情和胜利姿势。全程保持严肃且令人振奋的剧场级动作表现。

图片 1 指代角色 1。图片 2 指代角色 2。请参考源参考图中的角色，并保持其身份一致。参考图仅用于确定角色的脸部、眼型、虹膜颜色、发型、发色、服装、装饰、体型、轮廓、氛围和角色配色。请勿复制参考图本身的背景、房间、家具、姿势、视角或构图。仅可改变表情、视线、嘴部、姿势、呼吸以及头发和服装的自然摆动。禁止混合特征、平均化脸部、交换服装、变成不同的人、克隆、增加额外人物或多余肢体。

角色 1 必须与图片 1 中的角色完全一致。角色 2 必须与图片 2 中的角色完全一致。请勿混淆两者的特征、脸部、头发、服装、装饰或配色方案。从一开始，角色 1 就持有一件该角色专属的双手重型武器。从一开始，角色 2 就持有一件该角色专属的单手武器。

敌人是一只巨型海洋怪物 Kraken。这是一种极具威胁的深海生物，拥有长而流线型的外套膜、低矮的额部装甲脊、锐利的琥珀色眼睛、深蓝绿色湿润粗糙的皮肤和苍白的吸盘。它拥有八条触手，从基部到尖端连续且无分叉。禁止触手融合、增殖、分叉、切割或变形成其他类型的怪物。

从一开始不要包含等待、静态介绍或并排构图。镜头从海面上方低位高速穿过破碎的浪花，同时 Kraken 出现在要塞外缘。接触前信号塔完好无损。一条触手随身体协调摆动，其侧面清晰地接触到信号塔中心的一点。接触后，石头和木头才从该点破碎，塔身向海面倾倒。

利用坠落的碎片作为前景遮挡，过渡到四分之三低角度的后方追逐镜头，此时两人已在奔跑。角色 2 领先，用单手武器将一条从右侧袭来的触手向斜上方格挡一次。接触点散发出扇形水膜，反作用力传回武器、手臂、肩膀和支撑腿。将该反作用力和动能传递到下一个动作，蹬开封闭式码头的栏杆，一步跃上一条上升的触手。角色 1 手持双手重型武器压低重心，利用破碎的石墙作为垫脚石紧随其后。两人同时从触手的弯曲表面跑上 Kraken 的外套膜。角色 2 用一次清晰的斜向挥砍清除挡路的触手，为角色 1 开辟出直达顶部的路线。不要切断怪物的本体。

将最终起跳到武器接触的过程展示在一个连续镜头中。角色 1 在 Kraken 外套膜的斜坡上加速三步，并在到达顶部前的最后一步强力起跳。从起跳瞬间开始，双手紧握武器，在垂直方向向前旋转整整一圈。将武器、双手、肩膀、胸部、腰部和腿部整合进同一个动力链中。不要只旋转武器尖端。禁止旋转中途停止、悬浮、空中定格姿势、空中二段跳或旋转两圈。在完成整整一圈旋转后，在双脚未触碰 Kraken 或地面的完全滞空状态下，且不中断旋转动作，将角色 1 的武器猛击入 Kraken 顶部中心的装甲脊上。禁止在攻击前出现着陆和重新摆姿势的序列，或站立不动举着武器的场景。顶部装甲在武器接触前完全完好无损。随后 Kraken 被击退至海面之下。

Maintain thin, delicate cool-toned outlines, transparent multi-layered cel shadows, strong summer sunlight, sea surface reflections, backlit splashes, and high-quality compositing. Reflect character inherent colors in key lights, reflected lights, shadow colors, and weapon effects. Separate characters from the background by keeping the backdrop to deep-blue sea, white rocks, and grayish-white stone structures. Clearly distinguish hair, eyes, wet monster skin, cloth, metal, stone, and wood by their reflectivity and roughness. Thick outlines, single-layered flat shadows, generic faces, smooth plastic CG, low-density backgrounds, semi-realism, live-action, dullness, and mixed art styles are prohibited.

The stage is an uninhabited ancient sea fortress built on white reefs and a deep-blue sea, enveloped in clear weather and transparent sea air. Place stone breakwaters, closed piers, bronze winches, signal towers, canvas, and chains. Fix the location, architectural structure, and combat path, and do not change them to beach houses, cafes, modern cities, or indoors. No people, passersby, sailors, or third parties exist. Target objects for destruction are only uninhabited stone walls, wooden piers, signal towers, and equipment. Horror, injury, bloodshed, cruel depictions, gags, cute monster portrayals, silly expressions, and victory poses are prohibited. Carry through as a serious and exhilarating theatrical-grade action.

Image 1 indicates Person 1. Image 2 indicates Person 2. Refer to the characters in the source reference images and maintain them as the same individuals. Reference images are to be used only for the character's face, eye shape, iris color, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, decorations, physique, silhouette, atmosphere, and character color. Do not reproduce the background, room, furniture, pose, angle of view, or framing of the reference image itself. Only expressions, gaze, mouth, pose, breathing, and natural swaying of hair and outfits may change. Mixing features, averaging faces, swapping outfits, changing into different people, cloning, adding extra people, or extra limbs are prohibited.

Person 1 is fixed exactly as the character in Image 1. Person 2 is fixed exactly as the character in Image 2. Do not mix the characteristics, faces, hair, outfits, decorations, or color schemes of the two. From the start, Person 1 possesses a single two-handed heavy weapon that naturally belongs to that character. From the start, Person 2 possesses a single one-handed weapon that naturally belongs to that character.

The enemy is a single giant marine monster Kraken. A menacing deep-sea creature with a long streamlined mantle, low forehead armored ridges, sharp amber eyes, deep blue-green rough wet skin, and pale suckers. It has exactly eight tentacles that are continuous from base to tip without branching. Fusion, proliferation, branching, cutting of tentacles, or transformation into other types of monsters is prohibited.

Do not include waiting, static introductions, or side-by-side compositions from the start. A low camera just above the sea surface passes through breaking waves at high speed, and simultaneously, the Kraken appears at the fortress's outer edge. A signal tower is completely unharmed before contact. One tentacle swings in coordination with the body, and its side clearly contacts a single point in the center of the signal tower. Only after contact do stone and wood break from that point, and the tower collapses toward the sea.

Using the falling debris as a foreground occlusion, transition to a three-quarter low-angle rear pursuit where the two are already sprinting. Person 2 takes the lead, parrying a single tentacle approaching from the right once diagonally upward with a one-handed weapon. Fan-shaped water film scatters from the contact point, and counterforce returns to the weapon, arm, shoulder, and supporting leg. Pass that counterforce and momentum to the next move, kick off the closed pier's railing, and run onto another rising tentacle in one step. Person 1 holds a two-handed heavy weapon low, follows behind using a broken stone wall as a one-step foothold. The two simultaneously run up from the tentacle's curved surface onto the Kraken's mantle. Person 2 clears a path through a blocking tentacle with one clear diagonal swing, opening a straight route for Person 1 to reach the top. Do not cut the monster's main body.

Show the final takeoff to weapon contact in one continuous shot. Person 1 accelerates three steps up the slope of the Kraken's mantle and jumps off strongly on the final step before the top. From the moment of jumping, while holding the entire weapon with both hands, perform exactly one rotation in a forward vertical direction. Integrate the weapon, both hands, shoulders, chest, waist, and legs into the same kinetic chain. Do not spin only the tip of the weapon. Stopping during rotation, floating, mid-air poses, double-jumps in the air, or two rotations are prohibited. Immediately after completing exactly one rotation, while in a complete mid-air state without both feet ever touching the Kraken or the ground, and without breaking the rotational motion, slam Person 1's weapon into the armored ridge at the center of the Kraken's top. Sequences of landing and re-posing before attacking, or scenes of standing still holding the weapon up, are prohibited. The top armor is completely unharmed until just before the weapon touches. The Kraken is then pushed back below the sea surface.

prompt:
Source Binding: <image1> : Female protagonist "Hikari". Maintain perfect consistency of facial features (eyes, nose, mouth, contour) and hair color across all segments. Ensure she is recognized as the same person even as angles change in each cut. Do not fix the outfit to <image1> — attire follows the text instructions for each segment. Ignore background, pose, and bottom text of <image1>.
4 Outfit Definitions: Homewear (oversized white shirt + cotton shorts), Look 1 (black monokini — cutout one-piece swimsuit), Look 2 (sky blue triangle bikini, simple basic style), Look 3 (pale pink frill bikini — subtle ruffles at the edges). Only wear the specified outfit for each segment, no changing scenes — all outfit transitions occur via jump cuts between segments.
In disclosure cuts, only hold the next look on a hanger towards the camera — do not try it on or drape it. Coexistence of held and worn outfits is allowed only in disclosure cuts; layering two outfits is prohibited.

Style: 8K cinematic photoreal. Real photo texture, no 3D renders, no game engine feel, no cutscene feel, no commercial CG feel. Cozy and cheerful tone typical of idol vlog lookbooks.

Cinematography: Naturalist cinematography. Feels like a YouTube vlog recorded in her own room. Only the first cut is a handheld selfie — allow the wrist and grip holding the cam to be slightly visible at the bottom of the frame — thereafter, use a fixed camera set on the floor, same spot/framing with jump cuts for outfit changes. No traces of tripods or lighting equipment.

Lighting: Bright daytime white room — soft natural light from a large window is the primary source, with white walls and wardrobes diffusing light so the face is always bright with faint shadows. Lighting remains identical in all cuts.

Color: 60:30:10 palette. Primary: white walls, white wardrobe, cream bedding, light wood floor. Secondary: outfit per segment (white shirt → black monokini → sky blue → pink frill) and natural skin tone. Accent: orange cushion on the rug.

Lens: Real camera lens texture, standard focal length, slight punch-in differences allowed per cut, 180-degree shutter motion blur.

Skin: Real skin texture with pores, fine hairs, natural complexion, and realistic shading. Subtle glow under indoor natural light. No plastic skin, no excessive retouching.

Acting: Sophisticated and natural acting. Cheerful yet shy talking tone typical of personal content — eyes sparkle with anticipation in disclosure cuts, comments shared like chatting with subscribers, reactions limited to eyes and mouth without exaggeration. No model posing — only natural movements while seated.

Physics: Realistic weight for all objects. Subtle shaking of the handheld cam, swimsuit on the hanger swaying slightly, frills fluttering at fingertips, fabric snapping back when pulled, rug compressing where she sits.

Composition: 16:9 horizontal frame, rule of thirds base. First cut is a standing handheld selfie half-body, subsequent cuts are seated half-body to knee fixed framing identical across all cuts — do not change framing for the fun of jump cuts.

Continuity: Maintain identical placement of person, hair, room, wardrobe, clothes inside, bedding, rug, and framing in all cuts. Follow outfit instructions per segment.

Shot 1 (0:00–0:02) [Intro / In front of mirror] — Homewear. Standing in front of a full-length mirror, handheld selfie — wrist holding the cam slightly visible, back reflected in the mirror. Brightly to camera: "Ta-da~ Hikari's summer lookbook!" Hard cut.

Shot 2 (0:02–0:03.5) [Look 1 Disclosure / Rug] — Fixed cam, maintain homewear. Sitting on the rug, holding the black monokini on a hanger toward the camera: "First one, the monokini!" Hard cut.

Shot 3 (0:03.5–0:06) [Look 1 Review] — Jump cut, same spot. Wearing only the black monokini. Pointing to the side cutout line: "This waistline is truly a work of art." Turning slightly to show. Hard cut.

Shot 4 (0:06–0:07.5) [Look 2 Disclosure] — Wearing Look 1, holding the sky blue triangle bikini on a hanger: "Next is the most casual one." Hard cut.

Shot 5 (0:07.5–0:10) [Look 2 Review] — Jump cut, same spot. Wearing only the sky blue triangle bikini. Leaning slightly toward the camera: "But the casual one... is what you end up wearing most, in the end."

variants.text:
源绑定：<image1>：女性主角“Hikari”。在所有片段中保持面部特征（眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、轮廓）和发色的完美一致性。确保即使在每个镜头的角度发生变化时，她也能被识别为同一个人。不要将服装固定为 <image1> —— 服装需遵循每个片段的文字说明。忽略 <image1> 的背景、姿势和底部文字。
4 套服装定义：居家服（超大号白衬衫 + 棉质短裤）、Look 1（黑色连体比基尼 —— 镂空连体泳衣）、Look 2（天蓝色三角比基尼，简约基础款）、Look 3（淡粉色荷叶边比基尼 —— 边缘带有细微褶皱）。每个片段仅穿着指定的服装，不要更换场景 —— 所有服装转换均通过片段间的跳剪完成。
在展示镜头中，只需将下一套服装挂在衣架上对着镜头展示 —— 不要试穿或披在身上。仅在展示镜头中允许手持服装与身上穿着的服装同时出现；禁止将两套服装叠穿。

风格：8K 电影级写实。真实的摄影质感，无 3D 渲染，无游戏引擎感，无过场动画感，无商业 CG 感。具有偶像 VLOG Lookbook 特有的舒适欢快基调。

摄影：自然主义摄影。感觉就像是在自己房间里录制的 YouTube VLOG。仅第一个镜头为手持自拍 —— 允许手腕和握持相机的动作在画面底部轻微可见 —— 此后，使用放置在地板上的固定相机，在同一位置/构图下通过跳剪进行服装更换。无三脚架或照明设备的痕迹。

照明：明亮的日间白色房间 —— 大窗户射入的柔和自然光是主要光源，白色墙壁和衣柜起到漫反射作用，使面部始终明亮且带有淡淡阴影。所有镜头的照明保持一致。

prompt:
PROMPT 1 — "THE ELIXIR" (0–15 seconds)

0–3s: Exterior establishing shot — the clocktower observatory looms over a fog-drowned city skyline at midnight, its great clock face glowing violet. Wind screams past cracked windows. The camera pushes toward a glowing round window, then glides seamlessly through the glass into the observatory. Inside, gears grind, orbs of violet fire drift lazily near the ceiling, star charts flutter on their pins.

3–6s: Camera circles slowly to reveal Dr. Vex standing atop a spiral staircase platform beside a massive brass astrolabe rig. She holds up a swirling silver-violet elixir in a cracked crystal flask, admiring it like a jewel. Her silver topknot catches the firelight. Below her, Milo and Senna trade a worried glance.

6–10s: She uncorks the flask with a sharp crack — violet smoke coils upward. She lifts it toward the astrolabe as it groans and spins faster. Camera pushes into close-up on her face, calm and certain. She drinks it in one motion. The apprentices freeze, bracing. Nothing happens for a beat. She smiles, satisfied, and begins to speak.

10–15s: Her smile locks in place. Silence. Her fingers twitch, one by one. Silver-violet light spiderwebs beneath the skin of her throat and jaw. Her pupils contract to pinpricks. The astrolabe overhead lurches and sparks. Every violet flame-orb in the room flares and dims in unison. Glass instruments rattle off their shelves. Her spine arches backward with a sharp crack. Her head lolls, then rises slowly — eyes now milky white, mouth stretched into a grin too wide to be human. A low, grinding growl rolls through the tower. The apprentices stumble back against the railing. The thing that was Dr. Vex turns its head toward them.

PROMPT 2 — "THE COUNTER-REAGENT" (15–30 seconds)

15–18s: The transformed Vex descends the last few stairs toward the apprentices, movements jerky and unnatural. She lunges and seizes Milo by the vest collar, hoisting him half off his feet. He kicks and yelps, goggles askew.

18–22s: Senna's eyes dart across the cluttered workbench without breaking her stare on Vex. She spots a small vial of glowing amber counter-reagent tucked among the star charts — the one Vex brewed "just in case," Senna always suspected. She edges toward it, slow, silent, one hand out.

影片开场于一个宁静的周六早晨。年轻女子决定带着她最近在家中找到的一台复古一次性相机去探索城市。她漫步在色彩斑斓的街道、花市、安静的咖啡馆、书店和河畔小径，捕捉那些让她微笑的小确幸。她拍摄盛开的鲜花、街头音乐家、追逐鸽子的顽童、面包店橱窗里的新鲜糕点，以及咖啡馆镜子里的倒影。每一次按下快门，都是对记忆的定格。

午后时光流逝，她独自坐在湖边的长椅上。喝完咖啡，她最后一次微笑着查看相机，随后接到一个电话。她匆忙起身离开，不慎将一次性相机遗忘在长椅上。

几分钟后，一位路过的善良年轻人发现了这台被遗忘的相机。他环顾四周，却找不到失主。出于好奇，他轻轻拿起相机，发现胶卷只剩最后一张。他没有据为己有，而是微笑着自拍了一张照片，照片中他拿着一张手写字条，上面写着：**“你的记忆理应回家。”**

他小心翼翼地在当地照相馆冲洗了整卷胶卷。冲洗出来的照片完美捕捉了女子快乐的一天。在最后一张照片的背面，他写下了发现相机的咖啡馆地址，并将冲洗好的照片与相机一起整齐地包装在信封里。

几天后，照相馆通过相机购买收据上的联系信息找到了女子，她收到了这个包裹。坐在卧室里，她慢慢翻看着每一张冲洗出来的照片，随着被遗忘的瞬间重现，她的脸上露出了笑容。当翻到最后一张照片时，她看到了那位陌生人拿着手写字条的样子。她感到好奇并被这一举动深深打动，注意到了背面写着的咖啡馆地址。

次日下午，她来到那家小咖啡馆。当她拿着一次性相机走进店内时，一眼就认出了坐在窗边看书的年轻男子。两人的目光交汇，交换了一个温暖而略带羞涩的微笑。

title: 大和号战列舰沉没
changes: 仅做提取与空白/Markdown 代码块格式规范化，提示词文字未做任何改动（含错别字）；未收录任何图片/视频。
path: prompts/真人/特效向/动作大片/youmind-8083--大和号战列舰沉没.md
prompt:
[条件定義]
15 秒、1:1 スクエア、共有用、参照画像なし。戦艦大和は、全長約 263 メートル、全幅 39 メートルの第二次世界大戦期最大級の超弩級戦艦として描く。冒頭から、米海軍艦載機による波状総攻撃の真っ只中にある。無数の爆弾、魚雷、至近弾による損傷が蓄積し、最終的に船体中央部から発生する致命的な大爆発により沈没が決定的となる。明るく鮮明な高品質の実写戦争映画の映像。鮮やかな青空、青から青緑色の海、暗灰色の鋼鉄の船体、白い水柱、オレンジ色の爆炎、濃い黒煙を明確に色分けする。

[被写体 / スケール]
メインの被写体は戦艦大和。長く幅広の船体、巨大な主砲塔、高い塔型艦橋、無数の対空砲を備えたフルスケールの超弩級戦艦。艦載機は明らかに大和より小さく、多方向から次々と攻撃を仕掛ける。大和は一撃では沈まず、総攻撃の蓄積によって致命的な最後を迎える。

[ショット / 流れ]
0.0-2.1 秒：左前方からの高い斜め俯瞰ワイドショット。戦艦大和の長い全長を画面中央に大きく映し出す。無数の小型艦載機が左、右、頭上から高速で交差し、広範囲で対空砲火、爆弾の命中、不規則な水柱が発生する。カメラは航空機を追わない。
2.1-4.2 秒：右側に寄った中高度の斜め俯瞰ワイドショット。艦首から艦尾までの船体が読み取れる角度を維持し、異なる方向からの編隊が前景、中景、背景を高速で交差する。甲板および船体周辺への攻撃が続き、火災と黒煙が増していく。
4.2-5.8 秒：高高度の真上からのワイドショット。固定カメラ。小型の急降下爆撃機 1 機のみが画面上部から大和に向かって高速で降下し、爆弾を投下して瞬時に画面外へ抜ける。大和の全長と航空機の小ささを同一フレーム内に維持する。
5.8-8.3 秒：海面ギリギリの超低高度。カメラは波の頂点すれすれを猛スピードで移動し、激しい飛沫が画面前方およびレンズ横に飛び散る。前方の巨大な大和に急速接近。魚雷本体を大きく見せず、白い魚雷航跡とともに左舷喫水線下へ接近する。命中と同時に船体より高い巨大な水柱が上がる。
8.3-12.2 秒：左側に寄った高い斜め俯瞰ワイドショットを維持し、ワンカットで撮影。大和をフレーム内に最大サイズで収め、艦載機群が前方、側面、頭上から高速で絶え間なく交差する。魚雷航跡、爆弾の直撃、至近弾、不規則な水柱、対空砲火が長い船体全体に集中する。攻撃を止めず、火災、黒煙、損傷、減速のみを増やす。12.2 秒まで致命的な大爆発は起こさない。
12.2-15.0 秒：同じ斜め俯瞰ワイドショットと戦闘の流れを維持。攻撃が続く中、蓄積された損傷が限界に達し、船体中央部への最後の一撃から致命的な大爆発が発生する。独立した球状の火の玉や多段階爆発にはせず、船体中央から水平に噴出するオレンジと白の爆炎、濃い黒煙、衝撃波、水しぶきを一体化させる。大和の船体と爆発の起点を同一フレーム内に収める。カメラはあまり動かさず、わずかに引いたパノラマで終了する。

[カメラ / 編集]
左前方斜め俯瞰 → 右側斜め俯瞰 → 固定真上からの急降下攻撃 → 海面超低高度の魚雷追跡 → 左前方斜め俯瞰での連続総攻撃 → 同一ショット内での致命的な大爆発。後方斜め俯瞰は使用しない。航空機を追跡せず、瞬時に画面を横切らせることで速度を表現する。カメラは魚雷シーンでのみ直線的に激しく動く。

[サウンド]
効果音のみ。無数の航空機の音、風切り音、対空砲火、爆弾の炸裂、魚雷の命中、水しぶきの音、鋼鉄の軋み、連続的な命中音、そして最後の巨大な爆発音。BGM、セリフ、ナレーションはなし。

[ネガティブ]
後方斜め俯瞰、航空機を追うカメラ、魚雷シーン以外の直線的な追跡、近すぎる画角、航空機が大和より大きく見える構図、似たような俯瞰カットの繰り返し、カット順序の変更、魚雷シーンの省略、12.2 秒前の致命的な大爆発、攻撃が途中で止まる展開、羅列、転覆、船体の分断、多段階の球状火球、船体から離れた爆発、夜戦、暗く鈍い色調、現代の戦闘機、ジェット機、ミサイル、カミカゼ、テキスト、字幕、ロゴ、人体損傷、死体、ミニチュア感、おもちゃ感、安っぽい CG 表現。

variants.text:
[条件定义]
15 秒，1:1 正方形，用于分享，无参考图。大和号战列舰被描绘为二战时期最大的超无畏级战列舰之一，全长约 263 米，宽 39 米。从第一帧开始，它就处于美国海军舰载机群的波状总攻击中。来自无数炸弹、鱼雷和近失弹的损伤不断累积，最终导致船体中心发生一次致命的巨大爆炸，决定了其沉没的命运。明亮清晰的高质量真人战争电影画面。鲜明区分色彩：鲜艳的蓝天、蓝色至蓝绿色的海面、深灰色的钢制船体、白色的水柱、橙色的爆炸火焰以及浓厚的黑烟。

[主体 / 比例]
主体是大和号战列舰。一艘全尺寸的超无畏舰，拥有长而宽的船体、巨大的主炮塔、高耸的塔式舰桥和众多的防空炮。舰载机明显比大和号小，并从多个方向接连发起攻击。大和号并非因单次攻击而沉没，而是通过总攻击的累积达到最终的致命一击。

[镜头 / 流程]
0.0-2.1 秒：左前方高位斜向俯拍广角镜头。在画面中心大比例展示大和号战列舰的全长。无数小型舰载机从左、右和上方高速穿过，防空炮火、炸弹命中和不规则的水柱在大范围内出现。摄像机不跟随飞机移动。
2.1-4.2 秒：靠近右侧的中空斜向俯拍广角镜头。保持能看清从舰首到舰尾的船体角度，来自不同方向的多支编队在前景、中景和背景高速穿过。对甲板和船体周围的攻击持续进行，火势和黑烟不断增加。
4.2-5.8 秒：高空超广角俯拍镜头。固定机位。仅有一架小型俯冲轰炸机从画面顶部向大和号高速俯冲，投下炸弹后瞬间飞离。在同一画面中保持大和号的全长和飞机的微小比例。
5.8-8.3 秒：海面超低空镜头。摄像机在波峰上方以极快的速度移动，海浪猛烈地溅向画面前方和镜头侧面。迅速接近前方巨大的大和号；不特写鱼雷本体，但鱼雷在海面上留下的白色航迹伴随其接近左舷水线下方。撞击时升起比船体更高的巨大水柱。
8.3-12.2 秒：保持左侧高位斜向俯拍广角镜头，作为单一连续镜头。大和号是画面中的最大目标，舰载机群从前方、侧面和上方持续高速穿过。鱼雷航迹、炸弹直接命中、近失弹、不规则水柱和防空炮火集中在长长的船体上。攻击不停，仅增加火势、黑烟、损伤和减速效果。12.2 秒前不发生致命的巨大爆炸。
12.2-15.0 秒：保持相同的斜向侧面广角镜头和战斗流程。随着攻击持续，累积的损伤达到极限，从船体中心的一次最终直接命中开始，发生致命的巨大爆炸。不要制作成独立的球形火球或多阶段爆炸；将从船体中心水平喷出的橙白色爆炸火焰、浓厚黑烟、冲击波和水花融为一体。将大和号船体和爆炸源保持在同一画面中；摄像机移动幅度较小，最后以略微宽广的全景结束。

[摄像机 / 剪辑]
左前方斜向俯拍 → 右侧斜向俯拍 → 固定超高空俯冲攻击 → 海面超低空鱼雷追踪 → 左前方斜向俯拍连续总攻击 → 同一镜头内的致命巨大爆炸。不要使用后方斜向俯拍。不要追踪飞机；通过飞机瞬间穿过画面来表现速度。仅在鱼雷场景中摄像机进行剧烈的直线移动。

[声音]
仅音效。无数飞机的声音、呼啸的风声、防空炮火声、炸弹爆炸声、鱼雷命中声、水花溅射声、钢材扭曲声、连续命中声以及最后的巨大爆炸声。无背景音乐、对话或旁白。

[负面提示]
后方斜向俯拍、摄像机跟随飞机、除鱼雷场景外的直线追踪、视角过近、飞机看起来比大和号大的构图、重复类似的俯拍剪辑、改变剪辑顺序、省略鱼雷场景、12.2 秒前发生致命巨大爆炸、攻击中途停止的发展、列队、倾覆、船体断裂、多阶段球形火球、与船体分离的爆炸、夜战、昏暗沉闷的色调、现代战斗机、喷气式飞机、导弹、神风特攻、文字、字幕、Logo、人员受伤、尸体、模型感、玩具感、廉价 CG 表现。

Do not use rear diagonal overhead. Do not track aircraft; represent speed by having them cross the screen in an instant. The camera moves violently in a straight line only in the torpedo scene.

title: 怀旧夏日粉笔动画 VFX
changes: 仅做提取与空白/Markdown 代码块格式规范化，提示词文字未做任何改动（含错别字）；未收录任何图片/视频。
path: prompts/漫剧/特效向/特效综合/youmind-8084--怀旧夏日粉笔动画-VFX.md
prompt:
15 秒、16:9。平成時代の真夏の日本の田舎を舞台にしたフォトリアルな実写映像と、輪郭線のみで構成されたチョークアニメーションを融合させた VFX 動画。少年の視点による、カットなしの完全なワンカット映像。

[実写スペース]
真夏の午後。畳の部屋がある伝統的な日本家屋。色あせた襖と障子、乾いた木の柱、ちゃぶ台、蚊取り線香、ブラウン管テレビ、古い扇風機、壁掛けエアコン。奥のキッチンには古い白い冷蔵庫がある。

障子越しに差し込む強い夏の陽射し、湿った熱気、わずかな陽炎。1990 年代のホームビデオカメラで撮影したような、色あせた夏の色味、ソフトなフィルムグレイン、光のにじみ、わずかな露出オーバー、フレームの揺れ。

[カメラ]
カメラは少年の目線の完全な POV。少年は手持ちカメラを持ち、畳の部屋からキッチンへと歩く。自然な手ブレ、呼吸に伴う上下動、アニメーションをわずかに遅れて追うパンや前進。

0 秒から 10 秒までは、少年の手、腕、顔、体は一切映さないこと。少年の右手は、10 秒以降に冷蔵庫を開ける際のみ一度だけ登場する。

[手描きアニメーションの絶対的スタイル]
アザラシ、ペンギン、ホッキョクグマは、ラフなチョークの輪郭線のみで描く。体の内部は完全に透明な空洞であり、動物の体を通して畳、壁、家具、冷蔵庫が常に見えている状態にする。

動物の内部を白や青で塗りつぶさないこと。不透明なシルエットは使用しないこと。体内に色、影、毛並み、立体的な肉感を描かないこと。動物は輪郭線、目となる小さな点、口となる短い線のみで表現する。

線は均一なデジタル線ではなく、太さが揺らぎ、途切れ、粉が飛び、フレームごとに描き直されるものとする。白、水色、濃い青のチョークの線を使用し、アクセントとして黄色やピンクの短い線を加える。

動物を塗りつぶすのではなく、無数の小さな線画を飛び回らせることで躍動感を出す。雪の結晶、泡、渦巻き、魚の輪郭、氷の欠片、星、波線、冷気の帯、スピード線が、異なるサイズと速度で前景、中景、背景を動く。画面全体に楽しげな動きがあるが、実写の部屋の風景が損なわれないようにする。

[0～4 秒：扇風機とアザラシ]
畳の上で古い扇風機が首を振っている。白と水色のチョーク線で描かれた冷気の渦が、羽根から次々と飛び出す。

空中で複数の渦の線が繋がり、輪郭線のみで構成された大きなアザラシへと連続的に変形する。アザラシの体は完全に透明で、背後の畳や襖が透けて見える。

アザラシは楽しげに空中を泳ぎ、体をくねらせながらカメラの周りを一周する。その後に、小さな魚の輪郭、泡、星、氷の粒子、波線の群れが続く。アザラシの尾からは複数のチョーク線の残像が伸びる。カメラはわずかに遅れてアザラシを追い、壁のエアコンへとパンする。

[4～8 秒：エアコンとペンギン]
アザラシがエアコンの前を通過すると、白と青のチョーク線で描かれた冷気が吹き出し口から噴き出す。

冷気の線は滑らかに、輪郭線のみで構成された 5 羽のペンギンへと変形する。すべてのペンギンは体が透明で、背景の壁や家具が見える。

5 羽のペンギンは同じサイズではなく、前景に 1 羽、中景に 3 羽、背景に 1 羽を配置する。それぞれが水中を泳ぐように、異なる高さと速度で部屋を飛び回る。1 羽は回転し、2 羽は交差し、1 羽はテーブルの下をくぐり、1 羽はカメラのすぐ横を素早く通り過ぎる。

ペンギンの周りには、雪の結晶、泡、渦巻き、魚の輪郭、リボン状の冷気、細かいスピード線が大量に流れる。冷気の中で風鈴、のれん、蚊取り線香の煙が揺れる。カメラはペンギンを追い、襖を通ってキッチンへと入る。

[8～10 秒：冷蔵庫への移動]
5 羽のペンギンとアザラシがキッチンに入り、古い白い冷蔵庫の周りを旋回する。動物の透明な輪郭線が冷蔵庫の前や後ろを横切り、正しいオクルージョン（遮蔽）と奥行きを作り出す。

青いチョークの矢印、雪の結晶、魚の輪郭が冷蔵庫の取っ手に向かって集まる。カメラは冷蔵庫の前で停止する。この時点まで、少年の手や体は一切映らない。

[10～12 秒：少年が冷蔵庫を開ける]
初めて、日焼けした少年の細い右手と腕だけが画面下部から入ってくる。手には 5 本の自然な指があり、古い冷蔵庫の取っ手を正しく掴む。

少年が手前にドアを引く。POV カメラはドアの重みに合わせてわずかに傾く。少年の顔、左手、胴体、足は映らない。冷蔵庫は自動で開かない。

[12～15 秒：ホッキョクグマとかき氷]
冷蔵庫からの青みがかった実写の光が、キッチンと少年の手を照らす。

冷蔵庫の中には、輪郭線のみで描かれた丸いホッキョクグマが座っている。ホッキョクグマの体は完全に透明で、体を通して冷蔵庫の棚や食品が見える。

ホッキョクグマを塗りつぶさないこと。一方で、目の前のガラスボウルに入ったかき氷は、鮮やかな水色と青のチョーク線を重ねて高密度に描き、キラキラと輝いているように見せる。透明なホッキョクグマと鮮やかなかき氷の対比を作る。

最初はホッキョクグマが下を向き、スプーンでかき氷を食べている。冷蔵庫が開いた音に反応してスプーンが途中で止まる。一瞬の静止の後、ゆっくりと顔を上げ、最後にカメラと目が合う。口の周りには、かき氷の跡である水色のチョークの痕跡がある。

その瞬間、冷蔵庫の周りからアザラシと 5 羽のペンギンが一斉に顔を出す。雪の結晶、魚、泡、星、渦巻き、冷気のリボンが画面中に弾け飛ぶ。ただし、すべて輪郭線と細かい落書きのような線であり、動物の体は透明なままである。

少年の手は取っ手を掴んだままである。ホッキョクグマと少年の視線が合うと、冷たい白い空気がレンズに向かって流れ込み、フレームの端がわずかに曇って終了する。

[オーディオ]
BGM、ナレーション、会話はなし。遠くの蝉の声、古い扇風機のモーター音、風鈴の音、畳を歩く足音、衣擦れの音、エアコンの作動音、冷蔵庫のドアの音、冷蔵庫内の小さな機械音。

手描きアニメーションに合わせて、紙の上を走るチョークの軽い音、冷気、泡、水しぶき、小さな氷の粒が触れ合う涼しげな音を同期させる。最後に、ホッキョクグマのスプーンがガラスボウルに触れる小さな音を強調する。

[厳格な要件]
最後までワンカットの POV を維持すること。動物の体の内部はすべてのフレームで完全に透明にすること（白、青、黒などで塗りつぶさない）。不透明なシルエット、塗りつぶしのセルルック、実写の動物、3DCG の動物、立体的な毛並みに変形させないこと。

0 秒から 10 秒までは、少年の手や体を絶対に映さないこと。10 秒以降に少年の右手で冷蔵庫を開けること。ホッキョクグマは最初からカメラを見ず、かき氷からゆっくりと顔を上げること。

カット、シーンの切り替え、テレポート、字幕、テキスト、ロゴ、透かし、BGM は一切追加しないこと。

variants.text:
15 秒，16:9。一段 VFX 视频，将平成时代盛夏日本乡村的写实真人镜头与仅由轮廓组成的粉笔动画相结合。这是一个从男孩视角出发的完整单镜头视频，没有任何剪辑。

[真人实拍空间]
盛夏午后。一间带有榻榻米的传统木屋。褪色的推拉门（袄和障子）、干燥的木柱、矮桌（茶几）、蚊香、显像管电视、旧电风扇和壁挂式空调。后方的厨房里有一个老式白色冰箱。

强烈的夏日阳光透过障子射入，空气湿热，带有轻微的热浪。褪色的夏日色调、柔和的胶片颗粒感、轻微的色彩溢出、略微的过曝以及画面抖动，仿佛是用 1990 年代的家用摄像机拍摄的。

[摄像机]
摄像机为男孩视线高度的完整 POV。男孩手持摄像机从榻榻米房间走向厨房。自然的摄像机抖动、伴随呼吸的垂直起伏，以及略有延迟地跟随动画的平移/推进。

0 到 10 秒内，完全不要出现男孩的手、手臂、脸部或身体。男孩的右手仅在 10 秒后打开冰箱时出现一次。

[手绘动画的绝对风格]
海豹、企鹅和北极熊仅用粗糙的粉笔轮廓绘制。身体内部完全透明中空，因此透过动物的身体始终可以看到榻榻米、墙壁、家具和冰箱。

不要用白色或蓝色填充动物。不要使用不透明的剪影。不要在身体内部绘制颜色、阴影、皮毛或三维肉体。仅用轮廓、代表眼睛的小圆点和代表嘴巴的短线来表现动物。

线条不是统一的数字线条；它们在粗细上抖动、断裂、掉落粉尘，并且每一帧都重新绘制。使用白色、浅蓝色和深蓝色的粉笔线条，并辅以少量黄色和粉色的点缀线条。

创造生动感不是通过给动物上色，而是通过大量飞舞的小线条绘图。雪花、气泡、螺旋、鱼的轮廓、冰块碎片、星星、波浪线、冷风丝带和速度线在前景、中景和背景中以不同的大小和速度移动。整个画面充满了欢快的动感，但真人实拍的房间质感并未丢失。

[0-4 秒：风扇与海豹]
一台旧风扇在榻榻米上摆动。由白色和浅蓝色粉笔线条组成的冷空气漩涡从扇叶中不断飞出。

几条漩涡线在空中连接，并持续变换成一只仅由轮廓组成的大海豹。海豹的身体完全透明，露出了身后的榻榻米和袄。

海豹在空中欢快地游动，扭动着身体绕摄像机转了一圈。随后是一群小鱼轮廓、气泡、星星、冰粒和波浪线。多条粉笔线条残影从海豹的尾部延伸出来。摄像机略有延迟地跟随海豹，并向墙上的空调平移。

[4-8 秒：空调与企鹅]
当海豹经过空调前方时，白色和蓝色粉笔线条组成的冷空气从通风口喷涌而出。

冷空气线条平滑地变换成 5 只仅由轮廓组成的企鹅。所有企鹅的身体都是透明的，显示出背景中的墙壁和家具。

这 5 只企鹅大小不一；将一只大的放在前景，三只在中景，一只小的在后方。每一只都以不同的高度和速度穿过房间，仿佛在水下游泳。一只旋转，两只交叉，一只从桌子底下穿过，还有一只从摄像机旁边快速掠过。

在企鹅周围，雪花、气泡、螺旋、鱼的轮廓、丝带状的冷风和细小的速度线大量流动。风铃、暖帘和蚊香烟雾在冷风中摇曳。摄像机跟随企鹅穿过袄进入厨房。

[8-10 秒：移动至冰箱]
5 只企鹅和海豹进入厨房，绕着老式白色冰箱盘旋。动物透明的轮廓在冰箱前后穿梭，形成了正确的遮挡关系和深度感。

蓝色粉笔箭头、雪花和鱼的轮廓向冰箱把手汇聚。摄像机在冰箱前停下。直到此处，完全没有出现男孩的手或身体。

[10-12 秒：男孩打开冰箱]
这是第一次，只有真人男孩那只晒黑的纤细右手臂和手从屏幕底部伸入。手有 5 根自然的手指，准确地抓住了旧冰箱的把手。

男孩将门向自己拉开。POV 摄像机随门的力量略微倾斜。男孩的脸、左手、躯干和腿部均未显示。冰箱不会自动打开。

[12-15 秒：北极熊与刨冰]
来自冰箱的蓝色真人实拍光线照亮了厨房和男孩的手。

冰箱内，一只仅由轮廓绘制的圆滚滚的北极熊正坐着。北极熊的身体完全透明，透过身体可以看到冰箱的隔板和食物。

不要填充北极熊。另一方面，它面前玻璃碗里的刨冰用密集的鲜艳浅蓝色和蓝色粉笔线条描绘，使其看起来闪闪发光。在透明的北极熊和充满活力的刨冰之间形成对比。

起初，北极熊低着头，用勺子吃着刨冰。听到冰箱打开的声音，勺子停在半空中。静止片刻后，它缓慢抬头，最终与摄像机对视。它的嘴边有一些浅蓝色的粉笔刨冰痕迹。

那一刻，海豹和 5 只企鹅同时从冰箱周围探出头来。雪花、鱼、气泡、星星、螺旋和冷风丝带在屏幕上迸发。然而，所有这些都是轮廓和细小的涂鸦线条，动物的身体保持透明。

男孩的手依然抓着把手。当北极熊和男孩的目光对齐时，冷白色的空气流向镜头，画面边缘略微起雾，视频结束。

[音频]
没有背景音乐、旁白或对话。远处蝉鸣、旧风扇电机声、风铃声、榻榻米上的脚步声、衣服摩擦声、空调运行声、冰箱门声以及冰箱内部的小型机械声。

将手绘动画与粉笔在纸上划过的轻微声响、冷风声、气泡声、水花声以及小冰粒碰撞的清凉声同步。最后，强调北极熊的勺子触碰玻璃碗的细微声音。

[严格要求]
保持 POV 为单镜头直至结束。每一帧中动物身体内部必须完全透明；不要填充白色、蓝色、黑色等。不要变换为不透明的剪影、实心赛璐珞渲染、真人动物、3DCG 动物或三维皮毛。

0 到 10 秒内绝对不要显示男孩的手或身体。10 秒后用男孩的右手打开冰箱。北极熊起初不看摄像机；它从刨冰中缓慢抬头。

不要添加剪辑、场景转场、瞬间移动、字幕、文字、Logo、水印或背景音乐。

variants.text:
15 seconds, 16:9. A VFX video blending photorealistic live-action footage set in rural Japan during the Heisei era midsummer with chalk animations consisting only of outlines. A complete one-cut video from the perspective of a boy, without any cuts.

[Live-Action Space]
A midsummer afternoon. A traditional wooden house with a tatami room. Faded sliding doors (fusuma and shoji), dry wooden pillars, a low table (chabudai), mosquito coils, a CRT TV, an old electric fan, and a wall-mounted AC. In the kitchen at the back, there is an old white refrigerator.

Strong summer sunlight through the shoji, humid hot air, and slight heat haze. Faded summer colors, soft film grain, light color bleeding, slight overexposure, and frame jitters, as if shot with a 1990s home film camera.

[Camera]
The camera is a complete POV at a boy's eye level. The boy walks from the tatami room to the kitchen holding a handheld camera. Natural camera shake, vertical movement accompanying breathing, and pans/advancements that follow the animation with a slight delay.

From 0 to 10 seconds, do not show the boy's hands, arms, face, or body at all. The boy's right hand only appears once after 10 seconds when opening the refrigerator.

[Absolute Style for Hand-Drawn Animation]
Seals, penguins, and polar bears are drawn only with rough chalk outlines. The inside of the body is a completely transparent hollow, so the tatami, walls, furniture, and refrigerator are always visible through the animals' bodies.

Do not fill animals with white or blue. Do not use opaque silhouettes. Do not draw color, shading, fur, or three-dimensional flesh inside the body. Represent animals only with outlines, small dots for eyes, and short lines for mouths.

Lines are not uniform digital lines; they jitter in thickness, break, drop dust, and are redrawn every frame. Use white, light blue, and dark blue chalk lines, with some small yellow and pink accent lines.

Create liveliness not by coloring animals, but with a large number of small line drawings flying around. Snowflakes, bubbles, spirals, fish outlines, ice fragments, stars, wavy lines, cold wind ribbons, and speed lines move in foreground, middle ground, and background at different sizes and speeds. There is joyful movement throughout the screen, but the live-action room is not lost.

[0-4 Seconds: Fan and Seal]
An old fan is oscillating on the tatami. Vortices of cold air made of white and light blue chalk lines fly out one after another from the blades.

Several vortex lines connect in the air and continuously transform into a large seal consisting only of outlines. The seal's body is completely transparent, revealing the tatami and fusuma behind it.

The seal swims joyfully in the air, wriggling its body as it circles the camera once. It is followed by a swarm of small fish outlines, bubbles, stars, ice particles, and wavy lines. Multiple chalk line afterimages extend from the seal's tail. The camera follows the seal with a slight delay and pans toward the AC on the wall.

[4-8 Seconds: AC and Penguins]
As the seal passes in front of the AC, cold air in white and blue chalk lines gushes out from the vent.

The cold air lines smoothly transform into 5 penguins consisting only of outlines. All penguins have transparent bodies, showing the walls and furniture in the background.

The 5 penguins are not the same size; place one large one in the foreground, three in the middle ground, and one small one in the back. Each flies through the room at different heights and speeds as if swimming underwater. One rotates, two cross each other, one goes under the table, and one passes quickly right next to the camera.

Around the penguins, snowflakes, bubbles, spirals, fish outlines, ribbon-like cold winds, and fine speed lines flow in large quantities. Wind chimes, noren curtains, and mosquito coil smoke sway in the cold wind. The camera follows the penguins through the fusuma into the kitchen.

[8-10 Seconds: Movement to Refrigerator]
The 5 penguins and the seal enter the kitchen and circle around the old white refrigerator. The transparent outlines of the animals cross in front and behind the refrigerator, creating correct occlusion and depth.

Blue chalk arrows, snowflakes, and fish outlines gather toward the refrigerator handle. The camera stops in front of the refrigerator. Until this point, the boy's hands or body are not shown at all.

[10-12 Seconds: Boy Opens Refrigerator]
For the first time, only the thin tanned right arm and hand of the live-action boy enter from the bottom of the screen. The hand has 5 natural fingers and correctly grasps the handle of the old refrigerator.

The boy pulls the door open toward him. The POV camera tilts slightly to match the weight of the door. The boy's face, left hand, torso, and legs are not shown. The refrigerator does not open automatically.

[12-15 Seconds: Polar Bear and Shaved Ice]
The bluish live-action light from the refrigerator illuminates the kitchen and the boy's hand.

Inside the refrigerator, a round polar bear drawn only with outlines is sitting. The polar bear's body is completely transparent, showing the refrigerator shelves and food through its body.

Do not fill the polar bear. On the other hand, the shaved ice in the glass bowl in front of it is depicted with high density using layers of vivid light blue and blue chalk lines, making it look sparkling. Create a contrast between the transparent polar bear and the vibrant shaved ice.

Initially, the polar bear is looking down, eating shaved ice with a spoon. The spoon stops halfway at the sound of the refrigerator opening. After a moment of stillness, it slowly looks up and finally makes eye contact with the camera. There are some light blue chalk traces of shaved ice around its mouth.

At that moment, the seal and 5 penguins peek out all at once from around the refrigerator. Snowflakes, fish, bubbles, stars, spirals, and cold wind ribbons burst across the screen. However, all are outlines and fine scribble lines, and the animals' bodies remain transparent.

The boy's hand remains grasping the handle. When the gazes of the polar bear and the boy align, cold white air flows toward the lens, and the edges of the frame fog up slightly to end.

[Audio]
No BGM, narration, or conversation. Sounds of distant cicadas, the old fan motor, wind chimes, footsteps on tatami, rustling clothes, the AC operating, the refrigerator door, and small mechanical sounds inside the refrigerator.

Synchronize hand-drawn animation with light sounds of chalk running on paper, cold wind, bubbles, splashes, and cool sounds of small ice particles touching. Finally, emphasize the small sound of the polar bear's spoon touching the glass bowl.

[Strict Requirements]
Maintain the same POV as a one-cut until the end. Make the interior of animal bodies completely transparent in every frame; do not fill with white, blue, black, etc. Do not transform into opaque silhouettes, solid cel-shading, live-action animals, 3DCG animals, or three-dimensional fur.

Do not add cuts, scene transitions, teleportation, subtitles, text, logos, watermarks, or BGM.

10.1-12.6 秒：斜め後ろからの屋外中広角ショットに切り替え、以降カットは変更しません。主人公は通路から脇に逸れて様子を見ます。匿名の歩行者が 1 人、主人公を通り過ぎて入り口に向かい、入り口はその歩行者に対してのみ作動して中に入れます。主人公は追ったり近づいたりしません。歩行者が通り過ぎた直後、入り口は主人公を無視して BLOCKED-STATE に戻ります。主人公はこれをはっきりと目撃します。

[サウンド]
開始から軽快でコミカルな BGM。横移動から加速し、最後の訴えでピークに達します。各漫画的演出に合わせて風や衝撃音を同期させます。歩行者のために入り口が作動する瞬間だけ BGM を落とし、作動音を強調します。入り口が BLOCKED-STATE に戻った後に短い休止を入れます。最後の全身での嘆きとカメラの引きに合わせて、一息で叫びます。
単一の持続する非言語的な叫び：「あーーっ！」

[参考定义]
@image1 是角色设定图 00_Shared_Live_Action_Character_Sheet_v6。请使用 01 FRONT、02 SIDE、03 BACK 和 05 FACE 作为主要参考来固定人物，在所有镜头中保持面部、发型、年龄感、肤色、体型、比例、服装和鞋子的一致性。04 SPECIAL LOOK 是用于参考人物神态和姿势的补充资料，不用于构图或背景。06 BUILDING REFERENCE 仅提供建筑正面、入口位置/类型、连续地面、从广场到入口的路径以及广角构图的结构参考。忽略 06 中的时间、光线、色调、用途和细节；以文字描述为准。在整个过程中保持 06 中显示的入口类型。MAIN-CHARACTER = @image1 中的人物。AUTO-ENTRANCE = 06 底部中央的一个自动玻璃入口。BLOCKED-STATE = 主角无法通过的初始状态。请勿在视频中复现设定图中的白色背景、分割线、文字、多重显示或参考框。

[视频条件]
15 秒，1:1 比例，适合分享，高质量真人电影感喜剧。明亮的白天，光线清晰，宽阔的户外广场，干净的现代建筑。全程从户外侧拍摄；不要进入室内或透过玻璃拍摄。室内大厅始终位于入口后方，主角始终位于摄像机和入口之间。
中间部分使用短促的残影、风压、星形闪光（白转黄，带黑色边框）、放射线、冲击帧和夸张的音效。所有这些均为剪辑表现手法，而非实际魔法。

[镜头流程]
0.0-0.8s：基于 06 的自然广角长镜头，展示一个建筑正面、连续地面和一个入口。保持直线和垂直线；无鱼眼、曲率或极端的广角畸变。摄像机固定在户外广场侧主角的正后方，保持不动。入口从第一帧起即处于 BLOCKED-STATE。主角在底部中央为中远景全身，完全背对镜头。自然背向全身，展示后脑勺、背部、服装背面、手臂、腿部和脚后跟，不露出面部或胸部。身体、脚尖和方向均朝向中心远处的入口。主角向入口走去，缩短距离；不转向摄像机，也不走模特步。
0.8-2.4s：从主角户外斜后方的广角全身镜头，同时展示背部和入口。主角径直走向入口。即使进入感应范围，入口也没有激活或打开。主角在入口前突然停下。
2.4-3.8s：户外侧广角全身镜头。主角困惑地在入口和感应器之间张望，转向广场一侧，并向远离入口的方向移动 2-3 米，以腾出表演空间。
3.8-5.7s：以入口为背景的正面广角全身镜头。主角面向摄像机，快速向左、中、右、中移动。每次改变方向时同步一个星形闪光或冲击线、短促残影、脚步声和摩擦声。入口保持无响应。
5.7-7.7s：户外斜向全身镜头。三个高速连续动作：头顶挥手、蹲下抬头看感应器、双臂双腿大幅张开。每次转换插入一个星形闪光、放射线和短促的冲击帧，并与风声和冲击声同步。不要使面部、身体或服装变形。
7.7-10.1s：主角移动到距离入口 2 米开外，以 3/4 角度摆出夸张姿势。从前斜方户外侧高速推近。头发和服装因风压而摆动；比中间部分更强的集中线和大型冲击帧。不要向前移动；双手向感应器方向斜向上伸出。不要触碰入口；入口保持无响应。主角恢复面无表情。
10.1-12.6s：切换至斜后方户外中广角镜头；此后不再更换镜头。主角从路径旁移开并观察。一名匿名行人经过主角走向入口；入口仅为行人激活并让他们进入。主角没有跟随或靠近。行人通过后，入口立即忽略主角并回到 BLOCKED-STATE。主角清楚地目睹了这一过程。
12.6-15.0s：同一户外侧的连续镜头。主角意识到只有自己未被识别，随即转向摄像机。摄像机轻微变焦至胸部以上特写，展示一个滑稽的悲伤表情：双眼圆睁、挑眉、张嘴。随后，主角头顶双臂大幅张开，仰天长叹。摄像机快速后撤，以主角在 BLOCKED-STATE 入口前哀叹的全身广角镜头结束。在喊叫前或喊叫过程中不要重新激活入口。

[声音]
从开始起播放轻快、滑稽的背景音乐（BGM）。随侧向移动加速，并在最后的呼喊处达到顶峰。将风声和冲击声与每个漫画特效同步。仅在入口为行人激活时降低 BGM，以突出激活音效。在入口回到 BLOCKED-STATE 后留出短暂间隙。呼喊声需一气呵成，与最后的全身哀叹和摄像机后撤同步。
单一持续的非语言哭喊：“啊——！”
一个连续的开口元音 /aː/，没有额外音节，没有单词，也没有可识别的口语。

[负面提示]
避免黑屏、夜晚、黄昏、黑暗入口、狭窄开口、开门变焦、鱼眼、弯曲建筑、极端畸变、第 1 帧主角已停止、第 1 镜头露出面部/胸部、第 1 镜头主角面向摄像机、第 1 镜头主角从入口向摄像机走来、0.8-2.4s 从正面拍摄、0.0-2.4s 主角靠近摄像机、未朝向入口、省略靠近入口过程、开始时入口已打开、入口类型与 06 不同、场景中途结构改变、为主角激活、在行人前激活、行人通过后保持开启、喊叫前/中重新激活、室内拍摄、透过玻璃拍摄、进出反转、多名行人、主角跟随行人或重新靠近、触碰入口、碰撞、跌倒、人物/发型/服装/鞋子改变、克隆、分屏、复现设定图、文字、Logo、水印、实际魔法、省略中间特效、类语言发音、多音节、背对镜头长时间停顿、缓慢转身、在悲伤表情前摄像机后撤、以胸部以上特写结束。

A carrier-based fighter returns over rough open water with an apparent mechanical problem. The flight deck enters emergency recovery mode. Crew clear the landing area as the fighter approaches and lands safely.

00–03s — EMERGENCY
Wide handheld footage on an active carrier deck under heavy overcast skies.

Strong sea wind, grey ocean, wet worn deck.

06–09s — DECK SCRAMBLE

Personnel rapidly move equipment and take safe positions.

One crew member crosses foreground, briefly blocking the lens.

Camera pans toward the approaching fighter.

09–12s — TOUCHDOWN

Fighter touches down firmly.

Landing gear compresses, tyres produce a small realistic puff, aircraft rapidly decelerates.

Camera makes a fast imperfect pan following it.

No explosion or exaggerated sparks.

12–15s — SAFE STOP
Three-quarter handheld footage.

Aircraft reaches a controlled stop, engine still running and heat haze visible.

Crew cautiously approach, signal toward the cockpit and inspect the aircraft.

Hard cuts.
Reactive pans.
Foreground obstruction.
Autofocus corrections.
Telephoto compression.
Wind-induced micro-shake.
Natural motion blur.

Approach remains aligned with the carrier.
Landing gear compresses naturally.

prompt:
[条件定義]
参照画像なし。15 秒、1:1 スクエア、実写、シェア用、BGM あり。深夜の地下鉄駅を舞台にした、ハイクオリティでスリリングなシネマティック脱出動画。大雨により排水設備が破損し、ホーム側から大量の泥水が駅構内に流入している。最初のフレームから危機的状況を見せ、改札の飛び越え、シャッターの閉鎖、床の崩落、中盤の急旋回、巨大な濁流、垂直脱出、そして地上への最終離脱までを 15 秒以内に描き切る。単なる追いかけっこではなく、ステップごとに速度、画面の向き、カメラ位置、アクションの種類を切り替え、全体を通して明確なリズムを作る。

主人公は 25 歳の白人女性。長身で脚が長く、洗練されたモデルのような体型だが、不自然な誇張はない。ライトブラウンのセミロングヘアを低めの位置で結び、都会的で整った顔立ち。服装はスポーツウェアではなく、通勤や外出を想定した少しフォーマルな装い（バーガンディの細身のテーラードジャケット、白いブラウス、黒の細身のスラックス、黒のローヒールアンクルブーツ）。突然の危機の中で大胆なアクションを見せる、エレガントな女性とのギャップを強調する。バッグ、帽子、大きなアクセサリー、ロゴはなし。全カットを通して人物、髪型、服装を統一する。

駅構内の主な動線は左から右奥へ。5.9 秒地点で一度 90 度旋回し、脇のメンテナンス通路に入り、その先の緊急用シャフトへ向かう。最後に上方へ脱出。地上出口はシャフトの頂上に直結した、長方形のメンテナンス用開口部が 1 つあるのみ。カメラが切り替わっても、この位置関係と移動方向を維持すること。冒頭の改札飛び越えと、ラストの地上での濁流および巨大な水柱が 2 つの強いアクセントとなる。

[シーケンス設計]
0.0–1.2 秒：高めの対角線上のワイドオーバーヘッドショット。左奥のホームから泥水が噴出し、中央左の主人公が右奥の緊急シャフトに向かって走り始める。危機の発生源、主人公、脱出方向を 1 フレームで明確に示す。
1.2–3.0 秒：主人公と並走する低い対角線上のサイドカメラ。改札への高速接近を捉える。改札に激突するのではなく、直前で力強く跳躍し、全身を改札機の上へ明確に浮かせる。踏み切りからジャンプの頂点まで約 0.4 秒の短いスローモーションを使い、横から体と改札上の空間を鮮明に見せる。着地直前にリアルタイムに戻し、大きな着地音と共に再加速する。直後、背後の濁流が改札を破壊する。
3.0–4.5 秒：防水シャッターの向こう側に設置された低い固定カメラ。主人公は走りながら低いスライディングに移行し、急速に閉まるシャッターの最後の隙間を通り抜ける。つま先が通過した瞬間にシャッターが床に激突する。
4.5–5.9 秒：真上からの短いオーバーヘッドショット。背後から床が連続して崩落し、主人公は左下から右上へ方向転換し、残った床へ対角線上に飛び移る。最後に蹴った床タイルが直後に崩落する。
5.9–7.6 秒：巨大な天井看板が主人公の前方に斜めに落下し、道を塞ぎ始める。減速せず、落下直前に鋭角な 90 度のターンを決め、狭い脇のメンテナンス通路に飛び込む。通過した瞬間にカメラが高速ウィップパンを行い、方向転換を強調する。直後、巨大な看板が背後に激突し、元の道を完全に塞ぐ。
7.6–9.4 秒：緊急シャフトの基部を捉えた低い固定ワイドショット。到着した瞬間、背後のシャッターが水圧で破壊され、白い飛沫を上げた巨大な濁流が通路に押し寄せる。止まらずに最後の一歩で梯子に飛びつく。靴のすぐ下まで水が迫るニアミスを演出する。
9.4–11.5 秒：シャフトの頂上から真下を見下ろすカメラ。ジャンプの勢いを維持し、高速で梯子を登る。水位の上昇で距離が縮まる中、カメラも急速に上方へ引く。長方形のメンテナンス出口の頂上に到達し、縁に手をかけ、頭と肩が地上に出た瞬間にカット。
11.5–15.0 秒：夜の街の道路を捉えた低い広角ショット。白く逆光を受けた雨粒と、温かみのある街灯を明確に分離する。同じ長方形のメンテナンス出口から全身が飛び出し、濡れた路面に着地した瞬間から前方へ走り出す。立ち止まったり振り返ったりせず、脱出姿勢のまま離脱を続ける。直後、同じ開口部から高圧の巨大な水柱が垂直に噴出し、夜の街に白い飛沫が爆発する。彼女が前方または斜め前方に走り去る姿で終了。

[視覚および音響演出]
駅構内は明るくクリアなニュートラルホワイトの LED 照明をベースに、鮮やかなアンバーと赤の非常灯を加える。壁は明るいニュートラルグレー、金属は清潔なシルバー、濡れた床には鋭い反射があり、泥水には背景と分離させるために多くの白い泡と飛沫を含ませる。バーガンディのジャケット、白いブラウス、自然な温かみのある肌のトーンを明確に見せる。明るい露出、透明感のあるコントラスト、豊かなハイライト、シャープな色分離を優先する。
BGM は危機が高まるにつれて激しくなる、高速なシネマティックパーカッションを主軸とする。着地音、シャッターの衝撃音、看板の衝突音、濁流の侵入音、最後の水柱の噴出音は、BGM よりも前面に出すこと。

[禁止事項]
改札への激突、長いスローモーション、途中で人物や服装が変わる、同じ背後からの追跡ショットの繰り返し、状況が判別できない暗闇、青緑色に沈んだ低彩度な映像、脱出後の停止や長い余韻、救助隊や他の主要キャラクターの追加。

variants.text:
[条件定义]
无参考图。15 秒，1:1 正方形，真人实拍，适合分享，带背景音乐。一段高质量、惊险刺激的电影感逃生视频，背景设定在午夜的地铁站。大雨损坏了排水设施，大量浑浊的泥水正从站台一侧涌入车站。视频从第一帧开始展现危机，清晰描绘 15 秒内跳过检票闸机、关闭闸门、地面塌陷、中间急转弯障碍、巨大洪流、垂直逃生以及最终冲出地面。不要仅仅是持续奔跑的序列，要通过分步改变速度、画面方向、摄像机位置和动作类型，在全片中营造出清晰的节奏感。

主角是一名 25 岁的白人女性。她身材高挑，腿部修长，体态纤细且具有高级感，但不过分夸张。她留着浅棕色中长发，向后低扎，五官都市感强且轮廓分明。她的穿着是适合日常通勤或外出的微正式装束：酒红色修身西装外套、白色衬衫、黑色修身西裤和黑色低跟踝靴。强调一位优雅的都市女性在突发危机中展现出大胆动作的反差感，而非穿着运动装。没有包袋、帽子、大型配饰或 Logo。在所有镜头中保持人物、发型和服装的一致性。

站内的主要动线是从左后方到右后方。在 5.9 秒时，进行一次 90 度转弯，进入侧面的维修通道，以到达后方的紧急竖井。最后向上逃生。地面出口是一个连接竖井顶部的单开矩形维修口。即使在镜头切换时，也要保持这种位置关系和运动方向。开头的跳闸机动作和结尾地面的洪流及巨大水柱是两个强有力的视觉重点。

[序列设计]
0.0–1.2 秒。高位对角线广角俯拍。浑浊的泥水从左后方站台涌出，位于中左侧的主角开始向右后方的紧急竖井奔跑。在一个画面中清晰展示危机源头、主角和逃生方向。
1.2–3.0 秒。低位对角线侧拍镜头与主角平行移动一小段时间，捕捉她快速接近检票闸机的过程。她没有撞上闸机，而是在闸机前强力起跳，整个人清晰地越过闸机。从起跳到跳跃最高点使用约 0.4 秒的短慢动作，从侧面清晰展示她的身体和闸机上方的空间。落地前瞬间恢复实时速度，并伴随沉重的落地声同时加速。紧接着，身后的洪流摧毁了闸机。
3.0–4.5 秒。放置在防水闸门后的低位固定镜头。主角从奔跑转为低姿滑行，穿过正在快速下降的闸门最后缝隙。在她脚尖通过的瞬间，闸门重重砸在地板上。
4.5–5.9 秒。近乎正上方的短俯拍。地板从身后持续塌陷；主角改变方向，从左下向右上对角线跳跃到剩余的地板上。她踢到的最后一块地砖随即塌陷。
5.9–7.6 秒。一块巨大的天花板指示牌在主角前方斜向坠落，开始阻挡路径。她没有减速，而是在坠落前瞬间做出 90 度急转弯，冲入狭窄的侧面维修通道。在她通过的瞬间，摄像机进行高速甩镜头，强烈表现出方向的改变。紧接着，巨大的指示牌在她身后坠毁，彻底封死了原路径。
7.6–9.4 秒。捕捉紧急竖井底部的低位固定广角镜头。她到达的瞬间，身后的闸门被水压冲毁，巨大的洪流夹杂着白色浪花涌入通道。她没有停顿，最后一步跳上梯子。营造出水面刚好没过她鞋底的千钧一发感。
9.4–11.5 秒。从竖井顶部垂直向下拍摄。她保持跳跃的惯性，高速攀爬梯子。随着水位上升缩短距离，摄像机也快速向上拉远。她到达单开矩形维修出口顶部，双手撑住边缘，在她的头部和肩膀露出地面的瞬间切换镜头。
11.5–15.0 秒。捕捉中性夜色路面的低位广角镜头。清晰区分被白色背光的雨滴和温暖的路灯。她整个人从同一个矩形维修出口冲出，落地瞬间即开始向前奔跑。她没有停下或回头，保持逃生姿态继续离开。紧接着，一股高压巨大水柱从同一个出口垂直喷涌而出，白色浪花在夜色街道上炸开。以她向前方或斜前方奔跑离开的画面结束。

[视觉与音频指导]
车站内部基于明亮、清晰的中性白 LED 灯光，并增加了生动的琥珀色和红色应急灯。墙壁为明亮的中性灰，金属为干净的银色，湿润的地板有强烈的反射，浑浊的水中包含许多白色气泡和浪花，以与背景区分。清晰展示她的酒红色外套、白色衬衫和自然的暖色肤色。在分享视频中优先考虑明亮的曝光、通透的对比度、丰富的高光和强烈的色彩分离。
背景音乐主要为高节奏的电影感打击乐，随着危机升级而增强。落地声、闸门撞击声、指示牌撞击声、洪流涌入声以及最终水柱喷发声应在背景音乐之上突出表现。

[负面提示]
撞上检票闸机、长时间慢动作、中途更换人物或服装、重复相同的后方跟随镜头、无法辨别情况的黑暗画面、沉闷的蓝绿色低饱和度图像、逃生后停顿或长时间的留白镜头、添加救援队或其他主要角色。

variants.text:
[CONDITION DEFINITION]
No reference image. 15 seconds, 1:1 square, live-action, for sharing, with BGM. A high-quality, thrilling cinematic escape video set in a subway station at midnight. Heavy rain has damaged drainage facilities, and a large amount of muddy water is flowing into the station from the platform side. The video shows the crisis from the first frame, clearly depicting jumping over the ticket gate, closing shutters, collapsing floors, sharp turn obstacles in the middle, massive torrents of water, vertical escape, and final departure onto the ground within 15 seconds. Rather than just a continuous running sequence, change speed, screen direction, camera position, and action types step-by-step to create a clear rhythm throughout.

The protagonist is a 25-year-old white female. She is tall with long legs and a slender, sophisticated model-like physique, but not unnaturally exaggerated. Her light-brown semi-long hair is tied back low, and she has urban, well-defined features. Her clothing is a slightly formal outfit for normal commuting or outings: a burgundy slim tailored jacket, a white blouse, black slim slacks, and black low-heel ankle boots. Emphasize the gap of an ordinary elegant woman showing bold action in a sudden crisis, rather than wearing sportswear. No bags, hats, large accessories, or logos. Maintain the same person, hairstyle, and outfit across all cuts.

The main movement line inside the station is from left to right back. At 5.9 seconds, make a 90-degree turn once into a side maintenance passage to reach the emergency shaft beyond. Finally, escape upwards. The ground exit is a single open rectangular maintenance exit connected to the top of the shaft. Maintain this positional relationship and movement direction even if the camera cuts. The ticket gate jump at the beginning and the torrent and massive water column on the ground at the end serve as two strong accents.

[SEQUENCE DESIGN]
0.0–1.2s. High diagonal wide overhead shot. Muddy water gushes from the platform at the back left, and the protagonist in the center-left starts running toward the emergency shaft at the back right. Clearly show the crisis origin, protagonist, and escape direction in one frame.
1.2–3.0s. Low diagonal side camera runs parallel to the protagonist for a short time, capturing her fast approach to the ticket gate. She doesn't crash into the gate but jumps strongly just before it, lifting her entire body clearly over the turnstiles. Use a short slow-motion for about 0.4s from takeoff to the peak of the jump to clearly show her body and the space above the gate from the side. Return to real-time just before landing, re-accelerating simultaneously with a loud landing sound. Immediately after, the torrent behind destroys the gate.
3.0–4.5s. Low fixed camera placed beyond a waterproof shutter. The protagonist transitions from running into a low slide, passing through the final gap of the rapidly descending shutter. The shutter crashes into the floor the moment her toes pass.
4.5–5.9s. Short overhead shot nearly from above. The floor collapses continuously from behind; the protagonist switches direction from bottom-left to top-right and jumps diagonally to the remaining floor. The last floor tile she kicks collapses immediately after.
5.9–7.6s. A massive ceiling sign falls diagonally in front of the protagonist, starting to block the path. She doesn't slow down but makes a sharp 90-degree turn just before it falls, diving into a narrow side maintenance passage. The camera does a high-speed whip pan the moment she passes, strongly showing the change in direction. Immediately after, the huge sign crashes behind her, completely blocking the original path.
7.6–9.4s. Low fixed wide shot capturing the base of the emergency shaft. The moment she arrives, the shutter behind is destroyed by water pressure, and a massive torrent with white spray bursts into the passage. She doesn't stop, jumping onto the ladder with her last step. Make it a near-miss where the water reaches just below her shoes.
9.4–11.5s. Camera looking straight down from the top of the shaft. She maintains the momentum of the jump and climbs the ladder at high speed. The camera also pulls back rapidly upwards as the rising water level narrows the distance. She reaches the top of the single rectangular maintenance exit, places her hands on the edge, and the cut happens the moment her head and shoulders emerge on the ground.
11.5–15.0s. Low wide-angle shot capturing neutral night-colored ground road. Clearly separate rain droplets backlit in white from warm streetlights. Her whole body bursts out from the same rectangular maintenance exit, starting to run forward from the moment she lands on the wet road. She doesn't stop or look back, continuing her departure in an escape posture. Immediately after, a high-pressure massive water column gushes vertically from the same opening, with white spray exploding onto the night street. End with her already departing toward the front or diagonal front while running.

[VISUAL AND AUDIO DIRECTION]
The station interior is based on bright, clear neutral-white LED lighting with vivid amber and red emergency lights added. Walls are bright neutral grey, metal is clean silver, the wet floor has sharp reflections, and the muddy water contains many white bubbles and spray to separate from the background. Clearly show her burgundy jacket, white blouse, and natural warm skin tone. Prioritize bright exposure, transparent contrast, rich highlights, and sharp color separation for the shared video.
The BGM is primarily high-speed cinematic percussion, intensifying as the crisis escalates. Sound effects for landing, shutter impact, sign impact, torrent intrusion, and the final water column burst should be brought forward over the BGM.

[NEGATIVE]
Crashing into ticket gates, long slow-motion, changing into a different person or outfit mid-way, repeating the same rear-following shot, darkness where the situation cannot be identified, low-saturation images sunken in blue-green, stopping after escape or long lingering shots, adding rescue teams or other major characters.

スタイル：明確な 2 ～ 3 段階の影と多層的なハイライトを備えた高密度な 3D セルルックシェーディング。レザー、金属、樹脂などの素材には明確な質感を適用すること。屋上には制御された反射を表現すること。映画品質の精度を維持し、一般的な 3D やリアルな質感との混在は避けること。

ステージ：雨上がりの夜の超高層ビルの屋上。L 字型のルートには、低い長方形のダクト、右側の垂直な壁、屋根間の隙間、着地点を配置すること。濡れた床に映るネオンの反射は、キャラクターの色味と調和させること。

パルクールアクション：キャラクターは全速力で走行。ダクトをコングボルトで飛び越える（両手のひらを同時に付き、膝を腕の間に引き寄せる）。着地せずに空中で右側の壁に向かって方向転換。壁を一度だけ蹴って（ウォールラン／キック）90 度旋回し、屋根の隙間を飛び越える。反対側に正確に着地し（右足、続いて左足）、そのままスプリントへ移行すること。

Its inner color pulses outward in uneven emotional waves, while its outline tears away in multiple directions. The background bends around the figure like soft paper under pressure. Fine hand-drawn textures crawl across the surface faster than the main form moves, creating tension between body and skin. [1.5-3s] The detached outlines accelerate and become nervous thread-like forms. The figure's color core stretches into sharp ribbons and liquid stains simultaneously. Empty spaces between moving parts ignite into new shapes, as if the composition is creating forms to fill its own emotional gaps. [3-4.5s] All forms suddenly surge diagonally across the frame. One large shape folds over itself like fabric, but the fold reveals a completely different texture beneath: grain, chalk, wet ink, and scraped paint all visible at once. The background follows the fold, twisting into a new color field. Smaller forms are dragged behind the motion, stretching into speed lines that remain alive and continue transforming. [4.5-6s] The composition fractures into several emotional forces: one calm, one violent, one fragile, one ecstatic. Each force pulls color from the others. Shadows appear before the objects that cast them, moving ahead like predictions. Original forms chase their own shadows, but the shadows mutate faster, becoming brighter, thicker, and more dominant than the objects. [6-7.5s] A rapid chain reaction begins. Every collision between forms produces a new motif taken from the references: fragments, symbols, textures, silhouettes, stains, lines, and color fields. These new motifs immediately accelerate in different directions. Trails do not simply fade — they harden into new bodies, then melt again, then split into smaller emotional echoes. [7.5-9s] The entire frame compresses toward a single invisible point near the lower center. All lines, colors, textures, shadows, and background layers squeeze inward at different speeds. Hold maximum compression for one single frame. Then everything explodes upward and outward with vertical smears, wobbling contours, and overshooting motion. Each element lands in a new position but continues vibrating from impact. [9-10.5s] Textures begin migrating between forms like exchanged emotions. A rough dry texture enters a fluid form, making it move in broken angular steps. A liquid texture enters a rigid form, causing it to sag, drip, and breathe. A glowing color texture passes into the background, making the entire environment pulse. Every form changes behavior based on the texture it receives. [10.5-12s] A cascade of rotations crosses the frame. Each form flips, twists, or turns inside out, revealing a hidden back face with a dramatically different color and emotional quality. Revealed faces reach toward neighboring forms like hands, hooks, flames, or waves. When touched, the next form rotates immediately, continuing the cascade faster and faster until the entire frame has transformed into a new emotional world. [12-13.5s] Boundaries dissolve everywhere at once. Forms merge, reject each other, separate, then merge again. New hybrid shapes inherit colors, textures, and motion behaviors from their parents but never become identical to them. The background no longer sits behind the forms — it becomes one of the forms, pushing forward, swallowing edges, and releasing new figures from within itself. [13.5-15s] Every previous process returns simultaneously at maximum speed: outlines detach, colors seep and drip, textures migrate, shadows lead, forms chase, trails solidify, hidden faces rotate, boundaries dissolve, backgrounds fold, and hybrid shapes multiply. Each element performs multiple transformations at once. STYLE: Cozy coffee-prep vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments. Focus on satisfying sounds: bean grinder whirring, portafilter tamping, steam wand hissing, cup clinking, milk frothing.
SUBJECT: Young man in his mid-20s, plain t-shirt, hair slightly tousled, minimal accessories. Calm, focused energy while making his morning coffee.
SETTING: Small kitchen counter with an espresso machine on a bright morning. Natural daylight, coffee beans and a mug nearby, quiet atmosphere.
STORYBOARD:
→ (3s, propped medium shot) Places camera on the counter, switches on the machine. "Morning coffee, the proper way."
→ (3s, overhead shot) Grinds fresh coffee beans, fine grounds falling into the portafilter.
→ (3s, close-up) Tamps the grounds down firmly and evenly.
→ (3s, handheld shot) Locks the portafilter into the machine. "Here we go."
→ (3s, detail shot) Espresso streams slowly into a small cup. No dialogue.
→ (3s, medium shot) Pours cold milk into a small steel pitcher. "Time for the milk."
→ (3s, macro shot) Steam wand hissing as it froths the milk.
→ (3s, propped shot) Pours frothed milk carefully over the espresso, forming light layers.
→ (3s, warm ending shot) Holds the finished cup, takes a small sip, satisfied smile. "That's exactly what I needed."
→ (3s, final shot) Reaches toward camera, still holding the cup. "See you later." Hand covers lens as recording ends.
AUDIO NOTES: Natural kitchen ambience — grinder whirring, tamping, steam hissing, milk pouring should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual.
REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine focused smiles, occasional careful pauses while pouring, imperfect framing, focus breathing, bright morning light shifts. Should resemble a genuine personal coffee vlog on a consumer camcorder, not a commercial or AI-generated production.

[撮影、カラー、サウンド]

The explorer accelerates toward a series of towering rock pillars rising from the valley floor.

The camera swings naturally with every movement, maintaining one fluid motion.

One enormous meteor crashes directly ahead.

The explorer dives through the expanding dust cloud as molten fragments fly past the camera.

A sleek escape spacecraft powers up.

The explorer sprints across the final collapsing bridge.

The bridge disintegrates beneath every footstep.

At the last possible moment, they leap directly into the open spacecraft.

The hatch seals instantly.

Behind her, a young cook crosses the narrow kitchen carrying two steaming bowls of ramen in one hand and a full kettle of hot broth in the other. Near the entrance, an elderly regular begins to rise from his stool to leave.

8–17s: Slow 360-degree orbit. The camera gracefully circles the frozen shop. Broth hangs in midair like molten glass ribbons and floating spheres, noodles suspended in delicate loops, steam frozen into soft drifting clouds. The bowls, kettle, and chopsticks drift weightlessly in suspended time. The woman takes another slow bite, her eyes half-closed with an almost bored expression. Then the frozen world begins to rewind elegantly. Every droplet, every noodle, and every person moves backward with perfect precision, returning toward their original positions.

K2 during a summit push above Camp II.

Altitude above 6,500 meters.
Time: early morning.
Thin air, sub-zero temperatures, powerful winds, drifting snow and distant mountain echoes.

A small expedition team of experienced high-altitude climbers ascending together on fixed ropes.

Snow blows continuously across the ridge.

Cut to a handheld perspective following directly behind the climbers.
Ice axes strike firmly into hard snow while crampons bite into the icy surface.
Heavy breathing is audible through oxygen masks.
One climber briefly looks uphill as subtle cracks appear in the snow above.

The snowfield collapses naturally before accelerating downhill.
Climbers instinctively attempt to anchor themselves to the fixed rope as a powerful wall of snow engulfs the ridge.

Avoid graphic injuries or gore.

The camera lies partially buried beneath fresh snow, tilted toward the shattered ridge where pieces of rope and scattered climbing equipment remain visible.
Fine snow falls across the lens while distant wind echoes through the mountains.
End on unresolved tension.

Natural handheld instability.
Realistic operator movement.
Plausible helmet-mounted and shoulder-level perspectives.
No impossible drone transitions.
No excessive slow motion.

Lighting originates entirely from the natural alpine environment.

Cold early-morning sunlight diffuses through thin clouds and blowing snow.

Real gravity and momentum.

Climbers remain physically attached to fixed ropes until realistic force overwhelms anchors.
Snow fractures, accelerates and behaves according to believable avalanche dynamics.
Loose snow responds naturally to wind.

HUMAN PERFORMANCE
Restrained, believable behaviour under extreme stress.

Heavy breathing from altitude.
Careful foot placement.
Constant balance corrections.
Natural communication through brief gestures and shor

prompt:
FORMAT 15s / free rhythm / 1 MATCH CUT / CONTINUOUS MOVE UNTIL MATCH CUT + IMMEDIATE ACTION FROM FIRST FRAME

SUBJECTS: A lone astronaut in a damaged EVA suit desperately repairs a failing spacecraft while floating above Earth. The same person is later revealed sitting in a small apartment wearing casual clothes, where a VR headset appears only after the match cut and is removed in one uninterrupted motion.

ENVIRONMENT: Outer space above Earth’s glowing blue atmosphere, drifting debris, blinking warning lights, frozen silence broken by suit alarms. Transition into a dim but cozy apartment filled with scattered electronics, coffee mugs, and soft morning light spilling through curtains.

MOOD: High-stakes survival dissolves into everyday reality without breaking movement or spatial continuity.

COLOR LOGIC: Naturalistic Film Print Emulation.

⸻

TIMELINE

0:00–0:07

One continuous handheld-style zero-gravity camera move, WS gradually collapsing into MCU. The astronaut tumbles toward a damaged satellite panel as warning lights flash across the visor. One gloved hand desperately reaches for a sparking cable while the other stabilizes against the hull. Loose debris slowly spins past the lens. The Earth fills half the background, slowly rotating beneath. The camera floats with the subject, maintaining believable inertia and subtle drift while slowly shifting from a 24mm to 35mm perspective.

SFX: (oxygen warning beeps, suit breathing, metallic creaks, distant electrical crackle, gloved impacts against metal, radio static)

Cold sunlight creates sharp highlights across the visor while Earth’s blue glow softly fills the shadows.

⸻

0:07–0:11

Without cutting, the camera tightens into a dead-on CU. Sparks burst inches from the astronaut’s helmet as a damaged panel begins separating from the spacecraft. Just before impact, a woman’s voice calmly calls,

“Alex…”

Then louder,

“ALEX!”

The astronaut exhales in annoyance instead of panic.

Everything suddenly enters slow motion.

Floating debris nearly freezes.

The separating panel hangs motionless.

Only the astronaut continues moving at normal speed.

The camera slowly orbits clockwise around the helmet while maintaining identical framing and distance.

Instead of reaching for the failing equipment, both hands rise toward the helmet in one smooth, deliberate motion.

No headset or gaming device is visible anywhere in space.

Maintain identical face size, hand position, lens distance, head angle, and clockwise motion until the match cut.

SFX: (radio distortion stretching into silence, slowed warning alarms, breathing, woman’s voice echoing “Alex… ALEX…”, ambient hum fading)

⸻

0:11–0:15

MATCH CUT.

CU to MS.

The rising hands occupy the exact same screen position as the helmet instantly becomes a VR headset in a modest apartment.

The motion never stops.

For the first time, the VR headset is visible.

The subject grips both sides and smoothly lifts

prompt:
[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
Gritty high-end medieval television production look. Shot on ARRI Alexa XT with Cooke anamorphic lenses, mix of Steadicam tracking and handheld inside the crowd. Natural overcast daylight, desaturated dirty palette, visible film grain, realistic crowd physics and fabric movement. No modern polish.

[CHARACTERS]
Central figure: proud middle-aged noblewoman with roughly cropped short blonde hair, wearing a plain rough grey woolen penitential robe that fully covers her, barefoot, pale skin, rigid upright posture that slowly cracks under public condemnation. Stern middle-aged woman in plain brown religious robes walking just behind her, continuously ringing a large heavy iron handbell and chanting in a loud flat voice. Dense crowd of dirty medieval city dwellers of every age and class in period clothing packed on both sides and leaning from windows.

[LOCATION]
Narrow winding cobblestone streets of a medieval coastal city, high stone walls, arched doorways, wooden shutters, mud on the ground.

[TIMELINE]
0-6s: [Steadicam tracking medium-wide from the side] The woman in the plain robe walks steadily forward with forced dignity. The robed woman stays half a step behind ringing the bell and chanting “Shame. Shame. Shame.” Crowd begins to notice, first heads turn, early shouts of “Shame!” rise.

6-12s: [Handheld inside the pack, pushing closer] Crowd presses tighter along the path. Faces show pure contempt. Children point and call out. The woman keeps her chin high but her eyes start to glaze. Bell never stops. Chant continues: “Shame. Shame. Shame.”

12-18s: [Low tracking shot moving with her feet then tilting up to face] Bare feet slap wet cobblestones. A woman leans from a window and shouts “Shame!” The central woman’s jaw tightens, first tears form but she does not break stride. Crowd noise becomes a continuous wall of overlapping “Shame!” mixed with the bell.

18-24s: [Medium close-up handheld, slight shake] Camera stays locked on her face as the controlled mask cracks. Tears finally fall. She stares straight ahead, breathing harder. Behind her the religious woman rings harder and keeps the flat chant. The plain robe shifts with every step under the weight of the stares.

24-30s: [Pull-back Steadicam wide tracking] The full street is visible: wall of bodies on both sides, continuous shouting of “Shame! Shame! Shame!” mixed with the bell. The woman continues walking, posture still upright but now visibly broken, tears streaming, until the frame holds on her isolated figure moving through the condemnation.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
Exact period production texture of a major series, coherent physics of every body and fabric movement, stable character continuity, natural motion blur, no modern digital cleanliness, no artificial enhancement.

prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic daytime amusement park roller coaster, bright hard sunlight, strong wind, realistic motion blur on tracks and background, subtle handheld camera energy, rich skin detail, heavy natural film grain.

0-5s: [Medium Shot] A young woman in her early 20s sits in the front seat of a moving roller coaster car, calm and slightly bored, hair whipping in the wind. Beside her sits a middle-aged man wearing what looks like a normal full head of hair. Behind them, another car with a woman is visible. The coaster drops and banks hard.

5-9s: [Dynamic Tracking] The force of the turn rips the man’s wig free. It peels off his bald head in a chaotic upward arc, spinning and flying backward through the air. The wig lands messily on the head of the woman in the car behind. Everyone’s faces freeze in pure shock and confusion at the peak of the chaos. Time locks completely. Only the young woman in the front keeps moving.

9-15s: [Slow Orbital + Detail] Camera slowly orbits the frozen cars. The wig hangs mid-air in a twisted shape with individual hairs suspended. The bald man’s scalp is fully exposed, mouth open. The woman behind is frozen mid-scream with the wig draped over her face. The young woman looks sideways, rolls her eyes and mouths “joder, otra vez”. She reaches into her pocket, pulls out a stick of chewing gum, unwraps it and calmly puts it in her mouth, starting to chew while the entire frozen scene (except her) begins a precise reverse.

15-20s: [Medium Close-up] The rewind is controlled and elegant: the wig lifts off the woman behind, flies backward through the air in reverse, and returns exactly to the moment it is only beginning to peel off the bald man’s head. Time freezes again at that precise instant — the front edge of the wig just lifting, a few strands already loose.

20-26s: [Tight Medium] Still frozen for everyone else, the young woman takes the chewed gum out of her mouth, reaches over and firmly presses it onto the center of the bald man’s scalp, right under the lifting wig. With the same hand she smooths and presses the wig back down into perfect place, locking it with the gum. She sits back, looks straight ahead with a tiny private smile, completely unbothered.

26-30s: [Medium Shot] Time suddenly resumes at full real-time speed. The coaster continues its drop. The man touches his head, feels the wig still firmly in place, looks confused for a second, then breaks into a relieved, happy smile. The young woman stares forward, already chewing a new piece of gum, expression of quiet satisfaction.

Photorealistic, ultra-detailed wind and hair physics, perfect motion blur only on moving elements, stable characters, cinematic lighting, heavy natural film grain, no artifacts, movie-level temporal coherence, high rewatch value.

prompt: Create a 15-second photorealistic cinematic dark-fantasy sequence in 16:9 widescreen. The video must contain exactly three clearly separated cinematic shots connected by clean hard cuts. No dissolves, morphing transitions or continuous camera orbit. MASTER DRAGON LOCK: Show one enormous ancient dragon with a broad powerful body, charcoal-black overlapping scales, subtle dark crimson colouring across its head and neck, two swept-back horns, smaller facial spikes, glowing amber-orange eyes, one long tail and one pair of enormous bat-like wings with dark leathery membranes. The dragon has four legs: two forelegs and two hind legs. Its design, size, horns, colour, anatomy and facial structure remain identical in all three shots. The dragon must feel extremely heavy, ancient and physically realistic. MASTER RIDER LOCK: One adult armoured rider is already seated securely in a dark leather saddle on the dragon from the very first frame. The rider wears detailed weathered silver plate armour, dark under-clothing, a fitted medieval helmet with a narrow shadowed visor and a long dark cloak. The rider’s face is never clearly visible. The rider holds leather reins connected to the saddle and remains seated throughout the entire sequence. The rider does not suddenly appear, mount, dismount or change clothing. During the first shot, the rider is naturally hidden behind the dragon’s large head, neck and folded wings. ENVIRONMENT AND LIGHTING: The sequence takes place inside a gigantic ancient mountain cave. The cave contains rough black rock walls, enormous stone formations, drifting mist, scattered bones and faint glowing embers between cracks in the ground. The far interior is almost black, but the dragon must remain readable through soft amber reflections and cold blue rim light entering from the cave mouth. The cave entrance opens from a high mountain cliff into a vast dramatic landscape of jagged mountains, deep valleys, distant waterfalls, rolling clouds and pale stormy daylight. Maintain a cinematic cold-blue and muted-amber colour palette with deep shadows, volumetric light rays and realistic atmospheric haze. Dark and mysterious, but never so underexposed that the dragon or rider becomes blurry or invisible. SHOT 1 — DRAGON EMERGES, 0–5 SECONDS: Begin with a symmetrical low frontal wide shot positioned near the cave entrance, facing deep into the darkness. The camera slowly tracks backward toward the entrance as the enormous dragon walks forward out of the black cave interior. The dragon’s wings remain completely folded against both sides of its body. Its glowing amber eyes appear first, followed by its horned head, shoulders and powerful forelegs becoming visible through the mist. Each heavy footstep shakes the cave floor and dislodges small stones and dust from the ceiling. The dragon exhales dense vapour from its nostrils and releases a deep restrained growl. Its head moves naturally with the weight of each step. The dragon looks directly past the camera toward the cave opening. The rider is already seated but remains hidden behind the dragon’s head and neck. Do not reveal the rider clearly during this shot. SHOT 2 — RIDER REVEAL, 5–9 SECONDS: Clean hard cut to a low three-quarter side tracking shot beside the moving dragon. Begin close to the dragon’s horned head and sharply detailed scales. Track smoothly backward along the dragon’s neck and folded wing while the dragon continues walking toward the cave entrance. As the camera reaches the dragon’s shoulder, reveal the single armoured rider seated in the saddle between the folded wings. Hold the composition long enough to clearly show the rider’s silver armour, helmet, dark cloak and both hands gripping the reins. The rider looks toward the bright cave exit and leans slightly forward in preparation for takeoff. The dragon and rider remain in continuous forward motion. Do not show a separate rider anywhere else in the cave. SHOT 3 — REAR TAKEOFF AND FLIGHT, 9–15 SECONDS: Clean hard cut to an epic wide rear view positioned behind and slightly above the dragon and rider. The bright cave mouth and vast mountain landscape fill the background ahead of them. The dragon accelerates into a powerful run toward the cave opening while its wings remain folded enough to pass safely through the cave. The dragon reaches the cliff edge and makes one forceful leap completely out of the cave. Only after clearing the rock opening, it spreads both enormous wings to their full symmetrical width. The sudden wing expansion pushes mist, dust and loose stones outward from the cave entrance. The rider leans forward, grips the reins and remains firmly attached to the saddle. The dragon performs one enormous downward wingbeat, catches the air and transitions naturally into stable forward flight. Loose stones fall from the cliff beneath it. The camera rapidly follows from behind as the dragon and rider soar away over the deep valley between jagged mountain peaks. The long tail streams naturally behind the dragon and the rider’s cloak whips in the wind. End on a majestic wide rear silhouette of the dragon flying into the open mountain landscape as sunlight breaks through the storm clouds. CAMERA AND MOTION: Premium cinematic camera movement with realistic scale and parallax. Shot one is a controlled backward dolly. Shot two is a smooth low side-tracking reveal. Shot three is a dynamic rear pursuit shot that follows the takeoff out of the cave. Use natural motion blur only during the leap and wingbeat. Keep the dragon’s movement heavy on the ground and powerful but graceful in the air. No shaky chaotic framing and no extreme close-ups that obscure the action. CINEMATIC QUALITY: Big-budget photorealistic dark-fantasy visual effects, highly detailed scales and armour, realistic creature muscles beneath the skin, physically accurate wing membranes, believable foot contact, convincing dust and falling-rock physics, volumetric cave mist, dramatic rim lighting, strong depth, atmospheric perspective and stable character consistency. AUDIO: No dialogue and no music. Deep dragon breathing, restrained growl, heavy echoing footsteps, claws scraping stone, armour movement, leather saddle creaking, falling pebbles, rushing cave wind, powerful wingbeat and a deep dragon roar as it enters open air. STRICT CONSISTENCY: Exactly one dragon and one rider. The rider is seated on the dragon from the beginning and never disappears. No additional people, dragons or creatures. No dragon transformation or colour change. No extra heads, horns, tails, wings, legs or riders. The wings remain folded inside the cave and open only after the dragon has completely cleared the cave mouth. The wings must not clip through the cave walls. The rider must not float above the saddle or merge into the dragon. No fire breathing, combat, dialogue, text, logos, blood or visible injuries.
