prompt:
[General Requirements] 12-second realistic single outfit change short video, 9:16 vertical screen. Strictly replicate the movement logic of the reference video 'Balance Outfit Change': the female lead balances on one leg, uses the outer side of her lifted foot to hold a bundle of 'shoes + clothes', tosses the bundle into the air, quickly retracts her leg to build power, and performs a single high-speed kick that accurately hits the target; the outfit change occurs in the exact frame where the foot and the clothes overlap. The change must be a hard cut in one frame, not a gradient, transformation, or clothes gradually covering the body. No dialogue, no narration, no subtitles, no watermarks, keep the background music.
[Character Lock] The lead is an adult woman over 25, using @1. Facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, height, and body proportions remain consistent throughout, no face-swapping, no age change, no body shape change. Movements feature realistic center of gravity, muscle exertion, breathing patterns, and slight balance swaying.
[Outfit Lock] Before change: Black short-sleeved T-shirt, lavender flare pants, black and white sneakers. After change: The lead instantly switches to the complete look of preset #1, strictly maintaining the colors, cut, material, and styling of #1. Only one outfit change occurs in the entire video, and the second look lasts until the end without adding, removing, or replacing any clothing, shoes, or accessories.
[Starting Clothing Bundle] The opening prop is not a single shoe, but a compact, weighted bundle consisting of the shoes and folded clothes corresponding to preset #1. The shoe outlines are on top, with folded fabric supporting the shoes from below and some fabric edges hanging naturally. The bundle is supported by the outer side of the lead's left sneaker, the outer instep, and near the ankle. It is not placed on the toe, not worn, and not floating. Once tossed, the shoes and clothes must fly together as a single unit without scattering.
[Scene] Minimalist modern residential interior with white walls and light gray hard flooring. Background includes a white wardrobe, door, washing machine, and a few household items. Natural window light mixed with soft indoor light; furniture, background, and lighting direction remain constant. Realistic mobile phone video texture, skin retains natural texture, clothing and shoe materials are clear.
[Close-up Fixed Camera] Fixed tight full-body shot, camera distance approximately 2.1–2.3 meters from the lead, height about 1.05 meters, 30–32mm equivalent focal length, nearly eye-level with a slight low angle. The lead occupies about 80% of the screen height, positioned slightly to the right to leave space for the left leg lift and clothing bundle trajectory. About 8% space at the top and 4% at the bottom. The person, support leg, lifted left leg, and airborne bundle stay fully in frame. Stationary throughout, no zooming, panning, or tracking cuts.
[Strict Time Storyboard] [00:00-00:00.90] The lead stands sideways, right leg as the sole support, right knee slightly bent; left leg lifted sideways to near horizontal. Left foot turned slightly inward so the outer side of the sneaker faces up like a tilted tray. The bundle of shoes and clothes is held steadily by the outer foot. She looks at the bundle with focus. Arms naturally raised for balance. No eye contact with camera.
[00:00.90-00:01.05] A short, clear upward flick using only the left ankle and outer foot, tossing the bundle diagonally upward. A light toss, not a full kick. The bundle leaves the foot, rising along a short parabolic path. Fabric edges expand slightly due to air, but the unit stays together. Accompanying 'whoosh' sound.
[00:01.05-00:01.45] Bundle rises to peak. Lead immediately retracts left leg, knee bending toward chest/abdomen in a compact ready stance. Body tilts slightly right, arms spread with gravity shift. Eyes track the clothes, no looking at camera.
[00:01.45-00:01.65] Bundle begins to descend. Lead finishes retracting leg, pausing for no more than 0.2s to judge the landing point.
[00:01.65-00:01.85] Lead performs one formal high kick, succeeding on the first try. Left leg explodes diagonally upward, knee opening rapidly, shin and toe fully extending in 0.2s. Fast, clean, sharp kick with natural motion blur. Left foot accurately meets the falling bundle, no misses or corrections.
[00:01.85, Instant Hard Cut] Frame of contact between foot and bundle center triggers a seamless hard cut. Pre-contact frame: Lead in black T-shirt and lavender pants; bundle in air. Post-contact frame: Lead in preset #1; bundle completely gone. No transition frames, no blending, no gradual growth. Just a hard cut.
[00:01.85-00:02.80] Hold high kick peak for 0.1s, then lower leg. She looks at her foot first, then slowly looks at the camera with confident smile.
[00:02.80-00:04.10] First siren-style fashion pose: S-curve body, one hand on waist, the other passing through hair. Looks away then back at camera with a mysterious smile.
[00:04.10-00:05.40] Two-thirds profile stance, feet staggered, shoulders back. She looks at camera, tilts head, and blinks slowly with a playful, high-fashion vibe.
[00:05.40-00:06.60] Slow turn showing back to camera. Hair slides along shoulders. Turns head back over shoulder with a slight smirk.
[00:06.60-00:09.30] Walks away from camera toward depth of room with 3-4 steps of a relaxed runway gait. Fixed camera captures full back view.
[00:09.30-00:10.40] Stops in background, one foot pointed sideways, still back to camera, then looks over shoulder with a mysterious side-smile and quick wink.
[00:10.40-00:12.00] Climax: On the final beat, a clean half-turn with a hair flip, stepping toward camera into a two-thirds frontal pose. One hand on waist, other near chin, chin up, staring at camera with direct siren gaze. Final 0.3s freeze frame.
[Audio] 00:00-01:85 ethereal female humming with reverb, ambient friction/whoosh sounds. At 01:85, heavy electronic drum drop with a deep 'thump'. 01:85-12:00 continuous electronic beat with walking/clothing friction sounds. Ending with an upward sweep. No dialogue.
[Strict Negative Constraints] No gradient changes, no dissolving, no gradual clothes growth, no fabric crawling on body, no color spreading, no old clothes fading; no intermediate states. Hard cut at contact: 100% old outfit before, 100% preset #1 after. No unauthorized modification to #1.

path: prompts/真人/特效向/特效综合/youmind-838--特斯拉-Cybertruck-和展厅的电影级亮相.md
prompt:
/imagine

整体说明：魔法工程与极简设计的迷人融合，展示了一个完整的 Tesla 生态系统如何从一个神秘的源头轻松、无声地诞生。

核心场景：一个极简的 Tesla 品牌箱子在一个未来空间中神奇地展开，同时展示了一辆 Tesla Cybertruck，并在其周围组装了一个时尚的展厅。

技术规格：
- 格式：电影 16:9
- 画质：4K，24fps
- 运动强度：中
- 摄像机稳定性：锁定

角色/物体：
- 物体 1：一个完美的哑光白色立方体箱子，印有精致、发光的 Tesla 标志。其接缝处发出柔和的白色内部光芒，轻轻脉动。
- 物体 2：一辆全新的 Tesla Cybertruck，带有拉丝不锈钢外骨骼，其锐利的棱角捕捉着初生的光线。车窗是深色且无缝的。
- 物体 3：极简展厅元素，包括一个白色 Tesla 墙壁连接器、抛光混凝土面板地板，以及一个时尚、低调的仿皮长凳。

环境与布景：
- 地点：场景开始于一个广阔、黑暗、空旷的虚空。这个空间随后转变为一个明亮、极简的 Tesla 展厅，拥有无缝的白色墙壁和抛光地板。
- 氛围：开始时神秘而未来感，随后转变为一种敬畏、纯粹和创新的感觉。
- 灯光：最初，唯一的灯光来源是黑暗中箱子发光的接缝。当它打开时，干净、明亮、漫射的建筑照明从上方逐渐亮起，以高端画廊环境的清晰度照亮整个空间。

情感曲线与节奏：
- 0-2 秒：期待。从一个固定的广角镜头中，孤零零的箱子在黑暗中脉动。
- 2-6 秒：揭示。箱子面板完美地收回。Cybertruck 显现，同时展厅元素以精确、快速而优雅的动作升起并展开。一个微妙的变焦开始。

prompt:
30 seconds, 16:9, high-quality Japanese anime-style battle PV. A very flashy and cinematic image, like a trailer for the latest theatrical anime movie. No text on screen. No additional characters. Only 1 protagonist, 1 divine beast, and 1 enemy boss. Depicted as a continuous sequence of events on the same battlefield throughout the 30 seconds. No transition to other spaces. Maintain consistency of the protagonist, divine beast, enemy boss, background, spatial structure, destruction state, and damage expression until the end.
The camera moves very dynamically throughout. No static cameras. Include clear camera moves in each cut. Actively use orbiting, rapid approach, rapid retreat, rapid ascent, rapid descent, overhead views, low-angle looking up, side-by-side tracking, circling in front of the subject, high-speed dolly shots close to the ground, foreground parallax passing through rubble, crash zooms, Dutch angles, and sharp turns. At the moment of impact, insert a strong impact like a freeze frame for a moment, and immediately move explosively after that.

Protagonist:
Girl Onmyoji 'Akane'. Around 17 years old. Slender and supple build. Pale skin. Golden-amber eyes. Long black pigtails tied with red ribbons. Before summoning, she wears a dark blue school uniform-style outfit. After summoning, she changes into a priest-style combat outfit based on black, white, and deep red. Equipped with a short combat skirt, talisman designs on the cuffs, arm guards, and leg armor. Weapon is a spirit blade formed from red-gold spiritual power. Focused and tense in the first half, cornered in the middle, and showing determination and ferocity in the second half.

Divine Beast:
A large four-legged divine beast. Has a massive lion's mane, muscular limbs like a wolf, two dragon-like horns, and a long tail. Black fur with red-gold glowing lines. Eyes are gold-red. Massive and heavy-set, focusing on charging, claw attacks, roars, and body slams. A presence combining divinity and ferocity. Maintains the same appearance throughout the video.

Enemy Boss:
'Ghost King in Black Armor'. A massive 4-meter class humanoid boss. Heavy black iron armor. Deep red glowing lines like cracks on the armor surface. Two horns curved backward. Burning red eyes. Carries a massive double-edged black greatsword. Manipulates black flames and shockwaves. Movements are heavy but fast, with each hit being very heavy. Possesses the composure and cruelty of a ruler. Maintains the same appearance throughout the video.

Background:
A plaza of night ruins of a shrine. A large summoning magic circle in the center. A collapsed torii gate in the back right. A fallen stone pillar in the front left. Ruins of a broken altar in the back. Cracked stone floor. Scattered rubble. Sky covered with thunderclouds. Maintain this spatial structure during combat. Even if the camera moves greatly, ensure the central summoning circle, the collapsed torii, the fallen pillar, and the altar ruins are shown repeatedly to identify it as the same battlefield.
Any destruction or damage that occurs will be continuously reflected in subsequent cuts. Maintain the broken stone floor, blown-away rubble, the beast's hit marks, cracks in the chest armor of the Ghost King, remains of black flames, and remains of red-gold spiritual power.

00:00–00:02
Short cuts between a close-up of fingertips, eyes, and palm. The camera circles slightly around the fingertips, crash-zooms into the golden spiritual light on the palm, and switches to a close-up of Akane's face. Akane quietly forms a seal. Expression is focused. Ends of hair and sleeves sway slightly.

00:02–00:04
The camera spirals upward rapidly around Akane, transitioning to a top-down view to show the entire battlefield. The central summoning circle expands rapidly. Golden light erupts from the cracked stone floor. Floating rubble rotates. Clearly show the torii gate in the back right, the fallen pillar in the front left, the altar ruins in the back, and the thunderclouds. Akane pushes her spiritual power into the ground.

00:04–00:06
The camera dives rapidly into the center of the summoning circle, half-orbiting while grazing the vortex of spiritual power. Strongly show the beast's eyes, fangs, mane, and front legs in sequence. The beast's head, front legs, and entire body manifest in order. Red-gold and ink-black spiritual power swirl violently.
Akane's dialogue:
'O raging god, manifest from the depths of the earth! Respond to my call, Divine Beast!'

00:06–00:08
The camera grazes the beast's chest and retreats, orbiting widely while keeping Akane and the beast in the same frame. Finally shows a full-body pose of the beast. The beast roars and stamps the ground. Akane's outfit completion of change to priest-style combat gear. Hair and clothes sway violently from the wind pressure.

00:08–00:10
The darkness in front splits. The camera moves at high speed close to the ground into the darkness, enters the feet of the Ghost King, looks up along the greatsword to show the horns and eyes, and finally looks up at the entire body. The Ghost King slowly walks out dragging the greatsword. The stone floor cracks, and black flames and red sparks scatter.
Ghost King's dialogue:
'Do you think you can stop me with that level of power?'

00:10–00:12
High-speed pan from Akane's profile to the beast. The camera tracks alongside the beast, circling in front halfway to show the charge approaching from the front. Akane holds the spirit blade and points forward. The beast crouches low and charges all at once toward the Ghost King.
Akane's dialogue:
'Go!'

00:12–00:14
The camera circles to the Ghost King's side, showing the greatsword swing from a super low angle. At the moment of impact, insert a strong impact like a freeze frame for a moment, then move violently. The Ghost King swings down a hit clad in black flames. The beast is hit head-on and blown away. The stone floor shatters, rubble scatters, and a strong shockwave of black flames spreads.
Ghost King's dialogue:
'Too slow.'

00:14–00:16
The camera is washed away significantly following the blown-away beast, showing the shattered floor and dancing rubble while turning back to Akane. Akane gasps at the impact and almost kneels for a moment. Clear hit marks remain on the beast's shoulder and flank. These marks will remain in subsequent cuts.

00:16–00:18
The camera rapidly approaches Akane's face, capturing the determination in her eyes, then drops to the seal on her chest. Akane grits her teeth and recovers, forming a seal again. The weakening summoning circle lights up again, and a red-gold spiritual line extends from Akane to the beast. Show the collapsed torii and altar ruins again.
Akane's dialogue:
'It's not over yet... Stand up, Divine Beast! Let's fight together!'

00:18–00:21
The camera pushes in a straight line from behind Akane to the beast, then orbits nearly 360 degrees around the beast. The beast roars and stands up while keeping the hit marks. The red-gold glow of the whole body intensifies, and the mane stands up as if burning. Akane also readies her spirit blade. Strongly show the resonance between Akane and the beast.
Akane's dialogue:
'Crush that arrogance to pieces!'

00:21–00:23
The camera orbits the side of the Ghost King at high speed while following the beast's lateral movement. The beast circles to the side of the Ghost King at high speed

prompt:
[Seedance 2.5 / 15 seconds / 9:16]

Use the reference image as the sole character reference. 15 seconds, 9:16 vertical, one cut, fixed camera. The camera is completely fixed from start to finish. Zooming, panning, tilting, rotating, handheld movement, cuts, transitions, reframing, slow motion, and freeze-frame effects are prohibited.

[Composition/Positioning]
Place a live-action BBQ grill and meat on the bone in the left 45% of the screen. Place a 2D character in the right 30% of the screen. Reserve about 20% of space in the center for tongs and moving the meat.

The character stands on the sandy beach on the right, always displaying their whole body from head to black flip-flops. Do not place the character in front of the grill, on top of the grill legs, or on the table. Leave clear space between the character and the grill, maintaining their standing position from start to finish.

Do not overlap the grill, meat, human hands, tongs, or gochujang bottle with the character's body. The character must not hide the meat or grill. Human hands or tongs must not unnaturally cross the character's face or body. Accurately maintain depth and foreground-background relationships between objects.

[Visual Style]
A comical video combining live-action BBQ footage at a beautiful midsummer seaside with a flat 2D animated sticker character.

Draw a blue sea, white waves, bright blue sky, golden sand, a distant coastline, and palm leaves swaying in the wind. Bright daytime natural light. Palm leaves, grill smoke, and the hem of the character's white shirt sway naturally in the sea breeze.

The background, sea, sand, grill, charcoal fire, smoke, flame, meat on the bone, fat, meat juice, gochujang, bottle, human hand, and metal tongs are all high-quality live-action expressions. Blown-out highlights, excessive bloom, haze, and exposure flickering are prohibited.

Only the character remains a flat 2D animated sticker until the end. Live-action, semi-live-action, 3D, CG figure, game model, Pixar style, or clay animation styles are prohibited. Maintain clear line drawings, cell shading, flat shadows, and thin white borders.

[Character Persistence]
Use the male character from the reference image exactly as they are. Fix the soft ash-silver wavy hair, bangs shape, hair length and volume, grey-blue eyes, young well-formed face, and slim long-limbed body type.

Fix the white sleeveless innerwear, sheer white short-sleeved open shirt, white drawcord, black paisley shorts, black flip-flops, silver necklace, earrings, bracelet, and ring.

Do not change the face, hairstyle, body type, clothing, patterns, colors, shoes, or accessories. Do not add hats, sunglasses, aprons, gloves, or new props. Do not duplicate the character. Do not add another 2D character.

The character is not coldly expressionless but moves very cutely and expressively. Clearly show large shining eyes, rosy cheeks, a happy smile, tilting the head, small shoulder-shaking movements, a sulking face with puffed cheeks, teary eyes, and frantic waving of hands. No standing stiffly.

[BBQ and Meat on the Bone]
Grill a large Tomahawk steak on the bone in the live-action BBQ grill on the left side of the screen. Long bones are clearly visible and physically connected to the meat. The meat is well-grilled, showing deep sear marks, savory char, glossy juices, melted fat, and light steam.

Do not make the meat raw, charred black, boneless, or deformed. Do not duplicate meat or bones. Do not let bones disappear midway.

A live-action adult woman's hand enters from the left edge of the screen. Maintain pink nail art, thin silver rings, and normal five fingers. Turn and lift the meat with metal BBQ tongs. Do not fuse the hand, fingers, ring, tongs, meat, or grill.

[Gochujang]
Use a transparent squeeze bottle with no label, text, or brand logo. The content is thick, glossy, deep reddish-brown gochujang. Do not make it bright red like ketchup or a watery liquid.

The gochujang flows in a thick continuous stream from the bottle nozzle and falls directly onto the meat surface. Do not make the sauce appear suddenly from mid-air. Do not leak from the bottom or sides of the bottle.

[00:00–00:03]
Start with a fixed wide composition. On the left, a Tomahawk steak on the bone is sizzling loudly. A woman's live-action hand slowly turns the meat once with metal tongs. Fat falls onto the charcoal, and a small flame rises for a moment. Thin smoke drifts in the sea breeze.

The 2D character on the right stares at the meat, their eyes sparkling large. They put their hands together under their chin, raise their shoulders, bend their knees slightly, and bounce twice. A small 2D drop of drool appears at the mouth for a moment and disappears.

[00:03–00:05]
The character finds the gochujang bottle. Their eyes sparkle, they tilt their head, and point at the bottle with one hand. They happily hold the bottle with both hands and hug it to their chest for a moment.

Then, with a mischievous smile and one eye closed, they point the nozzle toward the meat on the left. The character themselves does not move from their standing position on the right.

[00:05–00:07]
The character squeezes the bottle hard, pouring a large amount of gochujang onto the meat on the bone. A thick reddish-brown sauce extends continuously from the nozzle to the meat, creating a large zigzag pattern on the meat surface.

The sauce bubbles lightly with the heat and mixes with the meat juice to create a gloss. Maintain visibility of the bone and grill marks without completely hiding the whole meat.

The character smiles proudly, sticks out their tongue slightly, and shakes their shoulders cutely while squeezing the bottle. The woman's hand stops in surprise while holding the tongs.

[00:07–00:09]
The woman's hand quickly takes the gochujang bottle with the tongs and returns it to the left. Immediately after, she lightly taps the top of the character's head once with the tip of the closed tongs.

The tip of the tongs clearly and lightly touches the character's hair. At the moment of contact, a small yellow 2D star-shaped impact effect appears over the head. Do not hit hard. Do not make it painful. Make it a completely cute cartoon-style reprimand.

The moment they are hit, the character's head tilts to the right, their silver hair bounces, and their shoulders and torso shake greatly to the left and right. Knees bend, and they spread their arms to balance. Feet do not leave the sand, and they do not move toward the grill.

They puff their cheeks, close their eyes tight, and shed a single small tear. Clearly show the cute shaking movement of the whole body, not just the head, for about 1 second.

[00:09–00:11]
The woman's hand returns the tongs to the grill and lifts a bite-sized piece of grilled meat with gochujang on it. The lifted meat shows grill marks, juice, fibers, and thick gochujang.

The tongs pass through the center space and carry the meat to the front of the character's mouth. The character sulks about being hit on the head, crosses their arms, turns their face away, and puffs their cheeks.

Immediately they glance at the meat with just their eyes. Their eyes sparkle again, they uncross their arms, put both hands behind their back, and lean their upper body slightly forward. They open their mouth wide and approach the meat.

[00:11–00:12]
The character clearly [eats] the meat

prompt:
Montage, 8-shot handheld phone vlog, photorealistic home-video style. Slight handheld shake, natural framing, bright summer daylight, soft breeze, fine film grain.

A woman (image) returns to the same traditional hanok courtyard restaurant for another summer meal. (Image) provides only her face and hairstyle; outfit: light beige linen short-sleeve shirt with shoulders fully covered, top button open, casual and relaxed. She remains seated on the same side facing the camera throughout. No other faces appear; only a server's hands enter the frame.

The table holds a steaming bowl of handmade kimchi mandu, crispy potato jeon, small side dishes (kimchi, pickled radish), chilled barley tea, soy dipping sauce, chopsticks, spoon, napkin, and a small fan gently moving in the breeze. Traditional wooden beams, tiled roofs, green plants, and afternoon cicadas create a cozy summer atmosphere.

Shots

1. Server places the hot dishes on the table. Steam rises dramatically. She smiles with excitement and says: "This time something hot!"

2. Close-up as she breaks a kimchi dumpling in half with chopsticks. Steam pours out and the filling stretches slightly. She softly blows on it.

3. First bite. Loud crispy wrapper followed by juicy filling. She widens her eyes and quietly says: "Wow... the juice is crazy."

4. She dips a piece of potato jeon into soy sauce and takes a crunchy bite. She gives a thumbs up while chewing naturally.

5. She sips cold barley tea after the hot food and smiles with relief: "This combination is the best."

6. Close-up of another dumpling dipped generously in sauce. She enjoys several satisfying bites with natural chewing sounds while nodding happily.

7. She finishes the last bite, wipes her mouth with a napkin, leans toward the camera, and whispers: "What should I eat next?"

8. She laughs softly, waves goodbye, and walks out through the peaceful hanok courtyard as leaves sway in the breeze and cicadas continue singing.

Audio

Natural Korean dialogue only where specified. Live ambient audio only: steaming food, crispy bites, chopsticks, dipping sauce, chewing, tea pouring, birds, cicadas, light wind, and courtyard ambience. No music, subtitles, logos, watermarks, exaggerated facial expressions, or duplicated reference image.

prompt: Create a 15 second 16:9 photorealistic social video in one continuous handheld smartphone shot at 30 frames per second. Bright late morning on a freshly cut green lawn beside a large matte tan industrial building. A black metal fence, a narrow road, and one parked white car sit in the deep background. The sky is pale blue with soft white clouds. Sunlight is clear but slightly diffused, producing realistic skin tones, soft ground shadows, and mild automatic exposure changes. Frame the scene from chest height. A young man stands in the foreground on the left in three quarter back view, medium length light brown hair, dark forest green shirt with a large white graphic on the back, navy athletic shorts, holding a fluorescent yellow tennis ball. A young woman stands farther away on the right, dark hair tied back, burgundy sleeveless top, loose white trousers. Keep the center of the frame open against the plain wall so both balls remain easy to follow. Seconds 0 to 2. The woman tosses an orange basketball high through the upper center of frame. The man crouches slightly, turns his shoulders, and studies its path while drawing the tennis ball beside his right ear. Use natural hand movement, subtle hair motion from the breeze, distant traffic, birds, and quiet field ambience. Seconds 2 to 4. He completes a believable overarm throw. His weight shifts from back foot to front foot, hips rotate before the shoulder, elbow extends, wrist snaps, and the tennis ball leaves his fingertips with accurate motion blur. The camera operator reacts a fraction late, then tilts upward with small human micro shake. Seconds 4 to 8. Track both balls in the same frame. The basketball drifts diagonally toward camera and grows gradually in size. The tennis ball travels on a faster rising arc from lower right toward the basketball. Maintain physically coherent speed, gravity, spin, scale, shadows, and depth. Add a very gentle digital crop only as the gap closes. The man remains partly visible at the lower left, watching the flight. Seconds 8 to 9.2. Use a clean speed ramp into crisp high speed slow motion. The tennis ball contacts the outer side of the basketball with precise edge contact and a tiny compression at impact. Hold the impossible moment for only a few frames. Seconds 9.2 to 12.5. Trigger a seamless comedic visual effect that looks intentionally edited rather than synthetic. A compact orange fireball, dusty smoke, glowing fragments, and small pieces of basketball material expand from the contact point. The tennis ball remains visible near the right edge of the blast. Leave a clean bright center area for adding the words JESUS SAVES during editing. Add a deep impact, brief bass drop, one beat of silence, then a warm gospel choir chord. Seconds 12.5 to 15. Let the smoke thin naturally. Tilt down slightly to catch the man staring upward in disbelief and the woman reacting with both hands raised. End

Giant statues of forgotten warriors stand broken among tall pillars wrapped in vines. A mysterious circular stone platform lies in the center of the ruins.

Eight explorers from different backgrounds stand on the platform wearing rugged expedition clothing mixed with tribal artifacts they discovered in the ruins. Their faces show tension, curiosity, and determination.

A mysterious guide dressed in dark modern expedition gear slowly walks across the platform while the explorers watch him carefully. Wind moves through the jungle canopy and ancient cloth banners hanging from the pillars. Torches burn with orange flames, creating moving shadows across the stone carvings.

Camera begins with a wide aerial shot revealing the enormous jungle valley and hidden ruins, morning fog drifting between trees. The camera slowly descends toward the platform.

Cut to close-up shots of several explorers: focused eyes, sweat on their faces, hands touching ancient engraved symbols on the stone floor.

The guide stops at the center and speaks calmly:

“Every civilization leaves behind a test. Only those who understand the past can control the future.”

Low distant thunder echoes across the valley. The camera slowly circles around the group as they look at each other, realizing this is the beginning of a dangerous expedition.

Final shot: one explorer kneels and traces a glowing ancient symbol on the ground, hinting at hidden secrets inside the ruins.

Ultra cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, realistic human acting, epic adventure film style, volumetric sunrise fog, jungle ambience, natural wind movement, shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens look, subtle lens flare, high detail textures, realistic environment simulation.

prompt:
CAMERA:
DV-style 16mm camcorder aesthetic with natural handheld movement. The entire sequence is filmed from CHASE's perspective as she records herself, occasionally setting the camera down for hands-free shots. Expect subtle shake, uneven framing, slow autofocus, awkward zooms, and the occasional partial crop of her face. The camcorder itself is never visible.

LOOK:
Soft analog tape texture with slight blur, faint tape grain, blooming highlights, auto-exposure flicker, muted contrast, and lifelike skin tones. Lighting evolves naturally across each location: warm vanity bulbs → cool daylight through the van window → dim soundcheck lighting → bright backstage entrance before the event.

STYLE:
Fast-paced anticipation montage with rapid cuts connecting each location. Transitional movement is slightly sped up to maintain momentum. A reflective voiceover carries the narrative instead of live dialogue. The mood gradually shifts from quiet preparation to nervous anticipation, ending with excitement just before greeting fans.

Character

CHASE — Korean idol (Image1), in her 20s. Long, straight black hair that is fully styled by the end. Dewy glass skin, large expressive eyes, and soft coral-pink lips. She begins in a dressing robe and later changes into a modest fan-meeting outfit with long sleeves, full coverage, and understated accessories.

Location Progression

Dressing room vanity (afternoon) → Moving van (daytime) → Empty venue during soundcheck (early evening) → Backstage entrance behind the curtain (evening).

Storyboard (15 seconds, 8 shots)

1. (~2s | Vanity | Camera on tripod | Warm lighting)
CHASE quietly sits as someone off-camera finishes styling her hair while she looks into the mirror.
Voiceover: "Every fan meeting begins with these peaceful moments."

2. (~2s | Vanity | Close-up)
Tight shot of hands carefully securing a hairpin in place. Only soft room ambience is heard.

3. (~2s | Van | Handheld | Window light)
Sitting beside the window, she absentmindedly fidgets with her hands while watching the city drift past.
Voiceover: "The butterflies always arrive during the drive."

4. (~2s | Van | Close handheld)
She exhales slowly and looks down at her folded hands. Quiet road ambience only.

5. (~2s | Empty stage | Handheld)
Standing alone on stage, she tests the microphone as her voice echoes through the venue.
Voiceover: "Hearing my own voice in an empty hall always feels surreal."

6. (~2s | Soundcheck | Macro detail)
Close-up of her hand adjusting the microphone stand while the echo fades into silence. No narration.

7. (~1.5s | Backstage | Medium handheld)
Waiting behind the curtain, she takes one deep breath as the muffled cheers from the audience grow louder.
Voiceover: "Then suddenly..."

8. (~1.5s | Backstage | Final shot)
A genuine smile appears as she steps toward the bright stage lights.
Voiceover: "...I remember they're all here for me."

POV: First-person handheld shot of a young adult male street photographer walking casually through the extremely crowded streets of Shibuya, Tokyo, Japan on a bright sunny day. Hundreds of pedestrians rush across the famous Shibuya Scramble Crossing, surrounded by towering buildings covered with massive digital billboards, colorful signage, and a vibrant urban atmosphere.

The photographer notices a beautiful young Japanese woman standing at the edge of the sidewalk. She has long silky black hair, fair skin, expressive brown eyes, and wears a stylish modern outfit consisting of an elegant white blouse, a beige pleated skirt, white sneakers, and a small crossbody bag. She is completely focused on her smartphone.

0–4 seconds:
Natural handheld walking motion through the bustling crowd. The photographer spots the woman standing near the sidewalk, looking down at her phone.

4–7 seconds:
He gently walks toward her through the crowd.

Photographer (friendly, clear English):
"Hey there!"

7–10 seconds:
The woman looks up from her phone, makes eye contact, and smiles warmly.

Photographer:
"You look absolutely beautiful in that outfit!"

10–13 seconds:
The photographer continues:
"I'm a street photographer, and I'd really love to take some photos of you if you're okay with that?"

13–15 seconds:
The woman nods enthusiastically and replies in clear English:
"Sure, that sounds fun! I'd love to pose for you."

She gracefully strikes a natural pose. The photographer raises a DSLR camera into the foreground (both hands and camera visible from the first-person perspective), perfectly framing her just before pressing the shutter. A gentle camera shutter click is heard.

Style:
Ultra-realistic cinematic video, vibrant urban colors, bright natural daylight, authentic Shibuya atmosphere, smooth handheld camera movement, shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the woman, dynamic moving crowds in the background, highly detailed textures, realistic facial expressions and body language, clear synchronized English dialogue, subtle ambient sounds including footsteps, crowd chatter, traffic, and city ambience, respectful and friendly interaction, 15-second video.

prompt: One single CONTINUOUS FPV shot, no cuts, no edits, one unbroken take. Real-time speed throughout, controlled and fluid — never frantic. Only ever moves forward in time — never loops, reverses or rewinds. NO slow motion except one half-second beat at the first bite, then an instant snap back to full speed. The image is clean and fully exposed edge to edge in every frame, all four corners as sharp and bright as the centre — no vignette, no dark frame edges, no goggle mask, no lens artefacts of any kind. The camera is INVISIBLE — no shadow or reflection ever appears in frame; it stirs no steam and leaves no trace. The take runs continuously until time runs out, still inside the market. CINEMATIC CAPTURE Clean sharp glass, 180-degree shutter with natural motion blur only on genuinely fast movement, fine grain, warm tungsten and red-neon colour over rich night tones held at natural saturation, skin tones true and unpushed, light filling the frame fully into all four corners — the texture of night street footage shot on a cinema camera in flight, NOT a game engine, NOT animation. The camera opens already inside a busy open-air Seoul night food market, moving between the stalls at a steady 20 km/h — a low roof of tangled bulbs and hanging plastic sheeting overhead, steam and grill smoke pouring across the aisle from every side, radios and shouting under it. It passes a man at arm's length turning skewers over coals and fanning the smoke away with a cardboard flap, swings around a couple leaning over a shared paper tray of fried chicken who step back laughing to let it by, and drifts past a grandmother at a folding table cracking mussels open with a knife and dropping the shells into a bucket. A stray dog trots the length of the aisle ahead of it. The camera turns into a glowing orange stall at the end of the row and settles into one smooth unbroken orbit around a young Korean woman in her twenties on a plastic stool at the counter — round warm face, short black bob with a red clip, cream puffer jacket beaded with rain — as the vendor, a broad woman in her sixties in a floral apron, ladles tteokbokki into a paper bowl in front of her. The camera drifts past her shoulder to the grill where skewers sizzle and snap in oil, then comes back as she lifts the first rice cake on a wooden skewer, thick red sauce clinging to it in uneven runs, and blows on it once — and the frame holds one half-second on her face as she takes the bite: her eyes close and her cheeks puff against the heat. Snap back to full speed. She laughs through her nose immediately, still chewing, fanning her open mouth with one hand and stamping one foot. The camera pulls wide enough to hold them both as the vendor laughs behind the counter and a man waiting behind her laughs too, and the woman takes the paper cup of broth already at the counter's edge and drinks, exhaling hard over the rim. She wipes her mouth with her thumb, still grinning, and points at the grill for another. The camera drops to the iron as the vendor's tongs come down and fresh skewers hit the hot surface in a burst of oil and smoke, sizzling hard, the market noise rolling on all around, as time runs out. SCORE Bright playful K-indie groove from the first frame — bouncing bass, crisp funk drums, a plucky electric guitar riff. Everything cuts dead at the bite for the half-second hold: sizzle and market noise alone. Then the groove slams back with handclaps and a keyboard hook, brighter than before, riding at full energy and unresolved at the last frame. Ambience sits beneath the score throughout. AUDIO A full market underneath — overlapping voices, radios, shouted orders, sizzling from several directions, a ladle knocking a pot, the dog barking somewhere behind, rain on plastic sheeting, her laugh, the vendor's laugh — all beneath the score. No sound tied to the camera itself. STYLE LOCK Hyper-detailed photoreal. The market is alive but never crowded with distant figures — every person in frame is within a few metres of the lens, individually detailed, and doing one specific readable action. EVERY figure keeps moving — nothing stands still. Real food physics — sauce thick and irregular, clinging and breaking in uneven drips, never falling as an even string; steam and grill smoke rising in patchy uneven wisps, thicker in some places than others, never an even cloud; oil spitting only on the grill; rain beading on the puffer jacket. Her reaction is quick and involuntary rather than performed — small, fast, real. The camera orbit is smooth and continuous with no jitter or floating in close framings. The skewer, the bowl and the amount of sauce stay consistent from the moment it is served. The market stalls and their lights never leave frame. The image stays clean and fully exposed edge to edge, all four corners sharp and bright — no vignette, no dark frame edges, no goggle mask. No subtitles, no watermarks, no text. 16:9.

prompt: Create a photorealistic 15 second cinematic video in 16:9 as one continuous handheld shot inside a vast professional special effects soundstage. Use a natural 24 millimeter wide angle lens at eye level, 24 fps, deep focus, slight operator sway, mild rolling shutter, realistic exposure breathing, and accurate motion blur. The camera begins at the corner of a large rectangular water tank. Blue water fills the lower frame, bordered by concrete, safety cones, and loose production papers. A small red and white model rescue boat floats near center. Above it hangs an enormous ribbed gray fabric funnel suspended from a circular ceiling rig. Green screen walls with tracking markers, black ceiling trusses, bright rectangular studio lamps, yellow wind machines, and a detailed miniature coastal city fill the background. From 0 to 2 seconds, hold the wide composition as the fabric tightens, wrinkles crawl upward, and its narrow tip begins rotating. The movement feels driven by real wind and tension, while reflections tremble across the water. From 2 to 4 seconds, the fabric collapses inward and becomes a dense rotating column of gray mist, dust, and atomized water. The funnel narrows toward the pool and descends with believable turbulent airflow. Drift slightly right while keeping it centered. From 4 to 6 seconds, the vortex strikes the water with a violent white eruption. Concentric waves race outward, the boat pitches and rolls, and heavy spray obscures the far edge. React with a quick controlled pan toward the miniature city. From 6 to 9 seconds, track the tornado across the shoreline. Water surges between buildings, a red vehicle is lifted, windows burst, rooftop objects spin away, and apartment blocks buckle in stages. Every fragment shows weight, collision, drag, gravity, and changing rotational speed. From 9 to 12 seconds, continue panning as miniature towers fold, shear, and fall into the street. A special effects technician appears naturally in the right foreground, wearing a plain black crew shirt and orange hearing protection, bracing against a railing. A tall glass skyscraper remains standing in the left background to provide scale. Keep the tornado dark and volumetric, with layered dust, mist, paper, roof panels, and vehicle parts orbiting at different depths. From 12 to 15 seconds, arc back toward the pool. The vortex returns to the center of the widescreen frame while a broad foamy wave curves around the tank and rushes toward camera. Fine droplets hit the lens, creating soft circular highlights without hiding the action. End with the tornado still spinning over violently churning water. Use harsh overhead studio lighting, cool cyan water reflections, mild green spill, realistic shadows, humid haze, and no stylized color filter. Preserve tiny imperfections, uneven water motion, slight camera shake, lens moisture, and natural debris randomness.

prompt:
Reference mapping: @Image1 for Tetiana's character card, @Image2 for Vova's character card.

Scene 1 (0-15 seconds): Request → Refutation → Confrontation → Breakdown
Shot structure: Six shots, fifteen seconds, 16:9 aspect ratio

Global Style Description:
• Shooting medium: iPhone 17 Pro original format video, each frame with raw photo quality. Non-professional mobile aesthetic, slight handheld jitter, snapshot composition, consistent exposure and white balance.
• Optical system: Black Pro-Mist diffusion filter combined with modern clinical-grade high-resolution lenses. The filter only softens highlight transitions and creates a slight bloom, keeping facial contours and details clear. f/16 aperture, deep focus, sharp from foreground to background, and from center to edges.
• Lighting: Overcast evening sky light as the sole main source. Soft, low contrast, and fully diffused. Light concrete ground provides natural bounce to faces, shadows are open, and eyes/tears retain clean white catchlights.
• Color: Neutral shadows, lifted graphite grey shadows, soft open blacks, natural warm neutral skin tones, authentic midtones, flat low-contrast midtones, natural highlights with full detail retention. Saturation is controlled and slightly lowered, with a balanced, soft, and slightly desaturated color palette.
• Realistic texture: Retains pores, under-eye texture, slight skin oiliness, tear film, tear tracks, redness on the tip of the nose, and wet eyelashes. Clothing maintains realistic weight, folds, and contact shadows. 24fps with natural motion blur.
• Setting: Backyard terrace of a modern private residence in Holosiiv, Kyiv, Ukraine, with light concrete walls, vertical wood slats, floor-to-ceiling glass doors, birch, and pine trees.
• Ambient sound: Distant city traffic, rustling leaves, gentle breeze, clear character breathing and sobbing. Ambient sound dips when dialogue occurs.
• Characters:
  Tetiana (corresponds to @Image1): consistent face, grey-green eyes, center-parted long straight black hair, black satin midi dress, black strappy heels. Voice is mid-high range, pace changes from restrained to frantic, volume rises to a shout, ending broken by tears. Consistent across all shots.
  Vova (corresponds to @Image2): consistent face, brown eyes, short brown textured hair, light stubble, black suit, open-collar white shirt, black leather shoes. Voice is mid-low range, starts low then becomes loud and curt. Consistent across all shots.
• Spatial Blocking: Tetiana stands on the right, garden behind her. Vova stands on the left, glass door behind him. Two steps apart. Camera maintains a strict 180-degree axis for eye-line continuity.
• Dialogue: Natural English

Sequence List:
Shot 1 (0s-1.2s) Establishing
• Camera: Medium two-shot, eye level, 90-degree profile, deep focus.
• Movement: Non-professional handheld, lateral drift of 30cm between them with one slight late framing correction.
• Action: Tetiana takes a half-step toward Vova, fists at her sides, chest rising rapidly, eyes filling with tears. Vova's shoulders tense, jaw tightens. In the last 0.2s, Tetiana takes a sharp breath and begins the first line.
• Exit: Tetiana's voice leads into the next angle.

Shot 2 (1.2s-4.5s) Request Outburst
• Camera: Close-up on Tetiana over Vova's left shoulder, eye level, 0-degree front. Vova's shoulder, Tetiana's face, and the background garden all stay sharp.
• Movement: Unstable handheld, pushes 15cm toward Tetiana, framing shifts slightly as her volume peaks.
• Action: Tetiana swallows, lower lip quivers, brows knit inward and up. Nostrils flare at 'dream', first tear rolls down right cheek at 'forever'. Tear has realistic surface tension reflecting white sky light. Stares fixedly at Vova.
• Dialogue: Tetiana says in a rising, cracking voice: 'Vova, I want a red panda! It's been my dream forever!'
• Exit: Last word carries into the first 0.3s of Vova's reaction shot.

Shot 3 (4.5s-8.5s) Refutation
• Camera: Medium close-up on Vova over Tetiana's right shoulder, eye level, 45-degree three-quarter view, all planes sharp.
• Movement: Handheld push 12cm, adding small lateral jitters as Vova's volume rises.
• Action: Vova blinks hard as the last word ends, jaw muscles clench, short nasal inhale. Voice starts low then turns loud and curt, right palm briefly gestures toward the house. Lips tight at the end. Tetiana's next line cuts in during the last 0.2s.
• Dialogue: Vova says in a voice turning from low to loud: 'We already have a cat and a Labrador! Our home is not a zoo!'
• Exit: Tetiana's shout overlaps Vova's final reaction.

Shot 4 (8.5s-11s) Losing Control
• Camera: Extreme close-up on Tetiana over Vova's shoulder, 10-degree low angle, 0-degree front, deep focus. Wet lashes, tear tracks, pores, and Vova's shoulder all sharp.
• Movement: Irregular handheld push 10cm, framing briefly drifts right during the first shout, manually corrected back to eyes.
• Action: Tetiana's eyes widen, tears flow continuously, nose reddens, mouth pulls down, shoulders twitch with every breath. First line is shouted, second voice breaks. Lips stay open at the end with one shaky breath.
• Dialogue: Tetiana says in a high, tearful volume: 'It's my dream! Why don't you care?'
• Exit: Vova's 'Tania' leads the audio into the next shot while still on Tetiana's face.

Shot 5 (11s-13.5s) Boundaries
• Camera: Close-up on Vova over Tetiana's right shoulder, 5-degree high angle, 45-degree three-quarter view, deep focus.
• Movement: Starts static, then slow 10cm push, maintaining low-amplitude phone handheld breathing.
• Action: Vova maintains eye contact, nostrils flare, jaw tensed. Volume rises at 'red panda', drops at 'pet'. Eyes drop toward Tetiana's tears at the end, lips tight.
• Dialogue: Vova says in a loud but restrained voice: 'Tania, a red panda is not a pet!'
• Exit: Last word carries into Tetiana's final reaction.

Shot 6 (13.5s-15s) Breakdown
• Camera: Extreme close-up on Tetiana's eyes and mouth, eye level, 0-degree front. Vova's shoulder and the background remain sharp.
• Movement: Handheld push stops, retaining only natural micro-jitter.
• Action: After the last word, Tetiana's lower lip loses control, corners of the mouth pull down, shoulders slump forward into a suppressed sob. New tear forms on lower lid and follows old track. Vova raises a hand in the foreground but stops mid-air. Ambient sound drops to near silence for one beat before traffic resumes.
• Exit: Lingers on Tetiana's unable-to-speak breath.

Technical Constraints:
• Identity, clothing, height ratio, position, lighting direction, exposure, and environment remain consistent across all shots.
• Each shot is a continuous take; editing follows the 180-degree rule.
• f/16 deep focus throughout; foreground, midground, and background remain sharp.
• Pro-Mist filter only affects highlights; facial structure and edges remain sharp.
• All English dialogue accurately lip-synced.
• Red panda is only mentioned; visuals contain only Tetiana and Vova.
• No subtitles, text, watermarks, logos, music, extra dialogue, or morphing.

Priority Generation: Shot 4 (voice break), Shot 6 (tear movement, final sob, Vova's hand).

prompt:
【Generation Mode】

Seedance 2.0

【Video Specifications】

Strict 15s duration, 16:9 landscape, 24fps, three clean shots.

【Overall Style】

Cinematic realistic texture, utilizing precise physical comedy, elegant Xianxia action, restrained deadpan performance, warm evening indoor light, and classic spatial comedy delayed mechanical payoff. The humor comes from two extremely confident people completing a mundane task too quickly while ignoring a tiny but crucial detail. Designed for Seedance 2.0 multi-modal character reference, multi-prop coordination, continuous performance, and native audio-visual sync.

【Scene Setting】

An unfinished modern apartment, light wooden floors, large windows, warm sunlight, unpacked boxes, scattered cabinet boards, hinges, screws, wooden dowels, a diagram-only manual, and the same bicycle parked by the toolbox.

【Characters】

Character ID A | Sword Immortal Lady

Same Sword Sister @Image 1, 25-30 year old East Asian female, strictly maintaining same face, black hair, makeup, slender build, white embroidered silk Hanfu, jade hairpin, and white boots.

Character ID B | Bicycle Girl

Same Bicycle Girl @Image 2, strictly maintaining face, ponytail, build, clothing, accessories, and bicycle.

【Core Props】

One silver longsword, four miniature tool-swords, same bicycle, set of cabinet boards, hinges, screws, dowels, and manual.

【Shot 1 | 0-5s | Low-angle Panorama Establishing Shot】

The apartment setting as described. The Sword Sister observes the scattered parts and says: 'A mere wooden array.' The Bicycle Girl rings the bell like a start signal.

【Shot 2 | 5-10s | Cowboy Shot Medium】

Controlled lateral orbital movement: The Sister in white silk Hanfu raises two fingers; the silver sword splits into four tools, lifting and fixing boards. The Bicycle Girl checks the manual, passing hinges from the bike basket, catching a falling shelf, commanding: 'Left board, beam, back panel!' Background remains consistent. Sound: screw turning, sword whistling, board clicking with heroic percussion.

【Shot 3 | 10-15s | Close-up to Extreme Close-up】

The assembled cabinet stands upright. They nod with a sense of mission accomplished. The Bicycle Girl finds one dowel left: 'Where does this go?' The Sister answers: 'A spare.' Half-second silence; the cabinet groans and folds in three stages, flattening on the floor. Extreme close-up: they freeze in place as the bicycle bell dings once.

【Technical Requirements】

Character/clothing stability, prop continuity, realistic physics for weight, collapse, and materials. Accurate Mandarin lip-sync. No subtitles.

【Negative Prompts】

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

prompt:
Japanese theatrical anime style, cel-look, flat-shaded animation. The footage should have extremely exaggerated perspective throughout.

An animation where a maid repels gangsters who have broken into a mansion. Please pass this prompt directly to Seedance 2.5. 4:3 landscape aspect ratio. 30 seconds total.

0-3s: Scene of gangsters breaking into the mansion. Gangsters' feet enter from the right and stop. -> Cut transition. Upper body of gangsters holding handguns from a diagonal front angle. They have flustered expressions and gestures.

3-8s: Scene where the maid from Image 1 slowly draws a sword from its scabbard. Close-up of hands -> Cut transition to full body. -> Cut transition to close-up of face. The blade of the sword is shown and glints.

8-10s: Gangsters fire their handguns one after another. Side view.

10-15s: Upper body close-up of the maid from Image 1 ducking. Feet not shown. Diagonal front view. In slow motion, bullets graze her cheeks and hair and fly backward. -> Cut transition. View from behind. From a close-up of the maid's soles. A fixed camera shot of her rapidly accelerating and approaching the gangsters in the background. In the background, the gangsters point handguns at her, sweating coldly.

15-19s: Downward view of Image 1. Diagonal composition. While running toward the screen, she looks up and swings the sword from bottom to diagonal top with momentum. Close-up of the sword tip. Aura effect on her body. The background becomes colors and effect lines flowing into the distance.

19-23s: Handguns leave the gangsters' hands and are split in half (expression of handguns being cut by a sword; the sword itself does not appear. Only the handguns cut in half are floating in mid-air). Three cuts from different viewpoints and angles. Scene of multiple guns being cut.

23-27s: Pan up from the upper body of the character in Image 1. Cut transition when her chin is shown. Close-up of her face from a low angle. Proud expression.

27-30s: Diagonal view from behind Image 1. The gangsters flee in a panic toward the exit at the back of the screen.

7-shot cinematic handheld smartphone food vlog, ultra-photorealistic, authentic travel VLOG aesthetic. Natural handheld movement with subtle focus breathing, casual framing, realistic exposure shifts, warm evening lantern lighting, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, immersive documentary realism.

A young woman (reference image) explores a lively Korean night market and sits at a small outdoor street-food stall. The reference image determines only her facial identity and hairstyle. Outfit: oversized cream linen shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms, dark relaxed-fit trousers, white sneakers, simple canvas shoulder bag. She stays seated at the same counter facing the camera throughout the meal. No other faces are visible—only the vendor's hands occasionally enter the frame while preparing food.

The counter is filled with a sizzling black stone plate of Korean cheese dakgalbi (spicy chicken, melted mozzarella, cabbage, rice cakes, sweet potatoes, sesame seeds, green onions), chilled barley tea, stainless chopsticks, wooden spoon, pickled radish, kimchi, and paper napkins. The background features glowing neon Korean signs, hanging lanterns, rising steam, distant conversations, food stalls, and a vibrant summer evening atmosphere.

Shots

1. The sizzling dakgalbi arrives with steam rising dramatically. She smiles excitedly and says:
"Wow... the smell is really good!"

2. Close overhead shot as the vendor stretches the melted cheese across the pan with metal tongs.

3. She wraps cheesy chicken around a rice cake, takes a big bite, laughs, and fans her mouth playfully from the heat.

4. She sips cold barley tea, exhales with relief, then quietly says:
"This combination is the best."

5. She picks up kimchi and pickled radish between bites while enjoying the smoky flavors.

6. Nearly finished meal. She gives a satisfied nod and says:
"I should come back next time."

7. Empty sizzling plate remains on the counter. She leans back smiling while colorful neon reflections glow behind her as the bustling night market continues.

Only authentic environmental sound: sizzling grill, bubbling cheese, chopsticks, metal utensils, tea pouring, distant market chatter, footsteps, soft breeze, and ambient city nightlife. No background music, subtitles, logos, watermarks, duplicate reference images, or artificial sound effects.

Start with a drop of molten gold floating against a jet-black background and begin a chain of free associations.

Laws of the Chain:
- Do not give specific instructions on what kind of story to create. Based on the 'characteristic properties' (curves, luster, texture, color) of the starting motif, the AI itself should associate the next shape and continuously transform it into another motif.
- Never let it stop or complete a single shape. It must always be in the middle of its next transformation. Do not cut; transitions should melt and flow smoothly into one another.

- Keep moving at all times. The tempo should gradually accelerate.
- At the final moment, the association returns to the starting form, looping seamlessly.

No text, no logos, no subtitles, no characters, no people, no dialogue. The camera is fixed in the center of the screen.

Reveal an irregular dark brown crust with visible grill marks, rendered with realistic heat shimmer and no exaggerated fire. 9 to 12 seconds. Cut to a toasted rustic bun on the same board. Add thick slices of fresh mozzarella, then place the cooked burger onto the lower bun. Keep ingredient positions, hand direction, board grain, clothing, fire, and sunlight continuous. A heavy ribbon of molten mozzarella stretches between the charred beef layers, trembling and thinning under gravity before partially breaking. Compose all key actions in the central safe area while using the wide frame to reveal fire, foliage, smoke, and rustic tools at the edges.

THE LAST ASCENT

1–2 seconds

A powerful pull from the Athena statue.

The character launches at extreme speed between two towering marble columns.

The web is fully taut.

His armor vibrates from the intense velocity.

---

2–3 seconds

He releases the web.

Performs a smooth half-spin in midair.

Fires a new web from the opposite hand.

THWIP.

The web anchors to the peak of a massive temple.

A sharp turn with realistic centrifugal force.

---

3–4 seconds

Low-angle tracking shot.

He skims only centimeters above the ancient stone road.

Dust erupts beneath him.

Horse riders instinctively duck as he flashes past.

---

4–5 seconds

A colossal monster smashes apart a giant marble statue.

Massive stone fragments explode across the street.

He swings directly through the raining debris without losing momentum.

---

5–6 seconds

Side tracking shot.

Still attached to the web, he runs several steps along the temple wall.

He pushes off and launches back into open air.

---

6–7 seconds

Extreme wide aerial shot.

The entire Greek city stretches into the distance.

The monster relentlessly pursues dozens of fleeing soldiers.

Smoke and dust engulf the city.

He remains the only figure moving at extraordinary speed above the chaos.

---

7–8 seconds

He executes two rapid consecutive swings.

THWIP.

THWIP.

Each swing naturally increases his momentum.

The rhythm feels fast, fluid, and physically accurate.

---

He narrowly misses the gigantic head of a Zeus statue.

With only a slight tilt of his body, he slips past by inches.

The camera subtly follows the evasive movement.

---

9–10 seconds

He threads between towering marble pillars.

His cape snaps violently in the wind.

The web remains fully stretched as gravity and momentum pull him through a sweeping arc.

---

10–11 seconds

He swings through the center of a collapsing marketplace.

Citizens scatter.

Broken columns crash behind him.

Dust and sunlight fill the air.

---

11–12 seconds

He releases one web.

Half-rolls through the air.

Fires another.

THWIP.

The web locks onto the tallest tower in the city.

---

12–13 seconds

The final swing accelerates.

An immense pull launches him upward.

His body arches naturally under gravity.

His cape ripples with realistic weight.

---

13–14 seconds

The camera follows from below as he rises above the city.

Below, horse riders, fleeing soldiers, shattered temples, drifting dust, and the colossal monster continue in chaos.

---

14–15 seconds

Hero ending.

He soars into the glowing golden sky.

He becomes a striking silhouette against the sun.

Cut to black.

---

AUDIO

No music.

Use only natural sounds:

- Wind
- Air rushing past
- Ocean waves
- Seagulls

prompt:
A street food vendor in his 40s, broad shoulders, white apron, red bandana headband, stands behind a wok on a night market stall. Just as he prepares a dramatic toss, his phone starts ringing in his pocket. Without hesitation he flips the vegetables and sauce into the air in a perfect arc above the wok under a burst of flame, and at the same moment pulls out his phone and answers it.

Camera holds tight from the side on the arc above the wok. As the vegetables reach the apex, they suddenly stop — suspended mid-air. Every droplet of sauce and every vegetable piece hangs frozen in a precise sculptural formation above the wok.

Calmly on the phone, the vendor says: “Okay, I’ll do it. I’m in the middle of something right now. I’ll do it after five minutes.” He hangs up.

He checks his watch. He leans forward and examines the suspended arc from different angles, hands behind his back. He pokes one suspended carrot. It stays. He shrugs, reaches up, and rearranges a few pieces into a more aesthetically pleasing formation. Steps back. Assesses. Nods.

Finally he casually taps the suspended arc. The vegetables and sauce instantly drop back down into the wok and continue cooking as if nothing happened.

Handheld DV 16mm vlog footage. CHASE films herself at arm’s length and occasionally places the camera on a bench, gym bag, or near the stretching mat. Keep subtle hand movement, drifting composition, autofocus hunting, rushed reframing, uneven zooms, and brief accidental face cropping. The camera itself is never visible.

LOOK:
Warm analog tape texture with gentle grain, slightly reduced sharpness, soft halos around overhead lights, small exposure shifts, low contrast, and realistic skin tones.

STYLE:
An intimate end-of-workout diary filmed in a mostly empty gym. The mood is casual and unpolished: tired breathing, small pauses, quiet humor, relaxed movements, and natural smiles.

CHARACTER:
CHASE — a beautiful white Brazilian Instagram fitness model and lifestyle creator in her 20s. Long wavy chestnut-brown hair tied in a loose ponytail, expressive brown eyes, glowing skin, and a slim athletic figure. She wears a fitted long-sleeve workout top, high-waisted leggings, white socks, sneakers, and a towel loosely resting around her shoulders.

SETTING:
A quiet boutique gym late in the evening. Stretching mats, a mirrored wall, dumbbell racks, a workout bag, and a protein shake nearby. Warm overhead lighting with a few darker corners in the background.

SCENES:
CHASE drops onto the mat and catches her breath.
“Okay… that session is officially over.”
She stretches forward over one leg and smiles at the camera.
“I definitely pushed that last set too far.”
She rolls one shoulder and slowly switches sides.
“Tomorrow is going to be interesting.”
Close-up as she reaches into her gym bag and pulls out a protein shake.
She takes a sip, pauses, and looks pleasantly surprised.
“Wait… this one is actually good.”
She raises both arms above her head and le both arms above her head and leans gently to the side.
“I’d call today a solid eight and a half.”
She rests her arms on one knee, still slightly out of breath.
“Exhausted, but in the best way.”
She stands, throws the bag over her shoulder, and gives the camera a small wave.
“I’m calling it. See you at the next workout.”

prompt:
[Generation Mode]

Seedance 2.0

[Video Specifications]

Strict total duration of 15 seconds, 16:9 aspect ratio, 24fps, three clean shots.

[Overall Style]

Cinematic realistic texture, using a restrained deadpan sports comedy style, high-end commercial film lighting, silent film-style reaction pacing, and clear visual misdirection. It disguises an ordinary indoor cycling class as a grand cavalry charge; the final punchline is shared by both characters, avoiding realistic penalties, accidental falls, failed magic, or one-sided embarrassment.

Designed for Seedance 2.0's unified multi-modal reference, dual-character stable movement, continuous camera spatial relationships, and native audio-visual synchronization for Mandarin dialogue, music, ambient sounds, and action sound effects.

[Scene Setting]

A dimly lit high-end indoor cycling studio. Black mirror walls, two rows of fixed exercise bikes, flowing red and blue lights, slight stage mist, folded towels, silver water bottles, continuously spinning wheels, and an empty instructor platform are clearly visible.

[Characters]

Character ID A | Sword Immortal Sister

A 25–30 year old East Asian 'Sword Immortal' sister from @Image 1. Strictly maintain the same face from the reference image, sharp dark eyes, long black hair, jade hairpin, tall and slender build, white embroidered silk Hanfu, semi-transparent wide sleeves, silver accessories, fluttering long skirt, and white cloth boots.

Character ID B | Cycling Sister

The same cycling sister from @Image 2. Strictly maintain the same face, ponytail, body proportions, clothing, shoes, and accessories.

[Core Props]

Two side-by-side fixed exercise bikes, folded towels, silver water bottles, empty instructor platform.

[Shot 1 | 0-5s | Low-angle Full Shot Slow Tracking]

Dim high-end indoor cycling studio. Character ID A, the 25–30 year old East Asian Sword Immortal sister from @Image 1, is fully seated on the frontmost fixed bike, hands gripping the handlebars, riding fast with a serious expression as if about to head into battle. Character ID B, the cycling sister from @Image 2, rides side-by-side with her. The camera tracks steadily forward from between the two bikes. Sounds of spinning wheels, chain rhythm, breathing, horse-hoof-like percussion, and heroic strings blend to create the illusion of thousands of troops charging.

[Shot 2 | 5-10s | Cowboy Medium Shot Side Tracking]

The same cycling sister lowers her upper body, pushes her cadence to the limit, and shouts: "Last ten seconds, charge!" The same Sword Immortal sister in white embroidered Hanfu stands up from the seat, hands gripping the handlebars, her long hair and wide sleeves fluttering violently backward. The cycling studio remains unchanged, but the red light trails and mirror reflections look like thousands of cavalrymen charging simultaneously. Their shoulders tremble from the effort, sweat beads appear naturally on their skin, yet they maintain a tragic and determined heroic expression as the music peaks.

[Shot 3 | 10-15s | Close-up to Extreme Close-up]

The heroic music stops abruptly, and ordinary white overhead lights flash on. An off-screen instructor announces calmly: "Warm-up finished, the formal class starts now." The same two women freeze simultaneously, slowly turn their heads to look at each other, and then both stop pedaling in unison. The Sword Immortal sister raises a slightly trembling hand and says seriously: "Cultivation requires gradual progress." The cycling sister immediately nods: "Agreed." Extreme close-up of their exhausted yet dignity-maintaining expressions, while the two wheels behind them continue to spin empty at high speed. Frame freeze.

[Technical Requirements]

Strict 15-second total duration, 16:9 wide screen, 24fps, three clean shots. Accurate Mandarin lip-sync, characters maintain clear left-right spatial relationships. Physical effects of pedaling, sweat, hair, silk fabric, wheels, and mirror reflections must be realistic. No generated captions, no added foreground figures.

[Negative Prompt]

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

prompt: High-quality anime footage. Urban fantasy action RPG style, high-rarity 3D toon/cel-look anime high-speed melee combat. Key priorities: high tempo, recoil transition from spear strike to tail attack, clear direct tail hit, and heavy blowback. No slow motion or long charging stances. [Reference Usage] Use Image 1 as the sole character identity reference. Maintain facial features, eye shape, hairstyle, and character color from Image 1. Do not use the background or UI from the reference image. The protagonist is a melee fighter with a spear and a single tail. [Protagonist] Consistent identity throughout. The tail is connected to the lower back and tapers naturally. [Enemy] A single giant armored goblin (1.8x height) with gray-green skin and black iron armor. [Art Style] High-density 3D toon/cel-look with sharp outlines and 2-3 layers of shading. Multi-layered highlights for eyes and hair. [Setting] Rooftop of a neo-gothic library overlooking a neon city after rain. [Action] Cut 1: Protagonist charges and strikes the goblin's chest with a spear, transitioning the recoil into a full-body spin for a tail attack. Cut 2: Close-up of the tail hit. The tail strikes the armor plate with a hit-stop effect, denting the plate. Cut 3: The goblin is blown back 3 meters, crashing into ventilation equipment. Cut 4: Protagonist stops, resting the spear's end on the floor while looking at the defeated enemy. [Guards] Only one protagonist and one enemy. No phantom clones or multiple tails. The goblin must be blown back horizontally, not jumping.

path: prompts/真人/现实向/剧情短片/youmind-8644--Luxury-Restaurant-Floor-Manager-Video.md
prompt:
【REFERENCE】
@image1 is a reference sheet summarizing characters and the stage. The top three panels and the bottom right face panel are used as fixed references for the face, hair, body type, costume, and full body of the same woman who appears alone in the video. Only the restaurant panel on the bottom left is used as a stage reference, inheriting the interior, panoramic window, night view, lighting, floor, tables, chairs, texture, and color tone. White backgrounds, frames, headings, text, and document arrangements are not shown in the video and are not used in the starting frame.
【CONDITION DEFINITION】
15 seconds, 1:1, realistic live-action film expression, high-rise revolving restaurant at night, 4 shots, hard cuts. In the starting frame, all dishes, glasses, napkins, and cutlery are grounded on the table, with zero aerial objects. The woman, body, hair, costume, and camera are always at normal real-world speed. Only after the anomaly, the flying tableware and liquid drops completely stop in world coordinates. The night view, horizon, building shell, central column, and camera are fixed, and only the circular floor, tables, and chairs rotate around the central column. The screen is not rotated. The emergency stop device is a black metal manual lever on the yellow and black mounting plate of the fixed central column. Do not change to a red button, vertical pole, or other device. The woman touches the central column only once just before the lever for 0.4 seconds or less.
【SHOT / FLOW】
SHOT 1 | 0-2.5s | Normal to anomaly occurrence
Fixed wide angle. 0-1.4s, woman walks normally between guest seats. All dishes are grounded on the table, and the floor and guest seats are completely stationary. There are no aerial objects, alarms, vibrations, or rotations. At 1.4s, strong vibration and alarm occur simultaneously. Tableware clearly flies up from the table and stops in the air at 1.7s. Only after that, the circular floor and guest seats begin to move. The woman braces herself on the moving floor, sees the distant lever, and immediately starts running. Hard cut at 2.5s.
SHOT 2 | 2.5-9.5s | Long obstacle run
A horizontal camera on the central axis side follows with a pan from the diagonal front. Against a fixed night view, floor patterns and furniture continue to flow from right to left. The woman runs towards the center while changing position and distance within the screen, not staying in the same place.
2.5-4.5s, she sprints hard against the flowing floor but slips significantly and is moved away from the lever. She momentarily grabs the back of a passing chair and immediately releases it to re-accelerate. 4.5-6.8s, she ducks under stationary plates, avoids glasses with her upper body, and slips diagonally between approaching tables. 6.8-8.2s, her path is blocked by a crossing chair, and she places a hand on the edge of a table to change direction sharply. 8.2-9.5s, she sprints the last 5m to the lever, but the floor accelerates further and she is swept sideways just before the central column. Shows full body, foot grounding, distressed expression, and swaying of hair and costume. Stationary objects do not follow the woman or furniture.
SHOT 3 | 9.5-12s | Momentary support and lever operation
Medium view. 9.5-10.0s, while being swept away, the woman reaches for the fixed central column with her last step. She grabs the column only once between 9.8-10.2s. She does not hug the column, go around it, or stop. She throws her body forward with the momentum and releases the column by 10.2s. 10.2-11.1s, she grabs the black lever on the yellow and black mounting plate with both hands and pulls it down to the end in a single powerful motion. 11.1-12.0s, the floor brakes suddenly, the woman releases the lever and stumbles two steps sideways, bracing in a low posture. Shows the lowered lever clearly and hard cut.
SHOT 4 | 12-15s | Time recovery and release
Wide angle. Includes the lowered black lever and yellow/black mounting plate in the right foreground, the woman standing away from the column in a position off-center, and stationary objects and guest seats in the background. 12.0-12.5s, the floor and guest seats stop completely. At 12.5s, time returns for the aerial objects, and all fall simultaneously onto the floor and tables by 13.3s. The woman runs away from the column, avoiding falling plates and sliding beside a table. 13.3-15.0s, the alarm stops, and the woman catches her breath without touching the column. Leaves the lowered lever, stopped floor, fallen objects, woman, and fixed night view in the final frame.
【CAMERA / EDITING】
Horizontally stable wide angle, medium view, short close-ups. Floor rotation is shown by the parallax of the fixed night view, fixed column, flowing floor patterns, and crossing furniture. Do not fix the woman in the center of the screen for long. No camera rolls, rotation of the entire screen, rotation outside the window, long rear tracking, crossfades, speed ramps, or overall slow motion.
【SOUND】
No BGM, dialogue, or narration. Quiet interior sounds during normal times, 1.4s vibration and alarm, accelerating mechanical sounds, fast footsteps, sliding sounds, furniture friction, heavy breathing, short column contact sounds, heavy mechanical lever sounds, and sudden braking sounds. Short silence after braking and the sound of dishes falling all at once.
【NEGATIVE】
Tableware floating from the start, floor rotating from the start, omission of anomaly occurrence, simple running in a stationary store, woman continuing to hold onto columns/poles, hugging the column, going around the column, woman stopping for a long time in the center of the screen, no obstacles, lack of floor rotation, rotation of screen/camera/night view/central column, overall slow motion, woman floating/multiplying/changing appearance, stationary objects following, time manipulation gestures, red buttons, vertical handles, lever deformation/movement/disappearance, new liquids, aerial objects after 13.3 seconds, composition where the lever disappears from the final screen, frames/text/white backgrounds of the reference sheet.

prompt:
Realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9.

At night in heavy rain, a lone driver in a dark SUV races across a long suspension bridge over black water toward the far shore as the bridge begins failing around him. The sequence opens with a wide low angle showing the wet bridge deck, flashing warning lights, and traffic stopped ahead and behind.

A massive suspension cable suddenly snaps with a violent burst of sparks, the whole bridge lurches, and the road tilts sharply to one side. The driver grips the wheel and accelerates as abandoned cars behind him begin sliding backward across the rain-slick deck into the darkness, smashing into each other and crashing through broken railings.

Keep the action clear and physical. The SUV fishtails but stays under control as the driver swerves around a sliding sedan and a fallen cable whipping across the road. The bridge deck buckles in sections, sending cracks racing through the asphalt. Another support cable snaps, one lane drops lower than the other, and a car behind the SUV loses traction and disappears over the edge. Use dynamic but readable camera movement: wide exterior view of the bridge twisting in the storm, low tracking shot beside the SUV tires cutting through water, and a tense front three-quarter angle as the vehicle climbs the tilted roadway toward safety.

Final action: the driver pushes through the last unstable section just as the center span behind him tears downward. He bursts off the bridge onto solid ground at the far anchorage while the roadway behind collapses in stages, cars sliding backward into the void, cables snapping, sparks flying, and rain exploding off the shattered structure. Realistic storm lighting, hard rain, wet reflections, engine spray, debris, violent structural movement, intense survival atmosphere, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion, no extra main characters, no famous celebrity faces, no recognizable actors, no movie-star resemblance, no public-figure likenesses, no clear facial close-ups.

prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic action sequence set in a real-world environment. Everything must obey real-world physics: realistic gravity, momentum, inertia, acceleration, friction, weight, collisions, balance, impact forces, wind resistance, and natural human movement. No supernatural abilities, impossible stunts, floating objects, teleportation, rubbery motion, or unrealistic physics.

Visual Style: Photorealistic live-action, authentic human proportions, realistic skin and clothing, natural lighting, physically accurate shadows and reflections, realistic environmental interaction, subtle handheld camera movement, natural motion blur, cinematic depth of field, high-end movie cinematography, ARRI-style digital cinema look, 4K HDR.

SHOT 1 — 0:00–0:03 | Tension

A realistic urban street at dusk after light rain. A fit adult man in practical dark clothing runs around a parked vehicle while looking behind him. His shoes realistically grip the wet pavement, water splashes under every step, clothing reacts naturally to his movement and wind. Camera follows from a low handheld tracking angle.

SHOT 2 — 0:03–0:06 | Pursuit

Cut to a wider side angle. The man crosses the street while another adult man follows several meters behind. Both maintain believable running speed, acceleration, balance, and foot placement. A vehicle approaches and brakes naturally at a safe distance, tires producing realistic water spray. No impossible near-misses.

SHOT 3 — 0:06–0:09 | Obstacle

The first man reaches a waist-high metal barrier. He slows slightly, plants one foot firmly, uses both hands, and climbs over it with realistic body weight and momentum. His clothing stretches naturally. The camera moves alongside him with subtle motion blur.

SHOT 4 — 0:09–0:12 | Close Action

The pursuer catches up. The two briefly struggle in a realistic, controlled physical confrontation. One pushes the other backward. The pushed character loses balance naturally, takes several steps backward, catches himself against a wall, and regains his footing. Show realistic contact, reaction, inertia, and weight transfer.
